articleTitle: Grooming a Thorough Analysis of Cyber-Attacks and Cyber Security
abstract: Currently, the majority of government, commercial, social, cultural and economic activities and interaction among nations, at every level, including those of individuals, non-governmental groups, governments, and governmental institutions are done out in cyberspace. The number of internet users has significantly increased. In recent times, cyber-attacks have become a threat for government Institution and private companies. Cyber-attack is done using computer and network and preventing cyber-attacks on our data is very challenging. In fact, machine learning can also be used to identify and reduce the cyber-crime. The goals of this research would be to critically review the progress made in the area of cyber security and to address the challenges, advantages, and disadvantages of the recommended strategies. In addition to historical developments and early cybersecurity initiatives, standard security frameworks are analyzed. Furthermore, current threats to security, developing trends in cyber security, and latest developments are also discussed. The thorough review study that has been offered is anticipated to be helpful to internet users, IT and cyber security researchers.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Driven Path Loss Prediction for 5G Networks in Smart Cities Metro Station Environments
abstract: Accurate path loss models are crucial for ensuring quality of service for wireless network customers. However, traditional approaches for measuring wireless communications are often inaccurate, complex, and time-consuming. In this paper, we introduce a novel method for prediction of path loss by employing various ML (machine learning) algorithns such as support vector regression, decision trees, k-nearest neighbors, and random forests. Our approach focuses on path loss prediction at Yamuna bank metro station and Rajiv chowk metro station in Delhi. The results demonstrate that machine learning algorithms can predict path loss models more accurately than traditional deterministic or numerical analytic approaches. This finding is particularly important as fifth-generation wireless technology evolves, and a high-accuracy and low-complexity channel model is needed. The proposed machine learning approach has the potential to optimize wireless network performance and enhance the quality of service for end users. The results demonstrate its effectiveness in improving the accuracy and efficiency of path loss models, ultimately leading to better reception quality in wireless networks. This research offers valuable insights into optimizing wireless network performance and improving service quality for users in the era of fifth-generation technology.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Image Classification and Object Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: In the modern era, Deep Learning (DL) methodology is used extensively in multiple areas and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is majorly used for addressing the problems in real-time for computer vision activities due to its capability of enabling acquisitions with higher accuracy. The concept at the back of this DL technique was inspired from architecture of biotic visual systems. In the current time, it is applied extensively in multiple areas and industries like automotive, medical and healthcare, space, aviation, agriculture etc. Moving forward, numerous algorithms on CNN were proposed to address the requirement of multiple areas, with Natural Language Processing (NLP) and computer vision as the major fields for application. The activities in computer vision with major application of CNN includes image categorization, object identification, recognition of face, estimation of human pose, recognition of action, scene labelling along with document analysis. This paper delves into modern techniques of CNN for classification of images and detection of objects.

articleTitle: Predictive Models for Career Guidance, Based on Academic and Behavioral Data with Data Mining and Machine Learning Technique
abstract: A person's future is greatly influenced by career counseling, especially for students making decisions about their education and careers. This project focuses on using data mining and machine learning approaches to leverage behavioral and academic data to create prediction models for career advising. To produce individualized career suggestions, the suggested system combines data gathering, preprocessing, feature engineering, and predictive analytics. Academic performance indicators (e.g., grades, test scores), behavioral characteristics (e.g., learning styles, personality tests), and demographic information are important sources of data. While clustering techniques like K-Means make it easier to group students with similar profiles, machine learning algorithms like Random Forest, Support Vector Machines, and Neural Networks are used for classification. Furthermore, hybrid models that combine clustering and classification improve the accuracy and customization of the system. Metrics including precision, recall, F1 score, and clustering validation indices are used to evaluate the system, guaranteeing solid and trustworthy results. By assigning students to appropriate career groupings and recommending certain positions, the prediction algorithms offer useful insights. This study fills in the gaps in conventional career counseling approaches and opens the door for scalable, effective, and customized career advice systems by showing how cutting-edge data-driven approaches can enable students to make well-informed career decisions.

articleTitle: Selection of Optimized Antenna Design for Improved Performance in Gain, Return Loss, and Efficiency for Access Point in WLAN
abstract: Optimizing antenna design is critical for improving performance metrics such as gain, return loss, and efficiency in modern communication systems. This paper evaluates two antenna configurations, including patch, and array designs, to achieve improved performance. The primary goal is to improve gain, minimize return loss, and maximize efficiency by optimizing key design parameters such as antenna frequency, feed technique, and substrate materials. Using simulation tool such as IE3D, antenna designs are modeled and analyzed to assess the impact of designing parameters. The results demonstrate that optimized designs lead to more efficient, high-gain antennas suitable for applications like next-generation wireless networks. The study concludes that efficient design and designing parameters significantly enhance antenna performance, contributing to the development of robust and reliable communication systems.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Deep-Fake Detection Methods
abstract: The easy availability of deepfakes because of advancements in generative adversarial networks (GANs) and other deep learning models, has led to popularization of extremely realistic fake media which can easily be misused. This review paper gives a comparative analysis of different deepfake detection methods in images as well as videos format, it focusses on advanced methodologies like hybrid deep learning, surface anomaly detection, vision language adoption, and transfer learning. Different methods like CNN-LSTM, GAN based approaches and architectures like CLIP, have different strengths in deepfake detection. Each method is assessed for its effectiveness in different real-world scenarios, generalization capabilities and performance with multiple datasets. We will also look into the shortcomings in every method. This analysis aims to find optimal deployment of these techniques and find which technique is optimal for detecting deepfakes to combat misuse and misinformation caused by such altered images and videos.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Enabled Smart Agriculture Monitoring and Control System
abstract: The Indian economy mainly revolves around the agriculture sector, and it is one of the dominant nations in agriculture. In recent times, traditional methods of agriculture have become more inclined towards automation-based agricul-ture, where the integration of modern technologies such as the Internet of Things, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and many others are taking the lead. In our proposed system, various sensors relating to agriculture mapping are integrated with the Internet of Things, and the data collected from the sensors, processed through IoT, will be further analyzed using machine learning and suggesting a corrective mechanism based on the data collected. No human intervention is needed; the system is fully automatic, responds within a delay time of 8.1 sec, and produces an accuracy of 94.68 % in predicting the data harvest.

articleTitle: Lunar Sustainable Housing Infrastructure Design by Using Tinkercad
abstract: The lunar explorations educate about natural formation of the earth and the moon. Further, moon settlement may also explore technological advancements such as new ways of controlling the environment and recycling etc. As the moon has practically zero atmosphere, the outer space view from the moon surface is far clearer. Thus, blasting off from Moon surface to explore other regions of outer space would be much easier. This paper presents the complex design of lunar housing infrastructure with a secured environment by using Tinkercad software. The proposed work also prioritizes sustainability and technical innovations by application of prefabricated bases, automated agriculture, and healthcare solutions. The proposed Tinkercad software supported residential infrastructure design provides good design, easy to implement, efficient and further a base for future colonization at moon.

articleTitle: IOT Based Plant Growth Monitoring and Ideal Condition Detection System
abstract: In recent times, the Internet of Things (IoT) has inched itself as an evolutionary technology in agriculture as it allows for managing and controlling the growth conditions of the plants in an optimal way. This paper demonstrates the features of an IoT based system for effective plant growth monitoring along with ideal condition detection. The set of sensors embedded in the system incorporates measuring devices that capture and send the temperature, humidity, soil moisture content and light intensity to a central processing unit. The system sets and analyzes the data cloud along with AI algorithms for efficient agricultural activities and systems. This study focuses on the system design, its data gathering procedures, and decision processes, and their potential in smart farming and urban gardening. The experiments, conducted within the framework of the given concept showed that the system was able to operate within ideal conditions and therefore when changes occur, it initiates an action that helps avoid resource losses and assist in improving the yield. It reiterates the importance of IoT in world of agriculture and the quest for sustainability in modern farming practices.

articleTitle: Assessing the AI-Powered Model for the Impact of Wearable Devices on the Human Body
abstract: We all know the significance and role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine learning in our lives. They have created huge impacts on our day-to-day lives. AI is revolutionising various aspects of modern life, spanning healthcare, entertainment, transportation, and education sectors. Numerous advantages of the technology include improved accuracy, efficiency, and personalisation. With so many benefits, in this paper, we will be discussing an AI-based model to analyse and predict Human activity using sensors, will identify the barriers to the adoption of wearable devices in healthcare and propose strategies to overcome them using a multidisciplinary approach and evaluate the impacts of wearable devices on the human physique comprehensively and at an expansive magnitude. The effectiveness of combining data from wearable devices and neuroimaging data requires further research. Wearables present potential opportunities because they monitor human behaviour and vitals, aid in medical diagnostics, and benefit elderly care, clinical services, and diagnostics. New models and frameworks for wearable technology have emerged due to recent technological advancements, AI mechanisms and technologies, the extensive use of smart devices, and booming data and computing device vogues. The scrutiny examines a broad realm of AI and machine learning enabling technologies for wearables and investigation instances. Hence, the paper concludes with some research procedures and strategies to discover the influence and significance of wearable devices on the person's body, their pros and cons, and the potential future study.

articleTitle: AI/ML in Preventive Healthcare: Building Multi-Disease Prediction Systems for Early Interventions
abstract: In today's healthcare, it has become crucial to predict multiple diseases such as PCOD, breast cancer and cervical cancer that have become more important to improve patient care. The proposed system is to be used by healthcare professionals to predict multiple disease with given input datasets. The stated system learns using machine learning capabilities including XGboost and CatBoost, in an effort to predict the presence of these cancers by identifying parameters that suggest the existence of the cancer. The proposed study shows that XGboost performs better than CATBoost in terms of Accuracy with 95 percent, making it suitable for integration with existing health care systems and enabling real time predictions to give doctors more powerful tools for diagnosing and developing personalized treatment plans for cancer patients.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Network Based Cyber Intrusion Detection System
abstract: An Intrusion Detection System (IDS) is a critical security device used to prevent intrusions, protect networks and digital assets from malicious traffic. Considering the rapid advancement of internet technology, security of networks has become a critical concern as there is high rise in data volume due to exponential growth of internet users and thus posing the serious security challenges. Soft computing techniques have proven effective in handling such large datasets, outperforming traditional approaches and demonstrating superior performance. In this study, we propose a soft computing-based IDS, training the model using complete set of features. The system was simulated with the help of a hybrid real and modern threat activities synthesized in UNSW-NB15 dataset, and the results validate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning for a Four Degree of Freedom Robot Arm Accelerated by Human Demonstration
abstract: This work investigates the use of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) for training a four-degree-of-freedom (4-DOF) robotic arm to efficiently and adaptively reach arbitrary target positions. A dueling double deep Q-network (D3QN) manages the large state-action space, while human demonstration data guides the agent's policy toward more human-like and effective trajectories. Experimental results show that integrating human demonstrations enables the robot arm to achieve more precise target positioning more frequently and in fewer steps than a purely self-trained agent. To assess generality and adaptability, the approach is tested on both a PhantomX Reactor robot arm and a Dobot Magician robot arm, with adjustments made to the Denavit-Hartenberg parameters of the latter. After running 5000 simulated training episodes on each platform, the resulting model is then implemented on the Dobot hardware for 50 episodes, demonstrating the feasibility of accurately controlling a robotic arm model different from the one used during training. The method's potential extends to practical computer vision-guided tasks such as pick-and-place or peg insertion, thus showcasing its versatility in both simulation and physical implementations.

articleTitle: Dual Port Merged-Elliptical Patch with Tapered Ground Designed for Integrated Narrow WiMAX/C-band and Wideband Antenna for Multiple Wireless Applications
abstract: In this manuscript, a dual-elliptical EM-wave inset feed antenna radiating electromagnetic energy with tapered ground is designed for WiMAX/C-band and Microwave-millimeter-wave band applications. The single-port antenna, a flower-type patch with a circular slot, is printed on the surface of the thin substrate and ground on opposite surfaces. This achieves bandwidth in Band1 of 3.22GHz-4.45GHz and Band2-bandwidth of 14.23GHz-40.0GHz. The identical patch is arranged in an orthogonal sequence, forming a four-port MIMO with bandwidth by all the patches nearing 3.00GHz-5.90GHz and 14.32GHz-40.0GHz. The MIMO configuration achieves isolation of more than −10.0dB in Band1 and more fantastic than −20.0dB in Band2. The diversity parameter includes <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{ECCMMW} < 0.05, \text{DGMMW} > 9.998\text{dB}$</tex>, TARCMMW more than −4.0dB, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{CCL}_{\text{MMW}} < 0.40\mathrm{b}/\mathrm{s}/\text{Hz}$</tex> with stable 2-D radiation patterns.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based E-Voting System Hosted on Cloud
abstract: Blockchain technology is becoming a great innovation at today's date due to its transparency, security and reliability. With the advancement in every aspect of life blockchain with its decentralized and distributed ledger system aims to provide immutability in digital transaction across the globe with the help of block structure joined together that stored the data in the form of hash. The data stored in block is next to immutable as if tried to change in a single block the hash of every block in the chain will change which makes it easy to identify. Due to its security and transparency the study describes its use in the e-voting system revolutionizing voting system with more security and transparency reducing logistic problem, solving storage issues, solves the problem of using extra man power in the large democracy like India.

articleTitle: Rice Leaf Disease Detection Using Deep Learning Models: A Comprehensive Approach
abstract: Rice serves as a primary food source for more than half of the global population. However, a range of diseases brought on by pathogens, including as bacteria, viruses and fungus are posing a growing threat to rice agriculture. These diseases have the potential to seriously reduce crop productivity and threaten food security. Conventional disease detection techniques mostly depend on the labor-intensive, time consuming and frequently prone to human error manual inspection performed by qualified agronomists. We concentrate on two cutting edge architectures: Vision Transformers (ViT) and DenseNet169, which is well-known for its high accuracy in image classification applications and efficiency in feature reuse which make use of self-attention mechanisms to identify complex patterns in images. We developed these models to precisely categorize various rice leaf diseases, including Bacterial Leaf Blight, Brown Spot, Leaf Blast, Leaf Scald, Narrow Brown Spot, Neck Blast, Rice Hispa, Sheath Blight, Tungro, and healthy leaves. This was achieved using a comprehensive dataset containing 15,910 annotated images of rice leaves. Our proposed systems improve crop management practices by enabling prompt interventions based on precise predictions but it helps to guarantee ensuring global food security and maximizing overall crop yield. This study highlights the revolutionary potential of artificial intelligence in agriculture, paving the way for further advancements that can enhance sustainability and productivity.

articleTitle: Analysis of Deep Learning based Ensemble Models for Brain Tumor Detection
abstract: Brain tumor is one of the severe diseases that can lead to human death. The probability of success for human treatment increases if the tumor is detected at an early stage. This paper works on the transfer learning models for detection of brain tumor. Transfer learning is one of the most useful deep learning techniques which offers reutilization of the pre-trained models on new tasks. This paper analyzed the performance of pre-trained models, i.e., VGG16, Xception, VGG19, and ResNet50, on three different MRI based datasets of varying sizes. On the basis of the performance of these models, this work continues the analysis using different ensembles of VGG16, ResNet50, and Xception. Overall, this work analyzes twelve ensembles, which include three weighted ensembles for VGG16+ResNet50, VGG16+Xception, Xception+ResNet50, and four weighted ensembles of VGG16+Resnet50+Xception. This work shows that the VGG16+ResNet50 ensemble with 25% weightage to ResNet50 and 75% weightage of VGG16, gives 94.04%,98.6%, and 99.4% accuracy on dataset1, dataset2, and dataset3, respectively, to outperform all other individual and ensemble models.

articleTitle: Blockchain Network Waiting Time Traffic Distribution Based on Priority
abstract: Blockchain (Bchain) technology has a wide range of applications across various fields. We can easily use Bchain in healthcare, and the number of transactions in healthcare is very high. In healthcare, there are several entities that can affect the process, from emergencies to normal OPD handling, so the Bchain throughput must be very low in healthcare. As per the distributed nature of Bchain, the waiting time (WT) for transactions should be minimal, and we divide the traffic into two categories, i.e., high priority (Hp) and low priority (Lp). We propose a method for distributing the WT using the Pollaczek-Khintchine equation. The study highlights the impact of transaction arrival rates and priority-based processing on Bchain congestion, showing that high-fee transactions experience significantly lower waiting times while low-fee transactions face delays. It underscores the importance of optimizing gas fees for faster confirmation and suggests that scalability solutions like adaptive block sizes and Layer 2 rollups are essential for reducing congestion. Additionally, the findings provide valuable insights for Bchain developers and policymakers to improve transaction prioritization mechanisms, optimize mining incentives, and refine protocol upgrades like Ethereum's EIP-1559 to enhance overall network efficiency. The results show that the allocation of Hp traffic remains unaffected by Lp traffic, whereas Lp traffic is dependent on Hp traffic.

articleTitle: Applications of AI in Preservation of Kumaoni Culture Through Digital Archival
abstract: Culture represents a society with human values and ethics. Without civilization there can be no culture. Thus it is very important to preserve our culture as it represents our values and ethics. Each region has its own characteristics culture which separates it from other regions not just geographically but in terms of traditions, art and literature. The Kumaon region in the Indian state of Uttarakhand lies in the eastern part of the state. It is blessed with a rich culture heritage and nature. The preservation of culture is done through traditional methods. The focus of this study is to use modern Artificial Intelligence techniques to achieve the preservation of culture. The Artificial Intelligence techniques which are used in this paper range from Convolutional Neural Networks, augmentation of data and fine tuning of models. To preserve it is necessary to archive the cultural elements so that it can be easily accessible in the future. The archival process can help in cataloguing the cultural items. By culture we mean traditional arts, such as Aipan, local literature texts and historical structures. The archival process seamlessly integrates the Artificial Intelligence methods to effectively preserve the cultural elements. This process can be further enhanced by fine tuning the Convolutional Neural Networks. This makes the model more robust and accurate than the existing model. The dataset quality can be further improved by using data augmentation techniques. This allows to generate more data from existing dataset. However, with the process comes some challenges like accountability and validity. This study explores these challenges which can help existing researchers in the field of culture and arts.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Fire Detection: Harnessing the Power of Machine Learning Models
abstract: The increasing frequency of wildfires and industrial accidents has highlighted the urgent need for reliable, real-time fire detection systems. Traditional fire detection technologies, primarily relying on smoke and heat sensors, often fail in dynamic and complex environments, making them less effective. In contrast, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) offer significant advantages for fire and smoke detection, as they can process large amounts of data and adapt to varying conditions, improving detection accuracy and robustness. This study provides a comparative evaluation of ANN and RNN models for fire detection, focusing on their ability to handle challenging scenarios such as occlusion and complex environmental conditions, where false alarms must be minimized. We explore the integration of these models with visual, thermal, and text data to enhance the detection process.

articleTitle: Empowering Smart Cities Through IoT and AI: Enhancing Decision-Making for a Data-Driven Future
abstract: To make better decisions, Smart Cities have embraced IoT & AI. As an outcome of the combination of IoT devices, which collect & transmit huge sets of data, and AI approaches, which process & examine this information, organizations have gained real-time insights and information to drive better decisions. With IoT and AI, decision-making processes can be automated, for instance, in predictive maintenance and supply chain management, which can improve operational efficiency, personalize the customer experience, reduce energy consumption, and enhance security. In this paper, we have discussed the rapidly identifying trends, patterns, and potential issues, IoT and AI which have transformed the decision-making process in Smart Cities and is now considered a key tool in staying ahead in today's data-driven world. We have also proposed a model which can help enhance the security concerns in Smart Cities as there has been a significant impact of IoT and AI on decision-making. In the future, it will only become more critical as technology advances and more data is generated. Overall embracing both IoT and artificial intelligence will be well-positioned for success in the future. This review article will examine the part of IoT and AI in decision-making, its benefits and challenges, and its future angle.

articleTitle: A Custom Sandbox for Malware Threat Analysis to Safeguard Infrastructure
abstract: The issue of safeguarding critical infrastructure against malware attacks has become more of a concern with the growing complexity of cyber threats. The paper presents the design and development of a custom sandbox tailored for isolated malware threat analysis, specifically aimed at addressing the security needs of organizations. Unlike existing solutions, this paper proposes creating a dedicated sandbox for the Indian cybersecurity landscape, which currently lacks a homegrown platform for malware analysis. The sandbox enables both static as well as dynamic analysis and provides a controlled, virtualized environment to investigate malware details without compromising the integrity of the system. Virtualization and monitoring tools help sandbox to effectively isolate threats so that malware TTPs (Tactics, Techniques and Procedures) can be understood. This work is a foundational step toward indigenous cyber security solutions. It stands as an excellent chance of augmenting national resilience against all evolving malware threats.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security and Privacy of Healthcare Data Using Hybrid Cryptographic Scheme for Cloud-Based Environment
abstract: Hospitals are progressively adopting cloud computing to store and manage patient data, enhancing accessibility and collaboration. The sensitive nature of health information necessitates robust security measures to avert unauthorized access and potential breaches. This study introduces a hybrid methodology that combines the Blowfish algorithm with Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) to protect data during cloud transmission. ECC is used as an asymmetric encryption technique for key exchange, whereas Blowfish serves as a symmetric encryption strategy for data encryption. Combining asymmetric and symmetric cryptography makes sure that security is higher and key management is more efficient. We commend ECC for its exceptional performance and enhanced security. Blowfish is optimal for cloud data encryption because of its swift encryption and decryption rates. It employs various key lengths, rendering it resilient against brute force assaults and safeguarding the secrecy of stored data. Blowfish enables robust encryption mechanisms to protect data during cloud transport from unauthorized access. We assessed the efficacy of this hybrid encryption method by conducting various tests across numerous data clouds. The findings indicate that the suggested hybrid security scheme outperforms the current schemes regarding computing time.

articleTitle: Evaluating Transformer Models for Named Entity Recognition in Indian Legal Texts
abstract: Named Entity Recognition (NER) in legal texts is vital for extracting information from vast, unstructured legal documents. The complexity of legal language—characterized by formal style, domain-specific terminology, and unique entity types such as case numbers, legal citations, court names, judges, and involved parties—poses significant challenges. Traditional machine learning models fall short due to their reliance on manual feature engineering and limited adaptability to the nuanced legal language. This paper evaluates transformer-based models, DistilBERT, DistilRoBERTa, and InLegalBERT, for NER in Indian court judgments using a comprehensive dataset prepared by OpenNyAI, which contains 46,545 annotated legal entities across 14 distinct types (e.g., petitioner, respondent, statute). To address imbalanced entity distribution, we propose a cleaning process and optimization of dataset splits using Jensen-Shannon Divergence, ensuring a more balanced representation of entities across training, validation, and test sets. We fine-tuned each model on three versions of the dataset: (1) the original dataset, (2) a cleaned dataset with sentences lacking tagged entities removed, and (3) a version with optimized entity distribution. Performance evaluation based on precision, recall, and F1-score revealed that DistilRoBERTa achieved the highest F1-score of 0.8672, significantly outperforming DistilBERT and demonstrating improvements over InLegalBERT, which is pre-trained on legal texts. Our results underscore that balanced dataset splits and robust preprocessing are crucial for enhancing model generalizability and performance in legal NER tasks, as evidenced by substantial gains in F1-scores following these preprocessing steps.

articleTitle: Comparative Review on Image Dehazing Methods Using Deep Learning Approach for Vision-Based Applications
abstract: Vision-based applications such as traffic management, public area surveillance, and environmental monitoring require clear and accurate visual data from cameras to provide better services to people. But foggy weather and traffic pollution causes haze, dust, or smog to degrade image quality, and reduce visibility of the target area, and becomes a challenge to the reliability of the automated application in urban areas. They face some additional problems such as color distortion, non-uniform illumination, low light, and dense or nonhomogeneous haze. The learning-based methods outperform traditional image dehazing methods in complex real-world problems and utilize large image datasets, despite their notable performance, learning-based models can have high computation and may require wide-ranging training datasets. This paper discussed prior-based and deep learning-based image dehazing models to test the RESIDE dataset with indoor and outdoor hazy images. Further, objective evaluation metrics have been discussed that are being used to evaluate the quality of state-of-the-art methods. These methodologies help us to set up vision-based applications for smart cities and have shown great potential to enhance image quality affected by haze and low light.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction Analysis with Machine Learning
abstract: When early diagnosis and treatment of heart diseases becomes increasingly challenging. However, various studies and researches discovered that recent development in technologies affects the healthcare industry with the advanced machine learning techniques. A machine learning predictive model (LumenCardia) for heart-diseases based on relative parameters is the aim of this work. In this project, we had employed the dataset called Cleveland heart disease dataset, which includes 14 distinct heart disease-related factors. In this study we had applied ML techniques like Random Forest, Logistic Regression, KNN, and Decision Tree to our model. We also looked for relationships among different features in our dataset using conventional ML techniques. The outcome demonstrates that Random Forest produces predictions with more accuracy (93.18%) in less time than other machine learning algorithms. The medical professionals may find LumenCardia beneficial as a decision support system.

articleTitle: Systematic Review and Development of Advanced CNN Models for Enhanced Diagnostic Accuracy in Retinal Diseases
abstract: This study investigates the application of deep learning techniques, specifically Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), to detect and classify retinal disorders in fundus and Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) images. It conducts a detailed analysis of current AI-based diagnostic approaches and demonstrates a revolutionary, multi-step deep learning methodology. The framework achieves exact classification and segmentation of retinal diseases by including fine-tuned pre-trained CNN architectures, with diagnostic accuracy comparable to or greater than that of human experts. Standard dataset evaluations have shown that it has the ability to considerably improve diagnostic processes in terms of speed, accuracy, and accessibility. Addressing the increased global prevalence of retinal illnesses and the dearth of qualified ophthalmologists, this study demonstrates how integrating complementary imaging modalities might improve AI-driven eye healthcare while laying a basis for future advances.

articleTitle: Online Discussion Forum with E-Voting Capabilities Using Smart Contracts
abstract: The title of our project is “Online Discussion Forum with e-voting capabilities”. We intend to help organizations and institutions alike, to have a ready-to-onboard platform for their election requirements. These requirements might plunge from a plethora of situations, ranging from an election for the best teacher in a school to an election for the most favored dish in a restaurant. Various groups within an organization can enroll and establish their presence in the system to participate in both polling activities and general discussions. The backend of this web-application will be developed using assembly language and the frontend using React JS. Since INDIA is the largest democracy in the entire world so our inspiration of having a very fair elections came from this fact, also the development of the country depends on the honest government which is chosen by fair elections. We have attempted to put forth an application that is beyond legacy apprehensions that pop-up to the surface during the election fervor. Ostensibly, there is not an exact application to compare with. However, a famous one exists which ardently promotes discussion but discourages voting. Another one is fundamentally a messaging application, but it allows the users post polls in message groups. We have noted the crucial points from both the applications and incorporated the good of both the worlds.

articleTitle: Social Media Sentiment Analysis for Airline Customer Satisfaction
abstract: Among the most important subfields in natural language processing, one of the fields is sentiment analysis. Sentiment analysis focuses on recognizing and estimating emotions in text. It has gained more importance in aviation in the sense that it can present insights into customer satisfaction and brand reputation as well as operational efficiency. This work investigates the topic of the sentiment analysis of the Twitter US Airline Sentiment Dataset: more than 14,000 tweets regarding the major US airlines labelled as positive, neutral, or negative. By such approaches documented in the literature, challenges consisting of the noise and subtlety of sentiment in the given data largely remain unsolved. To address these deficiencies, this research will use the machine learning techniques in the form of Naive Bayes and Random Forest models, classifying sentiments by methods like class imbalances through SMOTE, and using TF-IDF vectorization in extracting features. Results for the experiment showed that the Random Forest model outperforms Naive Bayes as the former can classify more neutral and positive sentiments correctly. It is, therefore, concluded that sentiment analysis may be useful to airlines for enhancement in customer experience and future research should emphasize on advanced deep learning models with rich data sets for further potential enhancement.

articleTitle: A Blockchain and Temperature Setting Approach for Secure Supply Chain of Temperature Sensitive Medicines
abstract: The medical supply chain (MSC) is a medical business that requires connecting suppliers, manufacturers, distributors, healthcare providers, and patients to ensure a steady supply of safe and effective medicine. It is not only important to deliver the product to the right place but also to track its survivability at different physical environment parameters such as temperature, humidity, etc. MSC faces several problems like fraud, counterfeiting, traceability, and ineffective ways of transportation. This paper aims to provide a transparent, secure, and trackable system by the use of blockchain technology and IoT. Some types of medicines require to be maintained at a certain temperature for their survival like antibiotics, insulin, vaccines, etc. For these types of medicine, we set the required parameter of temperature at the start of the supply chain. The Bosch BME680 sensor is used for real-time temperature monitoring and is integrated with EVM-based smart contracts. Data from the temperature sensor is transmitted securely to the blockchain for storage or smart contract execution. The proposed model ensures the authentication of medical products and traces their suitability at different environmental parameters.

articleTitle: Multi-Modalities Biometric Encryption to Secure Personal Data Offloading to the Cloud
abstract: Data security has remained a paramount concern for the last decade. Data security saw the introduction of biometric-based security methods. Single biometric-based security methods worked well, but the issue of biometric variability impacted these systems performance. On the other hand, multimodal biometric security systems are less affected by biometric variability than single biometric-based systems. Single biometric-based schemes have the inherent issue of a single point of failure. Multimodalities not only resolve the issue of single-point failure but also increase the reliability of the security scheme. Furthermore, the use of multimodalities enables us to use fixed and cancellable biometrics together to get the security benefits of both types of biometrics. Fixed biometrics offer high reliability; on the other hand, cancellable biometric modalities create a scope to generate different templates from the same biometric, which in terms allows to change the key in case the original key gets compromised. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for securing personal data using an encryption key derived using multi-modalities, which can be used to secure crucial personal data offloading to the cloud or storing at a local data center. Suggested approach has achieved Genuine Acceptance Rate (GAR) of 94% and Genuine Rejection Rate (GRR) of 96% which is better than the single biometric encryption.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Models for Predicting Top Goal Scorer and Goalkeeper Performance in Football
abstract: The use of football analytics has transformed how players are evaluated, strategies are developed, and recruitment processes are planned. Machine learning (ML) has become a vital tool in analyzing player performance, especially in identifying leading goal scorers and highly effective goalkeepers. This research focuses on understanding how team statistics influence goals and saves, examining not only individual player metrics but also the relationship between team attacks, team goals, and the impact of each player's threatening attacks on their goal-scoring output. Additionally, metrics related to goals conceded by the team were analyzed to establish any correlation with the number of saves made by goalkeepers. The study aims to predict the top goal scorer and the best goalkeeper using seven ML models: Random Forest, XG Boost, Linear Regression, K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Decision Trees, Support Vector Regression (SVR), and Gradient Boosting. Data was gathered through web scraping and API integration from five major leagues: La Liga, Bundesliga, Premier League, Ligue 1, and Serie A covering the seasons from 2017/2018 to 2022/2023. The models' performance was assessed using statistical measures like Mean Squared Error (MSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), R-Squared (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE). Findings indicate that XG Boost performed best for predicting goal scorers, while Linear Regression was most effective for forecasting goalkeeper saves. This research enhances decision-making for managers and analysts by providing data-driven insights that improve strategic planning and player evaluation.

articleTitle: Intelligent Bilingual Chatbot for Enhanced User Engagement on College Websites
abstract: The paper introduces an intelligent, bilingual chatbot specifically designed for the educational college website to streamline user interactions and provide instant assistance. It addresses a variety of queries, including admissions, courses, campus facilities, and events, through an intuitive and engaging interface. By facilitating bilingual interaction through support for English and Telugu, the chatbot ensures inclusivity across diverse audiences. Leveraging advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP), the chatbot accurately interprets inquiries and delivers context-aware responses. Additionally, it integrates with the college's systems to provide current and reliable information. Built with scalability in mind, the system can handle multiple user interactions simultaneously without compromising performance. The chatbot reduces response times and enhances accessibility by providing personalized, bilingual text and audio support tailored to individual needs. This initiative enhances the efficiency and engagement of the college website, making it a valuable tool for students, parents, faculty, and visitors.

articleTitle: Cost Effective Obstacle Detection Kit for Blind People
abstract: Around 1.3 billion people worldwide suffer from various types of vision impairments, and most of them encounter accidents due to obstacles they are unaware of. Most of the proposed solutions in this regard require a continuous network connection, are difficult to produce and design, require the user to carry a smartphone, and are costly. The present research aims to provide an effective, easy-to-use, and cost-efficient solution. The kit design primarily consists of ultrasonic sensors, an Arduino Uno processor, and micro-motors. Ultrasonic sensors were placed on the legs, hands, and cap of multiple users. As soon as obstacles entered the sensing range, signals were generated and sent to the Arduino Uno controller for processing. The Arduino Uno then processed the signals and used the micro-motors to create the vibratory output. The developed obstacle detection kit offers several advantages, including low cost, ease of adaptation and maintenance, a simple design, the utilization of the human body for an improved working range, and, most importantly, the ability to detect objects not only on the ground but also suspended ones.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Dual-Port MIMO Antenna for WLAN and n258 Bands with Flexible Configuration
abstract: This communication reports analysis of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{MIMO}_{\mathbf{WLAN}/\mathbf{n}\mathbf{258}}$</tex> antenna radiating Electromagnetic-Energy designed for Dual-Band operation including lower Microwave WLAN band and higher n258 mmWave bands for 5G applications. The radiating patch emitting EM-Waves includes etched-chamfered rectangular-patch and partial-ground plane responsible for achieving three resonance bands. The single port antenna offers bandwidth of 5.04GHz-7.72GHz (WLAN) and 25.24GHz-33.91GHz (n258) bands. The single-port also shows good impedance matching at 5.50GHz and 28.0GHz nearing to ideal values. The two-port <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{MIMO}_{\mathbf{WLAN}/\mathbf{n}\mathbf{258}}$</tex> antenna maintains the bandwidth achieved by single-port configuration offering maximum peak gain of 2.39dBi at 5.50GHz and 4.70dBi at 28.0GHz. The proposed <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{MIMO}_{\mathbf{WLAN}/\mathbf{n}\mathbf{258}}$</tex> antenna also maintains diversity-parameters within the standard values. The proposed work is capable of application in WLAN band and can be deployed in 5G infrastructure.

articleTitle: Boosting GAN Performance Through Dataset Augmentation with Denoising Diffusion Models
abstract: Image generation using generative models is a new and challenging task, especially when the available training dataset is limited in diversity and size. Generative AI models require a huge corpus of data for training effectively. Limited data can cause problems such as overfitting and poor generalization, making it difficult to generate images. To Address this challenge, this work explores an innovative approach to integrate Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic models (DDPMs) and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs).The aim of this work is to significantly enhance the quality and diversity of generated images by initially augmenting the training dataset and then utilizing the potential of GAN s for realistic image generation.In the proposed hybrid model, the DDPM acts as the initial step, performing data augmentation by generating additional samples.then the augmented dataset is passed through GAN. To optimize the model's performance, a careful analysis of varying augmentation ratios and training epochs was conducted. The Experimentation concluded that as the dataset size increases the models performance improved drastically on FID metric.On the CIFAR-I0 Dataset an 82.96% improvement was observed demonstrating the positive effect of augmentation. The findings highlight the effectiveness of combining diffusion-based data augmentation with GAN s in addressing challenges like limited data diversity and availability.

articleTitle: Garbage Detection System Using Image Processing
abstract: This research presents a brand new development system for garbage detection using advanced techniques in image processing. This system is primarily to identify and then classify the waste in real time, thus tackling waste management problems. This has been done using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and image preprocessing to achieve high accuracy in the detection of different waste types such as plastics, metals, and organics. The experimental results prove the model's robustness across diverse environments that make it amenable to large-scale deployment. The work is meant to serve municipalities, industries, and environmental organizations for automating the waste segregation process [1], [2]. The paper deliberates about some image processing techniques on edge detection, segmentation, and feature extraction since these form the basis for waste identification and classification types that rely on them. Integration of such methods into machine learning and deep learning algorithms, especially using convolutional neural networks (CNN), makes the process more accurate and robust in detection. Also discussed in the review are the pre-processing methods, such as noise reduction and contrast enhancement, which improve the quality of input data to achieve better detection results.

articleTitle: Network Coding for Scalable Genomic Data Transmission in Public Health Crises
abstract: Quick genomic data transfer acts as an essential tool that public health teams need during emergencies like the COVID-19 outbreak. Network coding stands as a technology evaluated for improving large-scale genomic data transmissions in distributed networks. The experimental results show that network coding leads to substantial improvement of transmission throughput through reduces times by 47.2% relative to other standard approaches. Network coding technology displays superior error resilience capability because it recovers 92.3% of data at 10% error rate when compared to normal transmission methods which recover only 65.4%. The introduction of slight computational workloads provides high data integrity protection by maintaining reconstruction accuracy above 98.4% and achieving complete integrity for both small and large datasets. The utilization rate of networks can reach 89.5% across multiple server environments. The study demonstrates how network coding technology optimizes genetic data sharing processes by delivering quicker and more resilient and expandable information distribution for genomic research along with public health intervention programs.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition Using a Hybrid Model of Transformer and CNN-LSTM for Improved Performance
abstract: Emotion recognition is a crucial aspect of AI technology that fills in the gap of human-machine interaction, allowing systems to react to human emotions effectively. The traditional models often struggle with precision and robustness when it comes to noisy data along with the complexity of analyzing human emotions. This paper proposes a hybrid model architecture by combining the Transformer model and CNN-LSTMs in order to maximize emotion recognition. The Transformer module captures input data's long-range dependencies, whereas the CNN-LSTM architecture extracts spatial and temporal features from voice signals, with potential extension to multimodal inputs such as facial expressions and physiological data. This work shows the capability of advanced hybrid architecture in developing emotionally intelligent systems in healthcare, education, customer service, and other applications. The findings pave the way for future work on multimodal data integration and generalization in complicated environments.

articleTitle: Advancements in Drug Discovery Through Machine and Deep Learning Concepts in Early-Stage of Drug Discovery for Apoptosis
abstract: Within the rapidly shifting field of drug discovery, ML and DL techniques have opened new directions for identifying potential therapeutic compounds with higher efficiency and accuracy. The present work explores the integration of ML and DL algorithms for drug discovery in apoptosis, by utilizing PaDEL and Lipinski descriptors for feature extraction. PaDEL is widely used open-source software that helps in generating the molecular descriptors and fingerprints of a chemical compound while Lipinski's descriptors depend on the “Rule of Five” which explores critical analysis of drug-likeness of molecules. The present article provides a comparative analysis of different ML and DL algorithms which include SVM, RF, GBM, KNN, ANN, and GNN. The performance of each one is evaluated based on key metrics such as adjustment of r2 score and mean square error. This presented work shall help in predicting the chemical compounds at the early stage of drug discovery using the QSAR method. Computed results are depicted graphically.

articleTitle: Blockchain Integrated Cloud Architecture for Surveillance Systems
abstract: The speedy growth of data-pushed programs, especially in surveillance and IoT systems, has underscored the need for steady, green, and privateness-retaining records control answers. While cloud computing gives scalability, it poses sizeable safety risks, making it liable to records breaches and unauthorized access. Blockchain technology, with its decentralized and immutable ledger, offers promising answers to these challenges, yet it struggles with scalability and computational demands while implemented to high-frequency, actual-time applications. This research paper proposes an technique to address those limitations through an integration of blockchain generation with cloudprimarily based surveillance systems. Through a hybrid version of selective storage and optimized consensus mechanisms, the proposed solution addresses the demanding situations of latency, scalability, and privacy maintenance at the same time while enhancing real-time access control.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Efficiency in Water-Meter Monitoring System using Neural Networking
abstract: This paper presents a water meter monitoring system enhanced by deep learning techniques such as Artificial Neural Networks(ANN) and Residual Networks(ResNet). Accurate readings of the water meters are essential for effective billing and resource management; but the limitations of traditional analog meters and previous computational methods include precision, scalability, and adaptability. The implementation of deep learning techniques has enabled the system to improve its ability to extract features and classify them with improved accuracy, resulting in a test accuracy of 99.17%. Additionally, High dynamic range (HDR) imaging and color-invariant edge detection are briefly studied upon in order to address the challenges associated with inconsistent lighting and varying environments causing gradient errors. The proposed model utilizes transfer learning from pretrained networks and datasets, optimizing for smaller datasets, and enhancing performance.

articleTitle: Implementation of Emotion Based Multifaceted Recommendation System
abstract: In recent years, human emotion has become extremely important. Emotion communicates a person's distinctive behaviors, which can take many various forms. This paper, proposed an algorithm to identify emotions based on hand gestures and facial features of people and recommended books, music and quote based on the emotions found. The data collection and dataset using libraries such as numpy, media pipe, and cv2 for emotion identification. Pygame & Tkinter are used to provide music recommendations. Quote and books Api are used to provide the book and quote recommendation. A device like internal camera is used to record hand gestures and facial expressions. On the input face photos, feature extraction is done to identify emotions including happiness, rage, sadness, surprise, etc. The computational time required to produce the findings and the overall cost of the system are both likely to be reduced by our proposed approach, boosting the system's overall accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Business Safety and Security Through Next Gen Fraud by Generating OTP
abstract: Digital transactions have recently seen dramatic expansion which requires social resolution of their basic security requirements. One-time passwords serve as an authentication method to shield systems against fraud yet attackers find weaknesses that cause financial damages to users. Traditional defensive measures prove ineffective against the present-day threats which combine OTP interception with SIM swapping while also including phishing activities. This document consists of an advanced fraud detection mechanism to stop OTP security threats effectively. Real-time security systems work as predictive protectors through threat monitoring networks linked with authorization procedures which construct protected data defenses. A new implementation system will install advanced transaction security methods which prevent unapproved access together with fraudulent activities

articleTitle: Optimized Ensembled Model for Patient Treatment Using Machine Learning Techniques
abstract: The accurate prediction of whether a patient will require in-care or out-care treatment is a critical challenge in the healthcare industry, the use of machine learning algorithms has become increasingly prevalent in healthcare, here aim is to explore the various machine learning algorithms that have been used for determining whether a patient should receive in-care or out-care treatment. A comprehensive review of the literature has been conducted to identify and summarize the ML algorithms that have been used for this purpose, such as logistic regression, decision trees, support vector machines, random forests, and our proposed ensemble model. Our ensemble model is developed by the ensemble of predictions by Sequential Minimal Optimization and Random Forest that ultimately aids in better accuracy, precision, and recall, We have found that this ensemble model always yield good results compared to an individual model. These ensemble models proved fantastic for all sorts of applications, which demonstrate the great potential of enhancing accuracy and the robustness of prediction that could well help in saving many lives.

articleTitle: Review of IoT-Enabled Crop Recommendation Model and Soil Nutrient Analysis for Precision Agriculture
abstract: Smart Agriculture, facilitated by the IoT, leads to precision farming, a practice known as precision agriculture. By precisely measuring soil properties including moisture, temperature, humidity, pH, and fertility and nutrition content, the combination of IoT technology with soil monitoring improves agricultural productivity. The collected information is kept on the cloud, allowing for effective data operations that enable the optimization of farming strategies and the creation of trend analyses. This, in turn, enables the precise utilization of resources and the implementation of farming methods in a strategic manner to maximize crop production. A micro controller with WiFi connection and cloud based storage would be at the heart of the proposed Internet of Things system, which also includes pH, humidity, temperature, soil moisture, and soil nutrient (NPK) probes. After installation, these sensors take readings of targeted parameters and send them to a server in the cloud along with a timestamp. Together, these sensors supply analysts a wealth of data. To assist in crop selection based on soil data and enhance growth through optimized farming processes, a recommending system using the Decision Tree algorithm is proposed.

articleTitle: Stock Market Prediction Using Meta-Learning and Few-Shot Learning
abstract: Stock market predicting is a difficult because of its constant fluctuations and intricate nature. Traditional machine learning models typically rely on extensive labelled data to effectively capture market trends and generate precise predictions. So this approach is not suitable when faced with unfamiliar market conditions, where historical data is scarce or non-existent. To solve this problem, we have to develop meta-learning and few-shot learning methods. These methods show great potential for improving the ability of models to generalize from limited data.By meta-learning it is possible to predict price movements, volatility forecasting, or trend analysis, without the need for extensive retraining. For this purpose we use the frameworks model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) and Siamese networks. This paper examines usage of Meta-Learning and Few-Shot learning method for predicting stock market trends, emphasizing their capacity to effectively handle limited data and adapt to changing market dynamics. We also explore the possibilities of this approach to enhance the accuracy, resilience, and adaptability of financial modelling.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning Sentiment Analysis to Evaluate Students Learning Impact
abstract: For educational experiences and results to be improved, learning impact assessment is essential. Students' emotional reactions, which are crucial to their involvement and understanding, are frequently missed by traditional evaluation techniques. Through a review of student feedback, conversations, and course ratings, this study investigates the use of machine learning-based sentiment analysis to assess the impact of learning. Performance evaluations were conducted on a number of sentiment categorization models, including Naïve Bayes, Support Vector Machines (SVM), Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and BERT. With an accuracy of 91.7%, the results show that BERT performs better than other models and offers more accurate sentiment classification. Accuracy and insights are further improved by combining textual, auditory, and visual signals in multi-modal sentiment analysis. The results show how sentiment analysis may be used to track feedback in real time facilitating adaptive learning techniques to raise student interest. Future studies should concentrate on expanding sentiment analysis applications to traditional and hybrid learning contexts, integrating multi-modal data, and ethical implications.

articleTitle: HerPal: An AI-Driven Platform for Enhanced Menstrual Hygiene Management and Period Assistance
abstract: The term menstrual hygiene management (MHM) continues to be a challenge for many women especially in rural areas. According to a survey conducted among 184 women in India ranging between the age 18–22, it was revealed that around 72.8 per cent of women experience stress during menstruation, more than 45 per cent of them have lack of knowledge regarding menstrual hygiene and hygiene related products, only 65 per cent of them wear sanitary pads and 57.6 per cent of women face disrespect due to menstruation. This is a need of the hour to find solutions to help women overcome the problem related to menstrual hygiene. This paper brings a solution to how artificial intelligence can be designed to help women understand more about the problems related to menstruation and recommend them safe to use products like sanitary pads, menstrual cups, tampons etc.

articleTitle: Combating Counterfeit Drugs with Blockchain in the Healthcare Supply Chain
abstract: The Primary goal of a drug traceability framework is to track the path of medications across the supply chain, ensuring that both their origin and final destination are accurately recorded. This is crucial for safeguarding public health and maintaining the operational efficiency of pharmaceutical companies. Current centralized systems based on server-client models have limitations regarding data security, privacy, resilience, and scalability. To address these concerns, we propose a blockchain-based approach that offers enhanced security and scalability. The solution also integrates storage optimization mechanisms, making the blockchain more practical for long-term applications.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation: Synthetic Image Generation for Medical Images Using Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoders
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has revolutionized medical imaging, significantly improving diagnostic accuracy via the evaluation of X-rays, MRIs, and CT scans. However, the effectiveness of AI models is hindered due to high costs, privacy concerns, and challenges in acquiring large annotated datasets. Artificial data generation techniques, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), and hybrid models like Disc-VAE, have gained prominence in dealing with these barriers. These techniques aim to augment datasets while preserving the complicated capabilities inherent to medical images. This paper compares the efficacy of Vector Quantized VAE with GAN and Disc-VAE using metrics Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR). The Vector Quantized VAE outperforms GAN and Disc-VAE in terms of SSIM and PSNR metrics. The findings spotlight the transformative capability of synthetic information augmentation for the medical system by enabling early and accurate disease diagnosis. These improved SSIM and PSNR metrics suggest that the generated images preserve essential diagnostic details, thereby enhancing the potential for early and accurate clinical diagnosis. It guarantees advanced performance and robustness of AI models, facilitating timely intervention and improved patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security in Software-Defined Networks: Hybrid Deep Learning Models for Flooding Attack Detection
abstract: Software-Defined Networking (SDN) enhances flex-ibility and centralizes network traffic management, but it also introduces new security challenges, particularly from flooding attacks such as TCP and UDP floods. These attacks can over-whelm network resources, leading to performance degradation or service disruption. This research presents a novel hybrid deep learning approach for detecting flooding threats in SDN utilizing an imbalanced dataset. Balancing is crucial in imbalanced datasets as it reduces bias towards the majority class, allowing the model to reliably detect attacks from minority classes. We have addressed class imbalance through the application of inverse proportional sampling. Our model employs a hybrid methodology combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to proficiently analyze network traffic and identify malicious flooding activities. The proposed model adeptly tackles the temporal dynamics of flooding attacks by utilizing CNN for feature extraction and LSTM for sequence modeling. This research presents real-time threat detection, enhancing SDN security. Our research indicates that the hybrid deep learning model accurately detects flooding-based denial of service attacks and generalizes effectively across various flooding scenarios, positioning it as a promising solution for the defense of SDN networks.

articleTitle: Wildlife Conservation Using Image Recognition with Artificial Intelligence
abstract: The sustainable development goal provided by United Nation says about 17 major development points and one of which contains to improve safety of wildlife animals and resources for the future. As there is development in human community there is rise in wildlife damage and also the surge in extinction of Unique wildlife animals. The united nation also acknowledges that problem through its development goals (SDG 13, SDG I5) to end theft of wildlife resources and maintain its biodiversity. Along with this image recognition with AI (SDG 9), there are lots of ways to enhance the current technology can do hours of works in milliseconds. moreover, adding AI algorithms can detect animals and human much precisely. Firstly, the camera traps capture an image and with AI algorithm, any object or species can be identifying and with IOT devices, authority can directly gather information on that particular problem. AI plays a crucial role in predicting future condition of an area using deep learning algorithms, that can help in preserving forest biodiversity. On the basis of several studies and analysis, this paper consists of several suggestions on various development and future scopes that can increase safety of wildlife ecosystem. This paper has depicted the advancement of the technology that are being used in many areas for monitoring by provided informative data from IOT devices. Additionally, image recognition algorithms perform a promising role in research with greater accuracy and real time conservation of that data into statical reports.

articleTitle: Enhancing Farm Security System with AI-Power-Driven Animal Intrusion Detection Mechanism
abstract: Growing need for effective farm security solutions drives the development of the “Animal Intrusion Detection in Farms” system. This paper aims to identify and inform farmers about animal invasions in order to increase agricultural area security. Making use of OpenCV, the system uses computer vision techniques to identify animals crossing the farm boundaries. Setting alarms should a trespass be discovered since the system scans images to identify animals using real-time video data acquired by cameras all around the farm. Then, supplied these alarms via notifications, farm owners may react quickly. By automating the monitoring process, the method drastically reduces human participation and protects valuable crops and cattle against animal damage. The solution helps to improve farm security by combining real-time notifications, automated detection, and accurate animal recognition. Modern farm security focusses on OpenCV and deep learning models since they promise significant accuracy in detection, even under various environmental conditions, thereby offering a consistent and scalable solution.

articleTitle: AI-Augmented Bioprinting: Revolutionizing Organ Transplantation and Regenerative Medicine
abstract: The landscape of organ transplantation and regenerative medicine is changing with the augmentation of bioprinting by artificial intelligence. The target of this review will be to consider the synergy between AI and bioprinting-from how AI enhances the accuracy, efficiency, and functionality of 3D-printed organs and tissues to its capabilities in improving implant design. In this endeavour to design optimal bioprinting processes along with scaffold design, and most importantly, quality control, AI technologies, which would include machine learning algorithms and predictive modelling, would be important. Promising solutions for the global shortage of organs will come through these developments and make it less dependent on donors, thereby improving results for regenerative therapies. Ethical and regulatory challenges accompany technology-related challenges. Despite these challenges, full of hope is the future of AI-driven bioprinting with numerous research focuses going on to overcome these challenges and further strengthen AI with other emerging technologies. The purpose of this review is to emphasize the need for interdisciplinarity to fully unleash the transformative power of AI in the context of regenerative medicine and organ transplantation.

articleTitle: Flexi-Fit: AI-Based Fitness Tracker
abstract: This paper introduces a personalized AI-based fitness tracker that provides dynamic diet and workout recommendations using the MERN stack, Llama 3 for natural language processing (NLP), and Hugging Face for machine learning. The tracker collects user-specific data such as dietary preferences, physical activity, and fitness goals to provide tailored suggestions. The NLP engine enables conversational interaction with users, making the system more intuitive and accessible. By integrating AI-powered insights and real-time data analysis, the system adapts to the user's progress and adjusts recommendations accordingly. This paper presents the architecture, methodology, and advantages of using such a system in a health and fitness context, demonstrating its potential to improve user fitness outcomes through precise interventions.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of ML Algorithms for Detecting Intrusion Using the NSL-KDD Dataset
abstract: With the advent of computer networks, it has become very convenient to communicate, share and collaborate with others in a short time. All the online services depend on computer networks. With the rise of computer networks there is a increase in threats of cyberattacks. Intrusion by an attacker is very common which can put the whole network at risk. Thus Intrusion detection has become very important today. There are several traditioanl methods which can indetify the intrusion. This study focuses on the use of Machine Learning to detect intrusion. Several machine learning models are trained on the NSL-KDD dataset from Kaggle. This dataset contains several factors which can result in intrusion. These factors are input to Machine Learning model to make prediction about any attack in the network. A correlation analysis of these factors is also done to identify the relationships among these factors. The performance of several Machine Learning algorithms are analysed based on several parameters and the best model is determined.

articleTitle: A Novel Multi-Classification Approach for Drugs Based on ANN and Other ML Algorithms with Hyper Parameter Tuning
abstract: In the realm of pharmaceutical research and development, accurate classification of drugs is of paramount importance for effective therapeutic interventions. This paper proposes a novel approach to drug classification utilizing a combination of Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) algorithms. By harnessing the power of ANN's ability to learn complex patterns and ML's versatility in handling diverse datasets, our approach aims to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of drug classification tasks. Furthermore, we incorporate hyper parameter tuning techniques to optimize model performance, thereby maximizing predictive capabilities. Through comprehensive experimentation and evaluation on real-world drug datasets, our proposed methodology demonstrates promising results, showcasing superior classification accuracy compared to traditional methods. This research advances drug discovery and development by providing a robust framework for accurate drug classification in biomedical and pharmaceutical fields. In this study we have applied ten ML technique: Logistic Regression, Decision tree, Random forest, Catboost classifier, Adaboost classifier, Ensemble classifier, Gradient boosting classifier, LGBM classifier, Soft voting classifier, ANN with hyper parameter tuning and Support vector machine on the drugs classification dataset. The evaluation of classification outcomes was conducted both with and without the implementation of hyper parameter tuning. Notably, upon applying hyper parameter tuning, the ANN classifier emerged as the top performer, surpassing all other classifiers. RFC and DTC have also attained good accuracy of 96%. Impressively, ANN attained an accuracy rate of 99.29%, showcasing its superior performance in the dataset.

articleTitle: Smart Helmet: A Comprehensive Solution for Rider Safety
abstract: Smart helmets: The merging of the conventional head- gears for the protection of one's head, with modern technology, may be said to be one of the breakthroughs in the motorcycling, cycling, construction, and emergency services industries. This paper deals with the history, components, applications, and advantages of smart helmets, showing how these impact user safety and connectivity in a wide context. This paper involves a feasibility study and problem statement for a project using smart helmet technology to integrate solutions with the prevalent social problems. The research focuses on three systems, including helmet recognition and reminders, emergency message sending, drowsiness detection. The article argues that each of these systems contributes in bringing about road safety, providing emergency help, and safe distance in drowsy riding. Smart helmets integrate cutting edge technology with the inclusion of sensors and communication systems thus giving the wearers much situational awareness with proactive safety measures. Through this research, it brings out the importance of smart helmets in preventing losses while outlining the construction of a safer connected future.

articleTitle: AI Driven Waste Classification for Smart Recycling
abstract: Having advanced technologies is critical to optimize the efficiency of sorting, as global waste generation continues to increase. This study categorizes waste types (plastic, glass, metal, organic, and hazardous waste) - the VGG16 architecture, a type of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), is commonly utilized for image classification on images of discarded substances, which in turn minimizes human error, lowers labor costs, and improves retrieval efficiency. Furthermore, there are IoT deep learning applications that can be used on the internet, which enable real-time access to data for monitoring and collecting, offer insights into waste disposal patterns. These technologies help address urban waste challenges by improving recy-cling rates, minimizing landfill usage, and advocating for sustainable waste management options. This study focuses on deep learning frameworks for waste categorization, data collection obstacles, and their relevance in urban waste management, highlighting the use of AI in propelling for-ward environmental sustainability and resource recovery. This study utilizes data up to October 2023 to train the model.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for Pose Based Human Activity Recognition
abstract: Activity recognition is the task of identifying human actions and physical activities. It can have applications in broad areas including medical, sports and fitness, healthcare, behaviour analysis and security. Activity recognition is a widely sought after area of research in both Machine Learning (ML) and smart devices. The activity recognition plays an important role in the field of machine learning. There are several machine learning techniques which can be applied for pose based activity recognition. These techniques involve training machine learning models for the dataset. The dataset is obtained by using OpenPose framework. This framework provides keypoints from an input image. These keypoints represent the raw data determining the pose of a human. The machine learning model can predict the pose after training on the dataset. models

articleTitle: Advancements in Machine Learning for Predictive Modeling of Genetic Disorders
abstract: Detecting and understanding gene patterns before the onset of genetic diseases holds immense promise for prevention. This paper discusses the current state of machine learning techniques available for the disease diagnosis problem, focusing on existing approaches, their analysis, and possible future work. Machine learning algorithms can process large amounts of genetic information such as DNA sequences, gene expression data, and images to identify and recognize patterns that could be useful in predicting disease risk or its progression. In this regard, the paper also focuses on a sequence comparison method using protein-level similarity, leveraging codon-based translation from DNA to protein sequences to calculate similarity indices between a test sequence and multiple disease related sequences.
