The test results show that the 3BPOA algorithm has good performance in low dimensions and quite good in medium dimensions. In high dimensions, if using a large population, 3BPOA has good potential.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Deep Learning Techniques for Lung Disease Diagnostic
abstract: respiratory diseases are one of the major causes of death globally; thus, accurate and timely diagnosis is critical. Recent advances in deep learning approaches have demonstrated comprehensive capability in predicting lung pathologies by leveraging heterogeneous data such as images, sounds or clinical data. This work discusses the use of various deep learning methods, such as CNN, RNN and transfer learning, to enhance diagnostic accuracy and efficiency. Alongside, a few key hurdles, such as data quality, interpretability, bias, and computation needs, are discussed as well as potential solutions - data augmentation, federated learning, and the development of explainable AI models. Deep learning is exhibiting a transformative role in the future of healthcare, and this work shows promise for facilitating innovation which could thwart the global burden of lung diseases.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Optimizers on Convolutional Neural Network for Lung Cancer Classification Using CT Scan Images
abstract: As a potentially fatal condition, lung cancer requires immediate medical attention. In particular, with imaging methods such as Computed Tomography scan imaging, early diagnosis at the early stage has the potential to save lives. To improve the accuracy of lung cancer classification, this study compares and evaluates several optimization algorithms, such as SGD, Adam, RMSprop, and AdaDelta. The goal is to determine how different optimizers affect the performance of CNN. The dataset utilized in this study was sourced from Kaggle. It included 5,958 CT scan pictures processed using a CNN model and divided into four classes: Adenocarcinoma, Squamous Cell Carcinoma, Normal and Large Cell Carcinoma. According to the trial data, the Adam optimizer had the highest accuracy, 72.22%, outperforming other optimization methods. This study contributes to advancements in AI for medical imaging, demonstrating that optimizer selection plays a crucial role in CNN-based lung cancer classification. The findings provide valuable insights for developing AI-assisted diagnostic tools to improve early lung cancer detection.

articleTitle: Decoding Social Media Sentiments with BERT-SA: A Deep Learning Perspective
abstract: The interpretation of textual information including opinions and emotions on Twitter strongly depends on sentiment analysis capabilities. This study employs a transformer-based model, BERT-SA (Bidi- rectional Encoder Representations from Transformers with Self-Attention for Sentiment Analysis), to classify tweets into four sentiment categories: irrelevant, neutral, positive, and negative. The process begins with preparing the text data and splitting it into tokens. The BERT tokenizer is then used to process the text before fine- tuning the transformer model for sentiment classification. The model is trained and evaluated on specialized Twitter datasets, demonstrating its ability to interpret text patterns within the unique context of social media. The BERT model's performance is assessed through precise metrics and category-based measurements. The outcomes of the research demonstrate that the BERT model is well-suited for sentiment analysis tasks, laying the foundational groundwork for real-world applications such as social media sentiment tracking and opinion mining, while utilizing advanced NLP techniques.

articleTitle: Improving Safety on the Internet: A New Multimodal Framework for Hateful Meme Classification
abstract: In the fast-changing social media world, a significant mode of communication carrying complex concepts and feelings has materialized: the manufacture of memes. It welcomes bad memes such as hatred, stereotypes, and misinformation, but many memes also have positive values for discussion. This paper directly addresses the challenge of detecting hateful memes. It leverages the “Facebook hateful meme dataset”, Kaggle, 2020 by Facebook AI, a hand-curated dataset, for conducting innovative model training to detect and mitigate the spread of hateful content. Our dataset analyzes multimodal representations of hate speech in memes, integrating both text and images for classification. The results are encouraging with the implementation of advanced neural network architectures, such as convolutional networks for image annotation and recurrent networks called text-data modelling. The implications of this paper extend beyond detection. This is a significant step in combating the spread of hateful content and ensuring a safer online space. Ultimately, this work benefits the larger natural language processing and computer vision community, making an argument necessary for interdisciplinary computational treatment of the intricacies of online hate.

articleTitle: Leo: Personal Desktop Assistant Using Python
abstract: Personal assistants or the desktop assistant have proven to be very useful in daily life as they made our work easier. If the user wants to perform some action without using their hands, they can just call out the assistant to do so by speaking which would then be converted into speech via python speech recognition module. The assistant can perform the tasks for which it was designed so like they can help you message someone in WhatsApp or play some YouTube video. If you want to take the screenshot of any page you can give command to the assistant to do it, and the assistant will work accordingly. These used to work on deep learning. They are getting advanced day by day by learning like the humans through machine learning and in future it would turn out to respond to as like the humans will respond. Alternatively, they may say, “Tell me latest news,” and the assistant would tell it, or “Play my favourite songs,” and the music would begin playing. Despite their easiness, many people overlook the complexities of their operation. Virtual assistants are driven by AI, which allows them to understand natural language, whether spoken or written, and perform tasks according to it. In this project, we are using Python to construct a voice assistant.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach to Classify Depression and Anxiety
abstract: A person's mood and overall health are significantly affected by psychological disorders like anxiety and depression. Since anxiety and depression have many symptoms in shared, distinguishing between them is the main issue. By employing a dataset of numerical replies, this work seeks to solve this problem by pinpointing the most important characteristics necessary for accurate classification. The dataset comprises 4184 individuals diagnosed by the French university and focuses on people aged 18 and over. SMOTE, which stands for Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique, has been used to solve the problem of class imbalance, as there were more people in the study population with no disorder. Random Forest feature selection found these 10 most relevant attributes to symptoms of anxiety and depression. The classification then proceeded with the supervised machine learning model, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Random Forest, and Support Vector Machine (SVM). This was done by applying the 10-fold cross-validation method to achieve consistent and trustworthy results. Random Forest showed the highest performance among the others, thus being the best method to differentiate between depression and anxiety.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Disease Risk Assessment Using Hybrid Machine Learning Model
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVD) are the leading reasons of the death globally, posing significant health risks. Accurate risk assessment is crucial for early intervention and prevention. This paper is about exploring a machine learning (ML) based approach for the estimating CVD risk using many clinical parameters like age of the person, person's blood pressure (BP), cholesterol levels, smoking habits and ECG signals. The model then classifies individuals into low, moderate and high-risk groups providing risk prediction of about 10 years. Established ML models like naive bayes and random forest along with the feature selection techniques. Performance comparison shows that neural networks outperform the other models by achieving 97% accuracy. This model aims to assist doctors in early diagnosis, thereby improving patient outcomes and reducing the incidence of CVD.

articleTitle: Transforming Agriculture with AgriConnect Using Machine Learning: A Comprehensive Analysis
abstract: AgriConnect is an innovative digital platform designed to revolutionize agricultural supply chain management by eliminating intermediaries and enabling direct farmer-to-consumer transactions. Unlike conventional agricultural marketplaces, AgriConnect integrates blockchain for traceability, AI-driven demand forecasting, and real-time chat assistance to enhance efficiency, transparency, and user engagement. By removing middlemen, the platform reduces costs, ensures fair pricing for farmers, and promotes sustainable agricultural practices. Additionally, AgriConnect fosters a community-driven approach by providing a dedicated space for farmer queries and knowledge sharing. The system also incorporates an optimized delivery network, minimizing carbon emissions and ensuring prompt distribution. With its focus on efficiency, sustainability, and digital transformation, AgriConnect represents a significant advancement in modernizing the agricultural industry.

articleTitle: Hybrid CNN-SVM Framework for Rice Leaf Disease Detection to Promote Sustainable Agriculture
abstract: Rice is one of the most significant crops and a key factor in ensuring the safety of food around the world. On the other hand, rice supply may be threatened by a number of diseases that harm the plant's various sections, particularly the leaves. Rice Neck Blast, Rice Leaf Blast, Rice Brown Spot, Rice Blast, Brown Spot, Sheath Blight, Bacterial Stripe, and False Smut in rice leaves are common illnesses that affect rice leaves. Depending on the disease, damaged plant tissues each class's accuracy, which ranges from 0.97 to 0.98, is good. Safe nutrition & sustained rice production can employ a variety of strategies, including natural control methods, insecticides, tolerant crops, and agricultural practices. Early diagnosis of rice leaf diseases is a major worry for the farming community, and the Nikon D5300 and Realme XT, which are outfitted with deep computing techniques like convolutional neural networks (CNN) and Support Vector Machines (SVM), can detect them with high accuracy

articleTitle: Optimized VGG16 Model for Pneumonia Detection from Chest X-Rays
abstract: Pneumonia is a serious and potentially life-threatening illness that requires prompt and accurate diagnosis to circumvent the dangers of serious complications. classic methods of diagnostics such as X-rays of the chest blood tests, and physical exams. Commonly Utilized Yet Challenged Methods. These methods are commonly utilized, but come with challenges Slow, error-prone, specialized knowledge-requiring. The model that we are using is VGG chest X-ray pictures for the extraction of vital lung features. After the preprocessing of images, VGG16 model was trained with these images. The proposed model achieved impressive accuracy of 93.5% shows its robustness and capacity to manage varied cases of lung illnesses. This high accuracy implies model as a dependable tool for healthcare professionals who help diagnose pneumonia More quickly and more accurately, while reducing the risk of human error. The outcomes demonstrate that VGG16 model has reached a striking 93.5% accuracy which shows its robustness and its ability to handle various cases of lung diseases. This high accuracy implies that the model might be a dependable instrument for health care providers. It can assist in diagnosing pneumonia with greater swiftness and correctness. Besides, it reduces the probability of human error. The technique is cost-effective. Therefore, it is affordable for health care systems. Technology can also enhance the decision-making process. Consequently, the patients' outcomes will become better. The early recognition of pneumonia is crucial. It may affect the potential for successful treatment. The results of the study suggest that AI-assisted diagnostic systems have great potential. This points to the necessity of further research. It is crucial for refining the technologies of disease screening.

articleTitle: Leveraging Hybrid Ensemble Framework for Diabetes Prediction: Integrating Random Forest, ANN, ETC, and Stack-CNN
abstract: Mellitus (DM), or diabetes, is a dominant universal medical affair dilemma harming a growing number of people around the world and putting them at severe risk. Diabetes is a long-lasting affliction that leads to a high annual mortality rate. Diagnosing diabetes initially is crucial to limit its growth and reduce the risk of serious kidney disease and eye disease. This paper recommends using an ensemble hybrid framework for a high-accuracy DM prediction. In this paper, a hybrid ensemble framework blends ML and DL the machine and deep learning structures with an ensemble learning-based stacking model to improve diabetes prediction. The Diabetes Dataset from the Frankfurt Hospital Germany (DDFH-G) trains the hybrid model. The conduct of the recommended model was assessed based on numerous parameters like accuracy, precision, specificity, sensitivity, ROC/AUC, F-score, and Matthews Correlation Coefficient. The recommended hybrid framework with stack-CNN achieves excellent performance with a 99.24% accuracy rate in testing the Diabetes Dataset from Frankfurt Hospital (DDFH-G). The results show that the recommended hybrid framework outperformed previous studies on independent machine and deep learning structures in the earliest diabetes screening.

articleTitle: Efficient and Accurate Brain Tumor Diagnosis: A CNN Approach for MRI Image Classification
abstract: This study uses CNN to detect and classify brain tumors from MRI data automatically. Due to tumor diversity and location, brain tumor diagnosis is difficult. Diagnostics are slow, subjective, and require expertise. This automated approach aims to address these limitations. The proposed model significantly improves diagnostic accuracy and efficiency, achieving a classification accuracy of 99.32%. By providing fast and reliable results, the system supports health care professionals in making informed clinical decisions and optimizes resource utilization for precise and timely patient care.

articleTitle: Deceptive Opinion Detection Using Stacking-Based Deep Ensemble Learning
abstract: The widespread reliance on online reviews in e-commerce and social platforms has led to an increase in deceptive opinions, commonly called fake reviews or opinion spam. These reviews manipulate consumer perceptions, impacting purchasing decisions, brand credibility, and platform trustworthiness. Detecting fake reviews is challenging due to their human-like writing style, evolving deceptive tactics, and the scarcity of well-annotated datasets. Traditional machine learning models, such as Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Naive Bayes, struggle to achieve high accuracy. In contrast, deep learning models like CNN and LSTM perform better but still face limitations in capturing diverse deceptive patterns. This study proposes a stacking-based deep ensemble learning model that integrates Simple Flatten, CNN, LSTM, and BiLSTM as base classifiers with a logistic regression meta-learner for improved classification performance. Evaluated on the Amazon fake review dataset, the proposed model achieves an accuracy of 90.04%, outperforming individual deep learning models such as BiLSTM (87.13.00%), LSTM (86.10%), CNN (83.11%) and MLP (80.00<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>). This will provide a more reliable and scalable solution for online platforms to detect deceptive opinions.

articleTitle: Hybrid Legal Clause Classification: Integrating Supervised BERT with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Detecting ambiguity or classifying as clear or vague is a crucial yet important task in legal document analysis, which often requires human feedback. This research involves a unique approach by integrating supervised Machine Learning with Reinforcement Learning for automatic legal clause classification. This work proposes a goal to develop a system which is able to accurately identify ambiguity in legal documents by pre-trained BERT embed dings and dynamic learning methods. The initial part of the system is trained using labeled data that predicts the clause as ambiguous or non-ambiguous. This model uses BERT for clause representation. The latter part of the system inculcates Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithm such as Q-Learning to interact with the environment created by legal dataset. The agent used in implementation of Reinforcement learning learns to classify clauses by receiving rewards as feedback. After multiple training episodes of RL agent, it dynamically improves its decision making by maximizing cumulative reward. This integrated system of Supervised Machine Learning and Reinforcement Learning helps the system to handle situations with well-labeled datasets and environments with available feedback but limited direct supervision. The proposed model showcases the potential of the integrated system for legal document analysis and scalable solution for clause classification task.

articleTitle: Image Super-Resolution Using GAN Based Vision Transformer
abstract: The goal of image super-resolution is to create a high-resolution image from a low-resolution one. Deep learning has significantly advanced this task, enabling the generation of high-quality images. However, the increasing complexity of neural networks leads to greater computational and memory demands, posing challenges for efficiency and real-time applications. It remains an active field with the potential to overcome many applications' resolution constraints. Transformers' strong self-attention mechanism has allowed it to achieve notable advancements in computer vision challenges in recent years. Due to the high computational demands of transformers, there are currently no widely adopted vision transformer networks designed explicitly for highly high-resolution images. This remains a challenge in current research. We suggested a comprehensive vision transformer-based GAN network to solve this issue. This network has two types of transformer networks: transformer discriminator and transformer generator. In order to produce 2x and 4x resolution images using image patches as input, we present the innovative Transformer Encoder Generator module. It can gradually reduce GPU memory usage and achieve excellent resolution.

articleTitle: Advancing Brain Tumor Detection in MRI Images Using Convolutional Neural Networks and Deep Learning Techniques
abstract: Brain cancer remains a major health challenge, particularly in constraint-driven settings like India, where it is the 10th leading cause of cancer-related deaths. Early detection is vital to improving treatment outcomes, yet traditional methods relying on manual MRI interpretation can be time taking, expensive, and highly susceptible to error. This study is presenting a deep learning based approach which is using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The proposed system uses advanced data preprocessing techniques, including Z-score normalization, skull stripping, and augmentation, to optimize MRI datasets. A robust CNN model was developed and trained on a diverse dataset comprising glioma, meningioma, pituitary, and non-tumor cases. This model achieved exceptional performance, with training, validation, and test accuracies of 99.95%, 99.8%, and 99.3%, respectively, along with high accuracy, recall, and F1 points. Evaluation metrics such as ROC-AUC and confusion matrix analysis showcased the model's accuracy in differentiating tumour types and stages.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model for Automated Classification and Condition Assessment of Indian Currency Notes
abstract: VeriTrust is a cutting-edge deep learning framework designed to improve financial safety through the automation of detecting currency denominations and assessing the condition of banknotes. It addresses the issue of damaged notes in circulation by processing images through steps like acquisition, edge detection, segmentation, and feature extraction. These features are analyzed using a custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to categorize notes as damaged or fit for use, ensuring that compromised notes are efficiently filtered out. Initially developed with TensorFlow and Keras, employing the Adam optimizer alongside binary cross-entropy loss, VeriTrust achieved commendable 93% precision. Recent improvements include the integration of PyTorch-based CNN and Grad-CAM-based CNN models, which achieved accuracies of 93% and 84%, respectively. This paper outlines the VeriTrust pipeline, its CNN architecture, and its potential to strengthen transaction security, while also highlighting future plans to improve accuracy and broaden its applications.

articleTitle: The Investigation on Mechanical Properties and Failure Mechanism Identification of a 3D Printed Object
abstract: 3D printing, also known as additive manufacturing, is a growing technology that has revolutionized the way products are designed, prototyped, and manufactured. This research paper reviews the current state of 3D printing technology, its applications in various industries, including healthcare, aerospace, automotive, and consumer goods, and the prospects of this technology. The paper also covers the advantages and limitations of 3D printing, the various types of 3D printing technologies available, the materials used, and the impact 3D printing has on society, including ethical considerations.

articleTitle: Dynamic Pricing Optimization for Coffee Shops Using a Machine Learning Approach with Random Forest Models
abstract: This study looks at how dynamic pricing can help coffee shops make more revenue using machine learning. It uses three months of sales data to find patterns and predict the effects of price changes. Simulations show that raising prices by 10% during afternoon peak hours brings the most revenue, while discounts and other adjustments also boost profits. A Random Forest model, with a strong predictive score (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> = 0.984), captures the trends effectively. The results highlight how machine learning combined with point-of-sale systems can create smarter pricing strategies that match customer habits, driving both profits and satisfaction.

articleTitle: Intelligent Defense For Smart Grids: Leveraging Resgen And Cho Models For Iot Security
abstract: The intrusion detection and security of Smart Grid IoT have only become so unimaginably significant with Internet of Things devices increasingly being integrated into smart grids at breakneck speed. It is a tedious process when it comes to detecting intrusions and countering them in an advanced dynamic system like this. Sophisticated models, which are designed to effectively determine the threats and react against them in real-time, must be utilized. This research addresses the above two problems by introducing two new models, ResGEN and ChO, which were developed to improve the accuracy and efficiency of intrusion detection in Smart Grid IoT systems. The ResGEN model integrates residual learning with generative methods in a bid to provide sophistication intrusion detection capability with major features retained from the system. Residual connections in ResGEN allow it to learn difficult patterns and outliers with fewer false negatives and false positives that render the solution potent in real-time intrusion detection. The ChO model uses novel optimization strategies merged with deep learning for adaptive hyperparameter tuning and optimizes performance both at training time and at model execution. This combination process makes the model forever optimized and hence flexible and adjustable to various modes of attacks. This paper therefore presents two novelties: using residual learning in combination with generative networks in ResGEN and using Cheetah Optimization in ChO. These novelties will improve both the effectiveness and efficiency of the whole detection system. The ChO model also enhances the efficiency of the intrusion detection process, thereby that of the system.

articleTitle: Enhanced Landslide Detection Using Deep Learning with Recurrent Neural Networks for Temporal Monitoring
abstract: Landslides represent an important group of geohazards causing extensive damage to structures and posing a thoughtful risk to general sustainability. The appropriate and precise withstanding of landslide actions is essential for successfully reducing the related hazards. This review announces an unconventional landslide warning structure that leverages an urbane learning planning, specifically a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN). The system is established through training on ancient landslide datasets shared with real-time sensor information, which incorporates critical features such as soil moisture content, temperature, humidity, and ground vibrations. The RNN model expertly identifies temporal forms thus facilitating precise probability assessments about the incidence of landslide actions. The efficacy of the executed RNN approach is assessed using previously experimental datasets to confirm its predictive accuracy and general applicability. Assessing presentation integrates metrics with accuracy, recall, precision, and F1 score to measure its success. The outcomes of the assessment expose that the Recurrent Neural Network shows enhanced value in the identification of landslides, accomplishing an outstanding accuracy rate of 89%. The outcomes document a precision statistic of 82%, an F1-score at 87%, and a recall rate verified at 94%.

articleTitle: NLP-Powered Resume Screening and Ranking System
abstract: Indeed, the system employs Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to identify the main features in the resume, including skills, education, and work experience. It then compares these features with the job description by means of semantic similarity methods, such as TF-IDF (Term Frequency Inverse Document Frequency) and BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) embeddings. The ranking engine uses weighted scoring algorithms that prioritize the relevancy of resumes. Further, the system also needs the user to upload their resume and job description through the web-based interface where the output will display that a listing has been generated and is listed to be gone through with the candidates. They evaluate the performance of the system by means of evaluation metrics such as precision, recall, F1-score, and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR). In their results, it shows that BERT based semantic matching has proved better than the conventional keyword-based methods as far as accuracy and efficiency in screening resumes is concerned. What makes the current study noteworthy is that artificial intelligence (AI) could help improve recruiting automation and point to ways of streamlining the hiring process. This will bring significant reductions to bias and further improve the fairness and effectiveness of selecting a candidate. Further work contemplates multi-lingual support, domain-specific customizations, and integration of the system to Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) to increase the importance of this study in real-world terms.

articleTitle: Image Forgery Detection Using Deep Learning
abstract: Images playa significant role in our life. With the growing Images are playing a pivotal role in our daily life. By the growing era images are becoming more and more popular as it contains lot of informatic content as well as memorable too. The problem arises from here, as the images are becoming popular day by day there are also increase in counterfeiting of the images or we can say that image forgery. It leads everyone to believe the content that's been forged. Not everyone is able to detect whether the image is forged or not. There are several applications that help people forge the image. This is a serious problem that has been arising and it should be addressed. There are many algorithms that can detect forgery, thorough the study, the most reliable approach or algorithm for detecting forgery is Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), but the singular approach of CNN is not much reliable. We hereby present a deep learning hybrid approach of Error Level Analysis with convolutional neural network for detecting Image manipulation. To detect whether an image is manipulated, the ELA from the image is extracted and will send the information to CNN. The training of the above algorithm will be performed on the dataset CASIA V2.0 which contains many forged images as well as authentic image. Transfer learning with UNET (encoder-decoder model) has also been applied for image segmentation. The experimental result on the dataset used are quite good, and these methodologies have been duly evaluated. The outcome of the proposed model outperforms the other well-known Transfer learning approaches compare to the findings. The study suggests that proposed model can get up to 0.910 and 0.930 accuracy and precision, respectively. The comprehensive analysis comparatively presented in this study provides valuable information that can guide the development of precise forgery detection technologies, safeguarding the honor of digital content and lessening the consequences of picture frame-ups in the rapidly evolving world of digital media.

articleTitle: Enhancing Stock Trading Performance in Chennai: A Reinforcement Learning and Sentiment Analysis Approach for Real-Time Decision-Making
abstract: Trading in stocks is facilitated by both technical and sentiment factors that are not well captured in routine models. The work presented investigates a reinforcement learning model integrated with sentiment analysis for improved stock trading in Chennai. The model analyses live data of stock and sentiment and makes changes to the trades being made dynamically. Training and finally testing the model, a dataset that consisted of stock prices and input sentiment data was used. Different results illustrate an average profit of 12.5% and a maximum drawdown of 5.2% with a Sharpe ratio of 1.8 to outperform previous methods. Profitable trades perfectly solved by the model to a success rate of 78%, and it had great improvements from success rates of 54%, 62 %, and 69 % in the years 2021, 2022, and 2023 respectively. In conclusion, the proposed model's performance suggests that the integration of sentiment analysis and reinforcement learning translates to large improvements in stock trading strategies.

articleTitle: The Result and Performance Analysis of Long Short-Term Memory Algorithm in Mobile Ad Hoc Network for Transmission Channel Prediction
abstract: Link prediction aims to identify key network properties to forecast topology changes. Most studies on temporal channel prediction focus on networks with moderate topological variations” often overlooking topological intervals and link duration. This study proposes an approach using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for link prediction. LSTMs are integrated into the prediction system due to their effectiveness in handling sequential input” outperforming multilayer perceptron networks and other artificial neural structures. The problem is framed as a multipurpose mobile network traffic prediction task” leveraging real downlink control channel data to minimize prediction errors. To optimize the LSTM network's memory length and determine the necessary data volume for accurate traffic forecasting” both one-step and long-term prediction errors are evaluated across different time intervals. Extensive testing on various datasets demonstrates that our LSTM model surpasses existing baseline methods in prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Future of AI-Driven Surgical Robotics
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI)-driven surgical robotics is revolutionizing modern medicine by enhancing precision, reducing human error, and enabling minimally invasive procedures with improved patient outcomes. AI-powered robots leverage real-time decision-making, adaptive control, and autonomous task execution, surpassing traditional surgical methods. With applications across various specialties, AI-driven systems like the Da Vinci Surgical System and Smart Tissue Autonomous Robot (STAR) are already reshaping surgeries, offering better precision and reduced recovery times. This paper explores the motivations behind integrating AI into surgical robotics, its current applications, and the potential for fully autonomous surgeries. Despite challenges such as data quality, high costs, and regulatory barriers, AI-driven surgical robotics holds promise for significantly improving patient care, particularly in underserved regions. By surveying existing systems, AI techniques, and emerging trends, this research highlights the future of surgery, offering insights into the transformative role AI will play in healthcare's evolution.

articleTitle: A Secure and Efficient Group Authentication Framework for Blockchain-Enabled Vehicular Edge Computing Systems
abstract: Maintaining privacy and trust within Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) systems requires proper authentication methods that ensure safety and effectiveness in dynamic settings. Current authentication solutions face three main drawbacks including excessive computational costs together with complex identity management systems and large security exposure. The proposed lightweight Multi-Entity Authenticated Group Key Agreement protocol serves blockchain-based VEC networks according to this research. MAGKA enhances authentication through bulk certification removal and reduces reliance on identity authentication and provides seamless vehicle traffic across edge networks. The solution provides VEC authentication with robust security and scalability demonstrated through security analysis of its ability to withstand attacks.

articleTitle: Accurate Brain Tumor Detection Using Laplacian Based GAN Model
abstract: The very complexity of the brain and the processes it operates with makes its tumors one of the most complicated malignancies that are difficult to detect and heal. Both benign and malignant kinds of tumors could seriously impair ordinary brain function. Improved results entail early, accurate diagnoses but traditional methods of biopsies and X-rays have disadvantages and risks. Improvements in deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) have helped diagnose brain tumors using non-invasive methods like magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). This paper applies Graph Neural Networks (GNN) and Laplacian-based image processing to propose an automated brain tumor recognition system depend on the MRI data from the BraTS 2020 dataset to classify brain lesions as benign or malignant. Before segmenting the images with a U-Net-based model to delineate brain lesions, the technique pre-processed MRI images using Laplacian filtering for better edge identification and noise reduction. Data imbalance was handled with a hybrid Laplacian-based U-Net GAN model, and a Fast Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) was applied to identify malignant cells. To improve generalization and avoid overfitting, dropout layers and data augmentation were applied. The model succeeded in identifying the tumor with a 90% accuracy on 1000 datasets, but when it was increased to 1500 datasets, the overfitting caused the result to decrease to 75% and stabilize at 70%. Although the issue is still being faced with bigger datasets, the findings show promise for early timely detection of tumors.

articleTitle: Cloud-Based HR Platforms for Scalable Workforce Management in Multinational Organizations
abstract: To address some of the issues that legacy systems in global corporations bring, such as fragmented data, inadequate scalability, and an antiquated front-end interface propose in the paper a cloud-based human resource (HR) platform. Decision-making is challenging with current HR systems, which also lack real-time transparency. The AI-enabled new platform promises to handle data analytics, automate several repetitive operations enable instant accesses to the data, and seamlessly integrate to enhance decision-making. Making use of cloud advantages for data centralization, scalability, and API connection with other enterprise applications. Important Points Regarding Process Efficiency, Cost Cutting, Employee Contentment, and Decision Accuracy Case Study in contrast to Legacy and Conventional Systems based on task completion time and satisfaction criteria, the proposed system performed significantly better than conventional approaches, reporting a 90% employee satisfaction rate, a 25% increase in process efficiency, and a 30% cost reduction. A cloud-based system that empowers HR teams in global firms, reduces administrative costs and maximizes staff management.

articleTitle: CNN-Based Hybrid Approach for Comprehensive Vehicle Detection in Complex Environments
abstract: Many detection algorithms (like Faster R-CNN or Mask R-CNN) employed for vehicle detection in composite traffic scenarios struggle to achieve real-time processing speeds and detection accuracy. This paper details a CNN-based hybrid approach employing feature extraction of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with an integrated Region Proposal Network (RPN) for generating high-quality region proposals. The proposed model uses ResNet-50 as the backbone in Faster R-CNN, so that the network benefits from ResNet-50's deep feature extraction capabilities, which help the RPN generate better region proposals and improve the accuracy of object detection. Thus, enhancing accuracy and robustness in real-world composite traffic scenarios. Further, to maintain speed that is required in real-time, the model skips Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) and spatial attention mechanism as they increase the computational load at different scales making approach slower. We carried out our evaluation on KITTI Vision Benchmark Dataset, Cityscapes dataset and custom dataset designed to test the model's robustness with various vehicle types, lighting conditions, and environmental complexities. The evaluation demonstrates that the proposed hybrid model resulted in a mean average precision (mAP) of 88% (in case of motor cycles) while maintaining real-time processing speeds. Along with the real-time processing speed, the model could also consistently handle detection under various scenarios (e.g., mixed traffic, fog, rain, and low-light conditions) with an acceptable precision. The paper contains findings to highlight the potential of this hybrid approach in applications involving vehicle detection accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: An Effective Way to Detect Cardiovascular Disease: A Comprehensive Review
abstract: CVD remains the main cause of deaths worldwide, and proper early detection with correct diagnosis will improve clinical results and reduce healthcare spending. There has been tremendous progress on AI, especially on ML and DL, in the last couple of decades, which has resulted in revolutionizing the overall predictive capabilities of health care systems. Most of these algorithms employed on public and private data sets have remarkably achieved remarkable results with up to 90 percent accuracy rate for the predictive outcome of heart disease. Despite all these developments, many issues are still left behind: dataset diversity, regional biases, and lack of utilization of reinforcement and semi-supervised learning techniques. Moreover, the evaluation metrics are still inconsistent in many ways, for example, underreporting of area under the curve (AUC), preventing models from being compared with one another and hindering their clinical adoption. This review synthesizes findings from recent studies, bringing attention to algorithm performance, dataset characteristics, and evaluation methods, pointing out gaps in current research. It demands bigger, more heterogeneous data sets, standardization of evaluation methods, and exploration of even more sophisticated techniques that have the potential to make the models scale up better toward applicability in the real world. This paper outlines roles of ML and DL in cardiovascular health care. Thereby, it directs further research and fosters the development of powerful, globally representative predictive models for CVD.

articleTitle: Deploying K-Mean Cluster Utilizing ML Approach for Detecting Fraud of Financial Landscape
abstract: The current trend of moving towards a global digital economy has made it very easy for criminals to commit sophisticated frauds which cause losses to both financial organizations and their clients. This paper suggests an innovative solution to the problem of financial fraud and its timely detection through the introduction of a supervised K-means machine-learning model. Emphasis is made on how massive amounts of financial transaction data can assist in identifying unusual transactions. This usually allows for timely fraud prevention. In contrast with common detection methods that are rule-based, machine learning solutions will improve the detection systems as new techniques and patterns of fraud as well as improvement of both efficiency and accuracy of the detections are observed. As k-mean clustering method helps improving the distribution of resources in financial organizations, it enables better Screening and Mitigation of fraud in the most vulnerable sectors of the economy which softens the effects of the frauds within entire Finances framework. In all, computational clustering with k-mean methods is the best recommendation for the application around fraud detection and its ease to deploy will improve on the security and trustworthiness of the financial system.

Author Keywords: Detectfraud of financial area and online financial transactions

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Interview System For Automated Recruitment: Shreshta Hire
abstract: The growing need for an effective hiring system has led to the creation of ShreshtaHire., an AI based platform revolutionizing interviews with advanced technologies. Using React for user-friendly interface., MongoDB for a secure and scalable database., and WebRTC for enhanced audio-video communication., ShreshtaHire redefines the interview experience. It employs BERT., RAG., and semantic search to ensure high-relevance output., aligning interviewer questions with job roles and candidate profiles while analyzing response context. The process is organized., impartial and transparent. ShreshtaHire generates detailed insight reports., offering feedback to candidates on performance., scores., skill gaps and tailored learning materials. Enhanced with visualizations like charts., these reports help candidates identify areas for improvement. By integrating advanced technologies and analytics., ShreshtaHire transforms interviewing into a structured., streamlined and effective process for modern recruitment.

articleTitle: Enhanced Deepfake Detection with LSTM and ResNeXt Integration
abstract: Created from advanced artificial intelligence (AI), Deepfakes are privacy, security, and trust shattering to digital media needs. In this work, we propose a novel deepfake detection model based on ResNext followed by Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) networks to achieve extraction of spatial features and temporal sequence analysis, respectively. Our approach combines the strengths of the two architectures and minimizes the investment in model size by retaining only a small portion of that which is accurate. On the Celeb-DF (v2) dataset, our model reached a detection accuracy of 93.59%, beating baseline methods. The demonstrated robustness and reliability of the proposed method make it a promising method to fight deepfakes in real world situations.

articleTitle: Personalized Fitness Recommendation System Integrating Yoga, Physiotherapy Exercises and Tips
abstract: Fitness applications have been a rage in the past decade, even more so since the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic limited outdoor activities and gym trips. The applications themselves, though, are marred by low adherence and high attrition. This paper discusses the Yoga, Physiotherapy Exercises, and Health Tips Fitness application that utilizes the application of machine learning to achieve maximum user adherence and engagement. A survey of 250 users named the top three reasons for the failure of fitness applications: lack of time, generic workout plans, and rigidity. The application remedies these by using personalized workout plans based on user preference and time at hand, e.g., short workout plans and AI-based plans. We utilized Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM) for user clustering based on initial activity, and supplemented it with sophisticated techniques such as BERT4Rec for recommendation, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) for plan optimization, SVD for dimensionality reduction, and XGBoost for predictive user adherence analysis. The model achieved high predictive accuracy of 95.12%, a loss of 0.0349, a total loss of 0.0314, and similarly high F1 scores, establishing the model's predictive ability. The application combines yoga, physiotherapy exercises, and personalized health tips in a novel combination, addressing multiple aspects of well-being to minimize attrition and encourage frequent exercise among diverse user groups.

articleTitle: Heuristic Algorithm for Anchor Point Selection in Wireless Rechargeable Sensor Networks
abstract: Data gathering and charging are critical operations in Wireless Rechargeable Sensor Networks (WRSNs), directly affecting network reliability and performance. Accurate sensor node localization is essential for ensuring power distribution stability. To optimize these operations, we consolidate data collection and energy transfer onto a single Mo-bile Vehicle (MV), reducing sensor energy loss and improving charging efficiency. This study aims to minimize energy transfer loss during charging and data gathering through the development of Weighted Function Method (WFM) heuristic algorithms. Using MATLAB simulations, we benchmark our algorithms against Hexagonal-based Anchor Point Selection (HAPS) and Weighted Term-based Anchor Point Selection (WAPS). Results indicate that our proposed methods significantly reduce energy transfer loss, lower the standard deviation of sensor distances from anchor points, and decrease overall energy consumption across the network with fewer iterations. Performance analysis, supported by an ANOV A test, confirms that the WFM algorithm outperform existing approaches, demonstrating their effectiveness in enhancing WRSNs efficiency.

articleTitle: Hindi Text Summarization Using the Improved Dingo Optimization
abstract: Document summarization has become an area of considerable interest across various fields, with approaches generally falling into two categories: extractive summarization and abstractive summarization. Extractive summarization generates a summary by selecting important sentences or phrases from the original text, ensuring that the key ideas are retained without altering the wording. In contrast, abstractive summarization generates sentences that succinctly represent the central concepts of the text more concisely and coherently. Both approaches face notable challenges, including errors in sentence selection, limited content coverage, and redundancy in generated summaries. To overcome these limitations, we introduce an innovative approach that utilizes the Improved Dingo Optimization (IDO) algorithm for the summarization of Hindi text. Before applying the IDO algorithm the input text is pre-processed, and feature extraction is done focusing on the coverage and redundancy features, two critical aspects for effective summarization. The IDO algorithm is then applied to optimize these features, improving the overall quality of the generated summaries. The proposed work was tested on the FIRE 2011 Hindi dataset, and its performance was compared with existing summarization techniques. The experimental results highlight notable improvements in accuracy and summary quality, highlighting the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling of Coronary Artery Disease Using Machine Learning
abstract: CAD remains among the leading causes underlying morbidity and mortality worldwide, requiring a prompt and precise diagnosis to improve outcomes for patients. Using the Z-Alizadeh Sani dataset, which consists of 303 samples with 55 features categorized into demographic, symptoms and examination, electrocardiogram, laboratory, and echo features, this study investigates the application of machine learning models for the prediction of CAD. To guarantee data quality, preprocessing procedures included outlier detection, univariate analysis, and a check for missing and duplicate values. Accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, ROC AUC score, and an ensemble approach are used to gauge the performance of the models under evaluation, which include CatBoost, XGBoost, LightGBM, and an ensemble approach. The class imbalance was addressed by using SMOTE which improved the recall of CAD predictions. With a perfect recall rate of 100%, an F1 score of 0.945, and an accuracy of 91.8%, CatBoost outperformed the other models. One important factor in medical diagnostics is false negatives, which can be reduced with a high recall rate. Using Optuna, hyperparameter tuning was done to optimize the model parameters for better predictive performance. The study highlights that in order to develop trustworthy diagnostic tools for the medical field, sophisticated machine learning techniques and appropriate data handling are essential. Subsequent research endeavors will center on the explainability of the models, their amalgamation with clinical data, and their validation throughout various datasets to bolster the resilience and relevance of the predictive models.

articleTitle: Elucidating Deep Transfer Learning Approach for Early Plant Disease Detection Through Spot and Lesion Analysis
abstract: The research field of detecting plant diseases through spot and lesion identification has become a crucial field because it helps minimize agricultural losses and enhances food security. The survey analyzes the latest progress in deep transfer learning methods which assist in detecting plant diseases during their early stages. A review of numerous research papers demonstrates how transfer learning techniques are used to achieve early detection of disease symptoms. The discussion includes significant development such as the application of CNN models ResNet, MobileNet, and EfficientNet alongside techniques like data augmentation and fine-tuning to overcome issues like limited labeled data and computational restrictions. The analysis focuses on commonly utilized data sets in plant disease detection research, which include the widely utilized PlantVillage dataset along with datasets from real-time field datasets. The paper highlights the dataset capabilities in managing data diversity, environmental variations, and scalability, but also represents dataset limitations when applied to real-world situations. A detailed overview discussed existing methodology in early plant disease detection through transfer learning and identifying major research gaps. It identifies critical obstacles, like unavailability of real-time based datasets, dataset imbalances, recommends future research based on development of lightweight models for devices with limited resources utilizing federated learning for the diagnostic process. This research presents essential insights to researchers and field experts to boost precision agriculture using novel AI methods.

articleTitle: Enhancing Personalization: A Machine Learning Approach to Modern Recommender Systems
abstract: In the digital era where Industrie 4.0 has emerged, most of the application are either web based or mobile based and also, people are becoming very specific in selecting their products and amenities over internet. This preference in choices of users makes it difficult for the service provider to understand which product or service they should provide to the user so that the user can select appropriately and that too in less time. This has led to the use of recommendation system for these purposes. Also, the recommendation system helps manufacturers to understand that which product has higher consumption and which product has lower consumption. This paper tries its best to first explain the foundation concept of recommendation system and its forms. Also, the paper tries its best to deep dive into all the relevant research that has been carried out to understand the merits as well as limitation of if recommendation system. This work deals with various machine learning algorithms such as Neural Collaborative Filtering (NCF), Embedding Layers, Deep Neural Networks (DNN), Matrix Factorization, Hybrid Model: Collaborative Filtering (SVD), Content-Based Filtering. The paper also highlights the vital applications of recommendation system that are useful in real life.

articleTitle: Integration of Genetic Algorithm and Support Vector Machine for Water Discharge Prediction in River Basin System
abstract: Water discharge (WD) is essential component of river hydrodynamics. It is crucial to predict WD for constructing reservoirs and dams, operations, management and river engineering studies. WD includes various complex nonlinear processes which depends on many variables. The WD prediction is complicated using traditional methods because these are unable to handle the complex nonlinear processes of it. WD prediction using novel artificial intelligence (AI) techniques is highly encouraged for its effectiveness in flood forecasting. A hybrid AI approaches is useful for WD prediction in Mahanadi River (MR), India. Support vector machine (SVM) is integrated with Genetic algorithm (GA) (GA-SVM) for optimization of all associated SVM parameters. Temperature(T), rainfall (R), water level (WL) and sediment yield (SY) are used as inputs parameters for prediction of WD. The standard statistical measures are used for the performance evaluation of GA-SVM model. Hybrid GA-SVM with automated parameter tuning model is developed for prediction of WD at Tikarapara location. It is outermost downstream station in the MR using hydro-climatical parameters. The developed GA-SVM model is compared to SVM, and multiple linear regression (MLR) to evaluate the ability of the models to predict the WD. The proposed GA-SVM model is provided satisfactory and better results for estimation of WD in the MR among all comparative models. This modelling approaches can be applied for the prediction of WD at gauge or ungauged places in MR due to its easiness in implement and satisfactory results.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Detection of Stress, Anxiety, and Depression: Techniques, Challenges, and Future Perspectives
abstract: This research studies new methods used to detect SAD problems based on both mental and physical signals. Because mental health problems affect people worldwide traditional ways to identify these issues and diagnose them do not work for today's demands. This research evaluates AI-powered methods using several input sources including speech, facial expressions and biometric information to better screen patients and expand testing capacity. This discussion covers issues with patient data changes and ethical questions while exploring new methods including transformer processing and shared learning. These results show that AI can change how mental health is diagnosed by helping doctors catch problems sooner and deliver better results to patients.

articleTitle: Advancements in Suspicious and Violent Activity Recognition for Intelligent Video Surveillance
abstract: Recognition of suspicious or violent activity in video surveillance has become increasingly important in terms of public safety and security. This synthesis examined state-of-the-art methodologies for detecting anomalous human behaviors-such as machine learning, deep learning, and hybrid approaches. By analyzing key contributions across recent studies, we identify advancements in feature extraction, model architectures such as CNNs, LSTMs, and Conv3D, and their applications to datasets like UCF101 and custom video repositories. The comparative analysis shows promising aspects in terms of performance and reliability, with some techniques such as Time-Distributed CNN getting accuracy improvements of over 90%. The issues of practical applications in a real-world scenario, problems with dealing with advanced datasets, and future research directions such as real-time implementation and ethical considerations were discussed. The present study provides an inclusive overview of the current trends in intelligent surveillance systems and the roadmap for innovations in the near future.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Deepfake Video Detection
abstract: As technology continues to progress, the creation of deepfakes is becoming increasingly simple and accessible. Due to developments in deep learning, artificial intelligence, and face manipulation tools, the quality of average deepfakes is steadily broadening. Deepfake technology represents the forefront of video manipulation, employing sophisticated neural networks such as auto-encoders and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to produce convincingly deceptive facial videos. Replacing the target face with a fake face in video content can be achieved quite easily using face manipulation techniques. Deepfakes can deploy the different type of deep learning algorithm's which can easily manipulate and synthesize the images and videos of a person that humans cannot distinguish from the real one. Caution should be exercised when utilizing this, as it has the potential for misuse. Identifying and detecting the manipulated video content is an essential responsibility that requires resilient methods to detect deepfake videos. There are serious concerns that deepfake technology will become a problem in the future. biometric security may become more vulnerable to malicious use in the coming years, raising concerns about its safety. Information, involving the utilization of facial recognition technology. To address these issues, detecting deepfakes are extremely crucial. Therefore, we attempt to construct a hybrid deepfake detection model which can categorize the manipulated videos and original videos. In this paper we will develop more efficient model to detect whether a video is a real or manipulated video. We will be using Res-Next Conventional Neural Network to extract frame level features and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) to differentiate whether a video is fake or real type. There are various available datasets to train and test our model. Our main focus is identifying and detecting deepfake videos with high precision, effectively by using the robust method which can differentiate b/w real and deepfake video with accuracy of more than 94%.

Author Keywords: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM)

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Health Insurance System
abstract: The existing healthcare claims process suffers from many ills, like fraud, huge paperwork, and delays in claims verification, affecting both patients and insurers badly. This paper represents a blockchain-based health insurance system based on Ethereum smart contracts and IPFS to enhance the security and transparency and ensure automation in claims processing. The proposed system consists of the blockchain layer for automating the policy management, claims processing, and fraud detection via Policy, Claim, and Audit smart contracts; a decentralized storage layer (IPFS) that ensures secure and tamper-proof storage of claim-related documents; and a payment layer that formally settles transactions via smart contracts, thus lessening the company's reliance on intermediaries. Integrating middleware APIs ensures good interoperability among insurers, hospitals, patients, and administrators-real-time tracking of claims and compliance with regulatory demands. This will be a global, scalable, fraud-resistant model that optimizes claims settlement and minimizes administrative overhead and maximizes user satisfaction. This paper underscores how health insurance can benefit from blockchain technology.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Novel Neural Framework for Schizophrenia Detection Using EEG Data
abstract: Schizophrenia is a chronic psychiatric disorder that has no definitive diagnostic tests and clinical diagnosis mostly depends on clinical judgment. It introduces a new neural approach for schizophrenia identification based on EEG data, which is more effective than current approaches due to noise, artifacts, and low interpretability. The framework also utilizes artifact removal and normalization of the WT and EMD as hybrid data features. A temporal and spectral feature-based attention map is employed in a custom neural network, which selectively focuses on important EEG areas to improve interpretability. The proposed model produces the highest accuracy of 93.8%, sensitivity of 92.3%, and specificity of 95.2% and surpasses prior works from the year 2021 to 2023. The model shows computational effectiveness with an inference time of 12ms per EEG segment, appropriate for real-time clinical application. This work lays the groundwork for developing explainable AI solutions that can be scaled for use in psychiatric diagnosis, specifically for the early identification of schizophrenia.

articleTitle: Design and Modelling of Unmanned, Microcontroller Based Mini Rocket for Planetary Space Exploration
abstract: The design and modelling of an autonomous microcontroller-based small rocket intended for planetary space exploration is described in this paper. The Small Rocket is Driven by a single-use solid rocket motor, and it is controlled by a Raspberry Pi Pico and uses a variety of sensors to gather information. The work presented in this paper is motivated by obstacles encountered in planetary exploration, such as limited mobility to reach difficult terrain. By addressing the drawbacks of conventional rovers, the small rocket hopes to open the door for more efficient and effective exploration of planets. With its ability to overcome mobility limitations and provide real-time data, the small rocket could revolutionize the way we explore celestial bodies. Additionally, the project aims to pave the way for future advancements in space exploration technology, ultimately expanding our understanding of the universe and more efficient and versatile exploration of planets.

articleTitle: Enhancing Medical Image Authentication in Healthcare with SLT, Contourlet Transform, and Firefly Algorithm Techniques
abstract: In today's health care system, integrity and reliability of medical images are most important. This paper proposes a novel X-ray image authentication system that improves security with Shearlet Transform (SLT), Contourlet Transform (CLT), and the Firefly Algorithm (FA). The SLT and Contourlet Transform capture complicated features of images that provide a robust representation basis. The Firefly Algorithm enables the process of authentication to improve efficiency and accuracy. This proposed method integrates these techniques toward increasing strength against common threats such as tampering or forgery with high authenticity levels. Many simulations have good representation in its probable application to safeguard medical imaging in healthcare settings.

articleTitle: Facial Recognition-Based Automated Access Control System
abstract: Facial recognition technology now days is used to identify or verify individuals based on their facial features. It works by analysing key facial landmarks and comparing them with a stored database of images. In this paper system based on facial recognition technology for secure and easy access control applications is proposed. The system uses a 12-volt solenoid lock, a relay module, and an ESP32-CAM module, wherein the integration and programming are done using Arduino IDE software. The ESP32-CAM module captures the facial images, then processes them to recognize the authorized people to allow or deny access. This method negates the importance of physical keys and cards, thus lowering the risk of lost or stolen credentials. Thus, recognition accuracy, response time, and reliability are a few of the bases for evaluating the performance of such a system, showing good potentials for practical applications in a variety of security-sensitive environments.

articleTitle: Hybrid Models for Effective Adversarial Attack Detection in Cyberspace Using Machine Learning
abstract: This With the exponential proliferation of cyberspace, it brought us in to a new area of security challenges that require cutting-edge methods and tools for adversaries to launch attack. The paper describes a novel idea of hybrid model using latest machine learning algorithms in order to handle adversarial attacks on Internet. The hybrid architecture combines a mix of algorithms that cheats the accuracy and ensures robustness against new cyber threats. It achieves latest performance with 97.8% detection rate on the benchmark datasets via extensive analysis and experiments, outperforming standalone models by a significant margin (+12.3 %). On targeted perturbations too, the hybrid approach exhibits 93.5% detection accuracy and proves to be more computationally secure against adversaries with diverse adversarial attacks (vs. standard model). This research should be a framework to measure the performance of hybrid architectures generally and especially for enhancing security in cyberspace using advanced machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Driven Knowledge Transfer for Automated Medical Image Segmentation
abstract: This study presents a comprehensive review and comparative analysis of existing research on image segmentation techniques for MRI imaging. A detailed comparison is made between single-image and multispectral image segmentation, as well as between supervised and unsupervised segmentation approaches. Additional aspects such as image pre-processing, image registration, validation methods, and their classifications are also discussed. In medical image processing, segmentation is an essential step, especially for applications like brain MRI analysis, where segmentation results help in understanding brain anatomy, identifying structural changes, and aiding in clinical tasks such as surgical planning or image-guided treatments. Automated Knowledge Transfer (AKT) using deep learning, particularly through pre-trained convolutional neural networks enables efficient learning from large datasets, significantly reducing manual labeling efforts and enabling faster, more accurate image analysis. This study also discusses challenges and solutions within MRI segmentation, highlighting a case study on tumor volume measurement to illustrate practical applications.

articleTitle: Cardiac Diagnosis System Using ECG and PCG Signals with a Multi-Scale Pooling-Based Deep Neural Network (MSP-DNN) Classifier
abstract: Globally, heart disease (HD) is one of the main causes of death, and survival rates are greatly increased by early identification. This paper proposes a Multi-Scale Pooling-based Deep Neural Network (MSP-DNN) for HD detection using ECG and PCG signals. The system involves pre-processing steps, including noise removal for ECG and denoising for PCG, feature extraction in both time-domain and frequency-domain for ECG, and amplitude and frequency analysis for PCG. These features are then analyzed for correlations, which are input into the MSP-DNN model for classification. A TMF-FIS is used to assess survival rates. According to experimental results, the proposed model performs better than existing models regarding f1-score, accuracy, precision, recall, sensitivity, and specificity.

Author Keywords: Deep Learning-based Multi-Scale Pooling-based Deep Neural Network (MSP-DNN) classifier
Trapezoidal Membership Function-based Fuzzy Inference System (TMF-FIS)

articleTitle: Patient-Centric Hand-Gesture Driven Wheelchair Control Using Convolutional Neural Networks for Enhanced Healthcare Mobility
abstract: This work presents a smart wheelchair system whereby users may operate it in an intuitive and hands-free manner by using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for hand gesture recognition in real-time. With programmed hand signals, the smart wheelchair substitutes for conventional button-operated controllers, so translating users' mobility and freedom despite restricted physical capability. This system's basic components are an L298 motor driver to regulate wheelchair movement, a Raspberry Pi for real-time image processing, and an 8x8 LED matrix visual feedback model. Data preprocessing, supervised learning model training, and testing in many environmental settings improves the gesture recognition accuracy. Testing reveals this system offers fast response times, accurate gesture detection, and consistent control. This work supports assistive technology by giving wheelchair users a flexible, adaptive, user-friendly control mechanism. Future research should look at expanding the gesture variety, improving CNN performance for faster real-time processing, and integrating sophisticated safety elements-such as obstacle detection and voice commands.

articleTitle: Maximizing Development Efficiency: A Comprehensive Guide to Frameworks and Libraries
abstract: This article discusses the differences between the baking of coding structures and libraries giving an easy-to-understand perspective for anyone. The frameworks are compared to blueprints; they determine the consistent construction of the software by emphasizing how components should be assembled as well as how they interact with each other. On the contrary, libraries appear as a box of toolkits, each containing everyday programs and functions programmers can utilize to formulate instructions corresponding to different tasks. Frameworks equip developers with standards and uniformity to make their work faster, more efficient, and more cohesive. At the same time, the framework structure may restrict developers from getting too creative or to add features that does not sit well with their projects, such as relying on conventions. In contrast, library encourages flexibility and modularity as developers are given the freedom to decide which functionalities they want and be able to integrate the libraries to provide the desired effects for their application. It enables the developers to craft solutions which cater for the specific requirements of their project and it also allows code reuse and promoting rapid development. In this way, developers express their suppositions which in essence helps to find the most suitable tool for their projects. Such comprehension grants the developers the wisdom to weight structure and freedom and thus ultimately yielding more proficient and scalable software programs.

articleTitle: Hand Motion Sign Language Detection Using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and YOLOv5 Object Detection Framework
abstract: The majority of people who don't hear or speak depend upon sign language as their main method of communication. Sign language mastery presents particular difficulties to learners. Our system will convert sign language gestures from interpreters into spoken and textual words. Our technology functions as a personal language translator which operates through computers or smartphones. The combination of OpenCV alongside his YOLOv5 framework enables users to watch hand gestures while detecting gesture signals accurately. Through this system individuals who struggle with hearing and speaking abilities can conveniently approach anyone. The system integrates with cellphone calls and applications along with video conversation features. We aim to provide affordable communication solutions that work for every person.

articleTitle: Adaptive Therapeutics Through AI-Enhanced Nanoscale Sensors: Innovations in Real-Time Health Monitoring
abstract: The paper provides an overview of the integration of AI and nanoscale sensors embedded within medical implants, thus enabling real-time health monitoring with adaptive therapeutic responses. This study has investigated the potential of AI algorithms in analyzing large amounts of data emanating from sensors designed to monitor physiological parameters at cellular and molecular levels. The system would also be able to pick out anomalies and predict health risks with the use of machine learning and sophisticated data analytics, automatically adjusting therapeutic interventions in the right direction to ensure timely and personalized medical care. This developed approach tends to build up effectiveness in the implantable medical device to respond effectively against dynamic changes in a patient's health condition. Furthermore, this study will address the issues of data privacy, sensor inaccuracy, and the integration of AI into the current healthcare system. Results from the study could afford the creation of innovative solutions that will empower precision medicine leading to improved patient outcomes and allowing more efficient healthcare delivery.

articleTitle: An IoT-Based Data Logging System to Ensure Consistent Dairy Product Quality Through Monitoring and Cloud Analytics
abstract: Pasteurization is intended to eliminate harmful microorganisms while maintaining the quality of milk and its other crucial constituents. As the consumption of dairy products increases in various regions across the globe, it becomes important to ensure that pasteurization is performed according to the set standards. Currently, the most major limitation of pasteurization processes is that they are overly dependent on the manual supervision and control. Besides the quality of the final product, this is a crucial factor for maintaining safety throughout. Furthermore, because they do not typically provide accurate data relating to the deviation of the process over a period of time. Nowadays having more of an automated solution, as well as computing capabilities of all systems in the cloud, has reduced redundancies across processes. In relation to the dairy sector, having those technologies enable efficiencies with respect to the precision, uniformity, and regulation of the entire pasteurization process. Consequently, the transfer to the automated systems undoubtedly improves operational performance as well as reduces errors related to the manual sanitation of the parameters particularly temperature and flow rate, which are critical and have to be maintained. Also, the factor of timely service is simplified because the machine is able to analyze data instantly, thus increasing productivity by reducing the downtime of operations.

articleTitle: Farm Fusion: Smart Crop Recommendation System for Sustainable Farming Using Machine Learning Techniques

abstract: In the recent past, data-centric solutions have been developed to address crop choice issues, low yields and soil management. The proposed work in this paper is a web-based application, referred to as Farm Fusion designed to help the farmers for the selection of the best crops to be cultivated according to specific site characteristic. This system utilizes the following machine learning algorithms like Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Random Forest, Gaussian Naive Bayes (GNB) and gradient boosting models LightGBM, XGBoost, and CatBoost. Before suggesting the appropriate crops, the system uses an Ensemble model that integrates these algorithms. The input soil nutrient parameters included in this system are phosphorus, potassium, nitrogen while the input environmental parameters include pH, temperature, rainfall and humidity. It is a web application that uses the flask framework which is integrated with pre-trained model to recommend right crop for the farm field. This system will assist in the process of decision making process, provide sustainability and improve crop yield.

articleTitle: Hybrid Semantic and Contextual Analysis for Multilingual Fake News Detection Using Deep Learning
abstract: The growth of fake news threatens the integrity of information and public trust. This work provides a very efficient multilingual system that automatically identifies fake news by unifying standard feature extraction with deep learning and transformer-based models. Datasets of Hindi, Tamil and English are used in the system, which uses TF-IDF, NMF and LSTM for constructing semantic and sentiment-aware embeddings and a fine-tuned BERT for classification. The results are considerably high for all three languages with accuracies ranging from 97% for Hindi, 93<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> for English and 84 % for Tamil, demonstrating its adaptability to diverse linguistic contexts. Several performance evaluations show the precision, recall and F1-score of the target of the system. This research emphasizes the necessity of sense-based and context-based approaches when dealing with the problem of fake news in a world with many languages.

articleTitle: Safe URL Detection with Privacy Using Machine Learning and Cryptography Techniques
abstract: A malicious URL or website represents a serious cybersecurity threat. Search engines logically serve as the foundation for managing in order. However, the influx of many malicious websites on search engines has created a considerable threat to our users. Most existing systems designed to identify malicious websites concentrate on particular types of attacks. Simultaneously, available browser extensions relying on blacklists are ineffective against numerous websites. To stop the server from deriving any useful information from the masked data, any data supplied from the client side must be successfully hidden. We provide the first Privacy-Preserving Safe Browsing service in this regard. This service offers strong security guarantees now absent from other Safe Browsing services. In particular, it preserves the capacity to recognize dangerous URLs while safeguarding the user's privacy and the blacklist provider's proprietary assets. In this study, we provide a methodology that protects users' privacy from outside analysts and service providers by encrypting their perceptual data. Furthermore, while maintaining differential privacy, it fully enables selected aggregate operations for examining user behavior online. The AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) algorithm encrypts users' online search behavior data. Only authenticated users can decrypt their history with assistance from the secret key sharing and verification process. A user feedback system notifies the search engine administrator of any malicious URLs, enabling the administrator to update the malicious URL database frequently.
