articleTitle: On-Device Financial Data Management Using ML and NLP: A Privacy-Focused Approach
abstract: Personal finance management has become more difficult due to the exponential rise of digital financial services, with SMS-based notifications being a crucial channel for transaction updates. However, the unstructured nature of SMS data poses challenges for users in organizing financial information effectively. This paper introduces a novel, privacy-preserving on-device financial data management system that makes use of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning (ML). The proposed solution incorporates three core functionalities: SMS transaction classification, data extraction, and data categorization, complemented by a chatbot interface for user interaction. A Random Forest classifier achieves a remarkable 99.15% accuracy in transaction classification, while a Bi-LSTM-CRF model, combined with BERT embeddings, attains 99.61 % accuracy in extracting transaction details. Transactions are categorized into spending categories facilitating detailed expense analysis. Optimized for mobile deployment, the system ensures data privacy and efficiency. This work bridges a critical gap in personal finance management by enabling users to securely track, analyse, and gain insights into their financial behaviour, laying the groundwork for future enhancements like real-time alerts and predictive analytics.

articleTitle: Robotic Drug Delivery in the Healthcare Sector
abstract: This paper examines the role of robotics in healthcare, with a focus on robotic drug delivery systems. Robotics has significantly advanced drug administration by improving precision, reducing side effects, and increasing patient compliance. Technologies such as RoboCap and PillCam have revolutionized drug delivery by being able to deliver treatment where other methods cannot reach. Pill like robotics can enter the GI tract by swallowing where they perform drug delivery and diagnostics better than conventional practices. It also looks at the applicability of microrobotics in minimally invasive surgeries, which therefore can include targeted drug delivery. However, challenges remain, especially in controlling robotic devices within the body. Ethical concerns, costs, and technical issues need addressing as these technologies evolve. Future research should focus on refining control systems and AI to further enhance robotic drug delivery and improve healthcare outcomes, particularly in underserved regions like India.

articleTitle: Decoding Sentiments in Product Reviews: A Smart Analysis Approach
abstract: Recently, sentiment analysis has been the backbone for understanding public opinions and behaviors, especially for online reviews on products. In this paper, a classification of product reviews based on the machine learning approach is taken. The study preprocesses text data using tokenization, stop word removal, and lemmatization on a data set from Kaggle, where the data is down-sampled to 70,000 reviews. A voting ensemble classifier comprising Logistic Regression, Multinomial Naive Bayes, and Support Vector Machines (SVM) were implemented to harness the power of more than one algorithm. Through this experiment, the proposed model demonstrated robustness to fit nuanced sentiment patterns in reviews, mainly achieving an accuracy of 85.75%. This work extends existing methods by combining ensemble learning with text-based feature extraction using TF-IDF for a good computational tradeoff in predictive accuracy. The findings echo the increasing need for scalable, accurate sentiment classification models in e-commerce analysis and social media analysis. However, while these advancements of large-scale pre-trained language models has received attention, challenges such as the cultural context interpretation, sarcasm detection and processing the multilingual reviews persist. This work lays the groundwork for future research that will overcome these challenges and enable greater consumer sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Deep Learning based framework for Automated Plant Disease Detection and Classification to Enhance Sustainable Agriculture
abstract: The rapid advancement of deep learning has revolutionized various domains, including smart agriculture, where it plays a pivotal role in plant disease detection. The purpose of the article is to highlight deep learning-based approaches for detecting different types of plant diseases. The article covers various types of plants, their associated diseases, and the importance of addressing these issues. The detailed literature and comparative analysis demonstrate how different datasets have been explored for plant disease detection and how various deep learning techniques have been utilized for predictions. The key challenges, along with a detailed study in the comparative analysis, also highlight the future scope for further research in this field and the limitations of each study discussed in the article. The objective of the present research is to propose an effective deep learning-based mechanism for detecting different types of plant diseases, enabling accurate large-scale development in the field of smart agriculture for sustainability.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Resume Builder: Enhancing Job Applications with Artificial Intelligence
abstract: Modern candidates for employment positions must construct ATS-compliant resume applications because employers strictly follow this practice for candidate selection. Applications struggle to create ATS compliant resumes while matching their content to resume keywords which results in poor automated recruiter screening and impacts their chances of submitting their best application. Resumes lack any additional feedback systems in standard development tools and do not provide automatic AI assistance or recommend roles for specific job requirements. This system uses NLP capabilities with ML attributes to auto-generate resumes that follow the requirements of ATS standards. The system requires two essential actions to complete which involve content reshaping along with template selection for recruitment approaches based on user-submitted industry keywords. The system instantly supplies users with feedback about grammatical precision and helps both users and applicants to determine keywords and improve score structure.Independent testers evaluated the methodological effectiveness of working with job seekers through different professional groups who have differing expertise levels. The system demonstrates its capacity to help employers acquire superior job candidates through interviews while meeting ATS requirements and developing resumes with clear terms. The research indicates artificial intelligence provides recruitment capabilities by developing artificial resume content which leads candidates to false interview opportunities. The study established fundamental concepts for future development of AIbased career guidance systems by creating automated systems for matching skills and giving job recommendations and AI-driven guidance to potential job seekers.

articleTitle: Network Coding For Data Compression In Genomic Sequencing
abstract: The exponential growth of next-generation sequencing technologies has resulted in a massive influx of genomic data, posing significant challenges in storage, transmission, and processing. Conventional compression methods, such as gzip and bzip2, are not optimized for the unique structural patterns and redundancies of genomic sequences, leading to suboptimal performance. Addressing this gap, our research introduces a novel data compression framework that leverages network coding principles to enhance efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Network coding, widely used in communication systems, is adapted here to process and compress genomic data by employing finite field arithmetic and redundancy-aware encoding techniques. Our method achieves a compression ratio of up to 50% while maintaining a data integrity level of 99.99%, as validated through extensive mathematical analysis and experimental testing on diverse genomic datasets. Furthermore, the framework demonstrates linear scalability and robust error resilience, making it particularly suited for large-scale applications in clinical genomics and research. By bridging the gap between traditional compression algorithms and the growing demands of modern genomic data, this study lays the groundwork for more efficient and reliable data management solutions in bioinformatics.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Cardiac Disease Classification Methods, Systematic Literature Reviews, Open Challenges and Future Directions
abstract: In recent years, Cardiovascular Diseases (CVDs) have appeared as one of the primary causes of death worldwide. The human heart is essential for circulating blood and ensuring its distribution throughout the parts of the body. The symptoms such as fatigue, difficulty in breathing, swelling in the ankles, fluid retention, and other related issues are the causes of CVD. Diagnosing CVDs poses a challenge for healthcare professionals due to the extensive amount of data in each scan and the potential for low contrast. Deep learning and machine learning models are utilized in various medical fields, including CVD diagnosis, achieving promising outcomes. This review examines the latest techniques and progress in the classification of cardiac diseases through machine learning and deep learning methods. In this review, different classification approaches based on the types of data utilized, Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) are categorized. This survey explores the software platforms and tools frequently used for model implementation and their effectiveness in clinical applications. Additionally, the performance of various classification models using relevant metrics such as accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity are reviewed in this work. Finally, the challenges encountered in existing cardiac disease classification models are analyzed and potential areas for improvement are discussed to enhance the accuracy and reliability of the categorization systems in future clinical settings.

articleTitle: Transforming Skin Disease Diagnosis: Harnessing Compound-Scaled AI Network for Enhanced Image Analysis and Precision Medicine
abstract: Millions worldwide suffer from skin conditions, making prompt and precise diagnosis essential to successful treatment. However, conventional diagnostic techniques are time-consuming, dependent on physician knowledge, and frequently unavailable in low-resource locations. The compound-scaled AI network, an advanced deep-learning model, addresses these challenges by providing precise and scalable image analysis. Utilizing high-resolution imaging and compound scaling, it can accurately detect, classify, and segment various skin disorders, including benign and malignant lesions. While questions remain about whether AI matches human specialists in diagnosing all pigmented skin lesions, studies have compared AI performance against experts in identifying clinically significant cases. This research highlights the compound-scaled AI network's potential in dermatology, particularly for telemedicine, early cancer detection, and clinical workflow integration. By enhancing diagnostic accessibility and accuracy, this AI model could transform dermatology, enabling more personalized and equitable treatment worldwide. Impressively, it achieved 99.6% training accuracy and 98.4% testing accuracy, demonstrating deep learning's effectiveness in automating skin disorder detection and classification.

articleTitle: AI Driven Restoration of Damaged Paintings and Historical Artifacts Using Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: Restoration of damaged art pieces, paintings, and artifacts is vital to the preservation of cultural heritage. Conventional techniques are done by hand, hence time-consuming and inconsistent. This paper proposes an AI-based restoration system with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Context Encoders to automate and improve the restoration process of digital artifacts. The process includes data collection, training, and model optimization to achieve good-quality outputs. The Context Encoder generates predictions for lost parts from adjacent image features, and the GAN model increases texture and color for full integration. The platform is easy to use with convenient uploads and rapid restoration. The model is assessed with quantitative metrics and expert judgment, showing better restoration accuracy. This AI-based solution is a productive and scalable alternative to human restoration and serves museums, historians, and cultural heritage.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of an AI-enabled State-of-the-Art Models for the Detection of DDoS Attacks on IoT Devices
abstract: With technological advancement, Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks are gaining momentum in IoT networks. DDoS attacks are widely spreading on IoT devices since they have limited resources (memory) and no efficient security models. Different security measures are available to protect IoT devices from attacks. Some of these are firewalls, Intrusion detection systems, etc. Recently, researchers have utilized Artificial Intelligence for early detection of attacks due to its capability of detecting menaced attacks and, hence, boosting security. In this paper, a rigorous survey of different AI-enabled state-of-the-art models for detecting DDoS Attacks was done, and the future direction and scope of improvement for early Detection of DDoS attacks on IoT devices were highlighted.

articleTitle: Detecting Leaf Disease and Classifying Images via Transfer Learning with VGG 16
abstract: Identifying plant diseases is vital for promoting the robust growth of plants. To maximize agricultural productivity, it is essential to maintain healthy plants and effectively prevent diseases that can compromise them. The adoption of modern technology is becoming paramount to meet the increasing demand for efficient farming practices. Recent improvements in artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and deep learning (DL) have significantly transformed agricultural operations, paving the way for enhanced productivity and sustainability in the farming industry. AI significantly boosts productivity, effectively identifies plant diseases, and proactively monitors agricultural air quality. By analyzing plants, machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) technologies deliver precise and reliable disease detection. This research paper showcases a cutting-edge system for detecting diseases in tomato leaves, utilizing the pre-trained VGG16 model (Visual Geometry Group-16). Through advanced deep learning techniques, our approach employs three powerful activation functions-Softmax, Rectified Linear Units (ReLU), and Hyperbolic Tangent (Tanh). The results speak for themselves: the Softmax function achieved an impressive accuracy of 97%, while ReLU reached 84%, and Tanh, although less effective, recorded 17%. With such remarkable classification accuracy, our proposed model establishes a robust framework for accurately predicting crop diseases, reducing crop damage, and enhancing plant health.

articleTitle: Review on Architectures of Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: This review provides a broad overview of CNN architectures, focusing on the crucial building blocks and layered structures that form complete networks. It traces the evolution of CNNs, summarizing key publications and highlighting the diverse array of architectures that have emerged in recent years. While simplifying some technical details, the review maintains conceptual rigor to ensure a thorough understanding of CNN principles and development. This review serves as a valuable resource for those seeking to navigate the complexities of CNNs, offering insights into their operational principles, architectural innovations, and potential applications beyond the realm of Computer Vision.

articleTitle: Leveraging CNNs for Early Detection and Staging of Diabetic Retinopathy
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a major cause of blindness, and its early detection is crucial hence the development of a reliable system for its detection. This work describes an automated DR detection system through Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for image classification of retinal fundus photographs. To address key problems of how the model can deal with data variability, multi-class classification, and feature localization, our model is trained on a diverse set of data. CNN based method produced an accuracy of 93% and precision of 93.84 while recall was 95.57%. The studies presented in this paper show the system's possibility of DR screening in real time for a large population, which would ultimately improve DR detection and treatment. The further improvements are extending the database for generalization purposes and implementing the model into a convenient real-life tool for clinical usage.

articleTitle: Developing the Performance and Longevity of Electric Vehicle Batteries Through the Implementation of Thermal Management Systems
abstract: Electric vehicles, also known as EVs, are quickly becoming more popular as a more environmentally friendly alternative to conventional automobiles powered by internal combustion engines. The performance and longevity of electric vehicle batteries, on the other hand, are crucial aspects that can have a substantial impact on the adoption of these batteries and their overall efficiency. As a result of the fact that temperature fluctuations have a significant impact on the degradation of batteries, thermal management systems are absolutely necessary in order to keep batteries functioning at their best and to extend their lifespan. The development and implementation of better thermal management systems for electric vehicle batteries is the primary emphasis of this field of research. In the first step of this process, we will examine the current status of electric vehicle battery technology as well as the difficulties connected with thermal control. After that, we investigate a variety of thermal management solutions, such as air cooling, liquid cooling, and phase change materials, in order to determine which methods are the most efficient for a variety of battery chemistries and operating situations. The design and simulation of a unique thermal management system that blends liquid cooling with superior heat dissipation materials is an important part of our study. This system is designed to manage thermal energy. In order to analyze the heat transfer that occurs within the battery pack and to optimize the design parameters of the thermal management system, we make use of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and finite element analysis (FEA). We analyze the effectiveness of the suggested thermal management system by conducting a number of experiments and simulations. Our results show that the system is effective in terms of temperature regulation, energy efficiency, and the impact it has on the life of the battery. According to the facts that we have gathered, the deployment of a sophisticated thermal management system has the potential to considerably increase the performance and longevity of electric car batteries, thereby minimizing thermal-induced deterioration and improving the overall reliability of vehicles. In the final part of this article, we will examine the wider implications of our research. These implications include the possibility of lowering the overall cost of ownership of electric vehicles (EVs), encouraging the widespread adoption of EVs, and making a contribution to the transition towards sustainable transportation on a global scale. Our work offers vital insights into the design and optimization of thermal management systems for electric car batteries, which will ultimately pave the way for the next generation of electric vehicles that are both high-performing and long-lasting.

articleTitle: Secure and Efficient Integration of Blockchain, Digital Twins, and Metaverse for Real-Time Asset Management
abstract: This study examines the convergence of blockchain, metaverse, and digital twin technologies in establishing a cohesive and secure virtual ecosystem. In this study, blockchain technology is combined with digital twin and metaverse systems in order to build a safe, unified virtual space of both. Real time monitoring systems for physical assets on which the conditions are being tracked, are called digital twins. Using Digital twins, users can explore virtual spaces to do detailed 3D data assessment. Because the blockchain networks added decentralized security to protect the data well and create trust throughout the platform, the integrated system works. What we researched is about security measures, time synchronization, interaction between digital, physical universe and connecting digital twins, blockchain, and metaverse with one system. Physical virtual matching and blockchain tools to handle secure data sources, smart contract to control automatic system in a secure way are all combination to create a brand new alignment system. In our framework, IoT sensors are first used to inject digital twin replicas in a metaverse with blockchain and proof of stake consensus. The combined use of blockchain technology, digital twin and metaverse tools yields an improvement on security defence and operation optimisation. Latency for regular platforms was cut by 60%, and the new system has reached twice the TPS rate. Using this approach, the system required 0.5 from 1.2 kilowatt hours less energy but operates 0.65 less in processing resources. The real time protection and management of assets were provided by both IoT sensors, blockchain systems, and virtual environments working together. However, in these solutions they overcome the key problems faced by the digital system and make the whole network work in a stronger, and faster way.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Approach for Handling Imbalanced Data for Intrusion Detection in the Cloud Environment
abstract: Cloud computing is a flexible on-demand service provider for pooled access to various software resources. Due to the high demand for the cloud for data storage and access, there are chances of getting it vulnerable to threats associated with data stealing and modifications to it, which results in poor management of cloud environments. Thus, detecting intrusions into cloud platforms is essential to providing better services to users and saving their important data and resources from being misused. Machine learning (ML) plays a massive role in detecting intrusions in cloud environments. Still, the most common problem that is faced is data imbalance as the data collected will consist of few intrusion samples. In contrast, the maximum will be normal ones, which makes the ML biased towards the majority class. Hence, to provide a solution to this problem, this paper aims to propose an approach that utilizes different ML techniques without using any over-sampling or under-sampling techniques for balancing the data. The different ML methods on the imbalanced data are trained to find the most optimal ML method by just optimizing the hyperparameters. The highest accuracy of 100% is achieved by three models, i.e., decision tree, random forest (RF), and XGBoost. However, when comparing the training time, DT and RF are the most promising algorithms for detecting intrusions on big imbalanced data without using any data balancing technique.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Disease Identification and Yield Optimization in Seasonal Agriculture: A Comparative Analysis
abstract: The agricultural industry is essential for global food security, economic stability, and employment, especially in developing countries. Crop diseases represent a substantial risk to productivity, with yearly yield reductions of 20-40%. Traditional illness detection techniques, dependent on eye examination, are frequently sluggish, labour-intensive, and susceptible to mistakes. This research examines the progress in agricultural disease identification, contrasting conventional methods with contemporary technology such as machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and remote sensing. Deep learning models, especially Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), have exhibited exceptional efficacy in disease detection, attaining accuracy rates of 90% in crops such as tomato, potato, and rice. The amalgamation of hyperspectral imaging, drone surveillance, and AI-powered instruments facilitates early illness identification, continuous monitoring, and scalable solutions. The transition to digital agriculture not only optimizes disease management but also increases crop output, facilitating sustainable agricultural techniques to address the rising global food demands.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning for Sentiment Classification from Noisy Data
abstract: The revolutionary impact of transformer architectures on Natural Language Processing decreases substantially because they become ineffective at dealing with ambiguous contexts as well as noisy data distributions and complex dependencies. Therefore, we develop a new Reinforcement Learning approach to improve sentiment classification systems that operate in these demanding environments. Our framework establishes an adaptive instance selection method to improve learning efficiency in heterogeneous and noisy data distributions since it differs from typical processing techniques that need extensive data cleaning with large annotation datasets. The main advancement stems from a process that improves selection protocols step by step while eliminating the detrimental impacts of noisy data samples on model performance. The method presents accurate classification results while avoiding lengthy data-cleaning methods that involve excessive computing resources. Evaluation of the system proves its effectiveness in raising classification accuracy levels which reach 90.5 percent for various benchmarked data types. The presented research findings advance the understanding of combining RL paradigms with language models by suggesting useful pathways to improve model robustness and transfer capability. This framework offers autonomous scalability for practical NLP needs, which avoids most of the existing system limitations. The presented study provides new paths for engineers to create robust language processing systems with the ability to adapt to the processing of challenging real-world linguistic data.

articleTitle: Leveraging Deep Learning Models for Enhanced Detection of Early-Stage Lung Cancer in CT Scan Images
abstract: Patients afflicted with lung cancer have a high mortality rate, making it a deadly condition. It is possible to save patients' lives by detecting this disease early and correctly determining the stage of lung cancer. Medical professionals face challenges when it comes to accurately and quickly diagnosing lung cancer using various image processing, biomarker-based, and machine automation methodologies. This research makes use of CT scan images extracted from lung images acquired at a hospital. Traditional approaches rely on the patient's permission before providing CT scan images to diagnose lung cancer. Lung Cancer Cell Detection using Fusion Neural Network (LCCDC-FNN) is a new approach to early and accurate diagnosis that is proposed in this research article. Deep neural networks are employed to extract the features from the CT scan images. To save patients from this deadly disease, accurate feature extraction is crucial for early detection of malignant cells. This research aims to improve diagnostic accuracy by using an advanced 3D-convolution neural network (3D-CNN) in conjunction with U-Net and Mask R-CNN. Differentiating between benign and malignant tumors is also made possible by the proposed method. The results validate the feasibility of the suggested hybrid deep learning (DL) method for early detection of lung cancer when assessed using conventional statistical methods. The empirical results obtained from the proposed mechanism demonstrate that the proposed improved model provides U-Net, R-CNN and 3D-CNN classifications with 83.4%, 70% and 80.3% accuracy and LCCDC-FNN has accuracy of 98.99%.

articleTitle: Enahanced Text Summarization System Using Machine Learning
abstract: Good communication is vital to modern collaboration, especially in an era when digital networks and remote work are the new standard. The rise of chat-based communication tools has rendered it ever more necessary to report detailed conversations in order to extract critical information. By using advanced chat summarizing methods, this article explores how Artificial Intelligence-fueled Natural Language Processing (NLP) can enhance team collaboration. We focus on the inclusion of big language models (LLMs) combined with AI models such as Groq in automatically supplying abridged discussions of dialogue records to help groups comprehend salient details swiftly without being subjected to extended logs. We demonstrate how AI can make communication processes simpler, reduce mental load, and improve decision-making by building and evaluating a chatbot system using the Telegram API, SQLite as the database for storage, and Groq's AI for summarization. Our approach gives businesses a viable means of maintaining efficiency and transparency in their online discussions through the use of contextual analysis and semantic understanding.

articleTitle: Real Time Automated Sign Language Detection and Translation Using AI and ML Driven Hand Gesture Recognition
abstract: This paper discusses an automatically generated real-time framework towards the conversion of Indian Sign Language into text using artificial intelligence and machine learning methodologies related to hand-gesture recognition. This system uses a CNN model to classify gestures and it processes live video input from the webcam to extract hand gesture features using MediaPipe, trying to bridge this gap in communication for the hearing-impaired community with that of the mainstream society. Thorough analyses include the system architecture, methodologies of data collection, model training, and testing processes iteratively, along with challenges such as changing lighting conditions, hand placement, and gesture speed, and strategies used to overcome these challenges. Promising results show high accuracy in real-time recognition, pointing out the potential of the framework to enhance communication accessibility. Subsequent research endeavors will prioritize the augmentation of the system to facilitate word-level recognition, incorporate multilingual functionalities, and improve its robustness for utilization across varied environments, thereby promoting wider applicability and empowering individuals with special abilities.

articleTitle: Chronic Kidney Disease Risk Prediction Using Machine Learning
abstract: Chronic kidney disease is one of the fast-growing global health issues that necessitates early detection for effective management and treatment. This research article examines the application of ML-based techniques to predict CKD, using clinical data for accurate classification. Three major algorithms are tested here for CKD stage prediction: RF, SVM, and MLP. We also adopt ensemble methods, including hard and soft voting, to make the predictive performance even stronger. Our results show that while SVM has the highest accuracy at 96.25, the ensemble methods provide very robust solutions, with the hard voting yielding an accuracy of 86.33. This research shows the prospect of ML models and techniques of ensemble in improving the diagnosis of CKD, valuable for clinical decision-making and treatment of patients. Future work will concentrate on optimizing these models and integrating them into clinical applications for real-time predictions.

articleTitle: Bi-Lingual Audio Detection for Sentiment Analysis
abstract: This study proposes a hybrid deep learning framework in the field of sentiment analysis of bilingual (Hindi-English) audio recordings, acknowledging the problems caused by code-switching in mixed language conversation. This model based on Bi Directional Long short-term memory (BiLSTM) and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks captures temporal and contextual patterns for the classification of emotions, such as happiness, fear, sadness, and neutrality. Results demonstrate the capability of the model to capture emotional nuances in code-switched audio; these abilities may enable further applications in multilingual environments, including virtual assistants and automated customer support systems. The research establishes a fundamental platform for addressing code-switching problems in audio sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: An Interpretable Decision Tree Model for Ayurvedic Drug Recommendation in Personalized Healthcare
abstract: This study explores the integration of traditional Ayurveda with contemporary machine learning techniques to develop a predictive model for personalized drug recommendation. Using a dataset comprising 1,300 patients samples that detail diseases, demographics, severity levels and corresponding Ayurvedic treatments, a Decision Tree Classifier-based model was constructed to predict Ayurvedic drug prescriptions. Key preprocessing steps, including handling duplicates, null values, and categorical encoding, ensured the data's integrity and usability. The model's predictive capabilities were evaluated against alternative algorithms such as Random Forest, SVM, Logistic Regression, and K-Nearest Neighbors, demonstrating superior accuracy of 95.3% with Decision trees on the test dataset. The proposed system provides an interpretable and robust framework for recommending Ayurvedic treatments based on patient-specific features, emphasizing its clinical applicability and trustworthiness.

articleTitle: Leveraging Ensemble Machine Learning: A Comparative Analysis for Enhanced Credit Card Fraud Detection
abstract: Credit card fraud poses a significant challenge in the financial sector, leading to monetary losses, reputational risks, and decreased consumer trust. Traditional fraud detection methods often fail to keep pace with evolving fraudulent tactics. This study explores real-time fraud detection by evaluating various machine learning techniques, including ensemble methods, KNN, decision trees, logistic regression, and SVM. Using a publicly available dataset that has both fraudulent and legitimate transactions, the models were assessed in the standard metrics while addressing the class imbalance issue. Key performance metrics such as recall, accuracy, precision, and F1-score were used for the evaluation. The study outlines the strengths and weaknesses of each model and suggests advanced deep learning techniques for further enhancement of Fraud Transaction Detection while taking the class imbalance in account. This study underscores the potential of machine learning in improving fraud detection by optimizing precision and recall, effectively reducing errors in practical applications.

articleTitle: Conditional GANs for Enhanced Artistic Synthesis: Improving Quality and Speed Through Innovative Colorization Technique
abstract: Art is a powerful way for people to express their emotions creatively through sketches. These sketches can range from simple black-and-white or grayscale to vibrant, colourful images, with colours often playing a key role in conveying feelings. Even though not everyone may be able to express their emotions through sketches, technology has made it possible for machines to create and enhance these images with colour. One innovative approach, the art model, makes it easier for artists to produce colourful sketches, helping them save time working on projects like magazine illustrations or newspaper graphics. This model involves three main steps: processing the data, creating the artwork, and adding colour, resulting in dynamic and engaging colour sketches. The image quality is significantly enhanced through this approach, as compared to different approaches. Its success is examined using performance measures like popularity and its ability to transform sketches into fully realized images.

articleTitle: Establishing Vehicle to Vehicle Communication using DSRC Protocol for Crash Avoidance
abstract: Vehicle-to-vehicle communication, an emerging technology, enables moving vehicles to exchange data with one another to reduce the likelihood of collisions and enhance road safety for all users. An efficient communication system for intelligent transportation systems is the primary goal of V2V communication protocol. Due to technological advancements, the automotive industry has created autonomous vehicles capable of exchanging data in real-time or preventing collisions. For fast, short-range communication between infrastructure and vehicles, the industry developed DSRC protocol. It was created to assist ITS applications and runs on the 5.9 GHz frequency. This research examines vehicle-to-vehicle communication systems that rely on DSRCs. This study evaluates concepts from several previous studies to provide a comprehensive evaluation of the state of Vehicle-to- Vehicle (V2V) communication systems employing Dedicated Short-Range Communications (DSRC).

articleTitle: Electronic Voting System Using Blockchain Technology
abstract: We discover that the voting mechanism has improved and changed with the aid of the blockchain. Due to its effectiveness in preserving voting integrity, blockchain technology in voting systems aids in election process control and fosters voter trust. The following issues plague the traditional voting system: confidence, security, and transparency. The existing system has frequently been described as being extremely susceptible to various threats, including fraud, hacking, and tampering. These issues can be resolved by blockchain technology, which uses an open-source encrypted ledger to keep track of every vote. Every voter in the automated blockchain voting system has a unique digital identity that is verified by blockchain technology. The vote they cast is then recorded on the blockchain system using their identification. Utilizing the blockchain ensures that votes are secure and unchangeable as long as they are registered in the blockchain database. Since the blockchain is an open platform that permits the voting method to be carried out with the assistance of other platforms, this also avoids the issue of a central authority.

articleTitle: Analyzing Blockchain Technology for Enhancing Security in Smart Home Systems: Current Developments and Future Directions
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) holds a great potential in revolutionizing the development of intelligent home environments. The Internet of Things is seamlessly integrated into our everyday routines, especially in modern smart homes, where it aids in streamlining resource management, enabling convenient remote control, and facilitating pervasive sensing. The use of smart home technology presents a significant challenge due to the range of issues it can cause, including concerns about transparency, security and privacy. The main reason for this is that devices are often used in open networks that may be susceptible to security breaches, due to inadequate device authentication methods, inefficient secure data storage and access procedures, and exposure to various threats. Blockchain shows great potential as a technology that can effectively tackle these challenges and fulfill the necessary criteria. This research study introduces a hybrid blockchain architecture, dynamic key management techniques, cross-domain authentication and lightweight cryptographic solutions to address critical IoT constraints, including security, scalability, latency, interoperability and energy efficiency, providing a unique contribution to advancing smart home security frameworks. In this paper, we studied and analyzed the various research works already done and provided a comprehensive review of current advancements, highlighted the major progress and discussed open challenges for future research directions.

articleTitle: Exploring the Possibilities of Genetic Engineering for Curing Human De-Formities : A Comprehensive Review
abstract: Biotechnology combines biological systems with technology to solve issues and develop valuable products. An essential tool in this field is genetic engineering since it lets researchers modify an organism's DNA to provide desired traits. That means inserting some genes with the help of restriction enzymes, which cut DNA at specific sites, allowing the altered genes to replicate inside the cell. Genetically modified mice and rats are produced with similar techniques, random integration or viral vectors. The great promise of genetic engineering is that it may cure human diseases by correcting the source of many of them, faulty DNA. Most of the time, drugs are temporary, but genetic engineering provides a permanent treatment, either by repairing broken genes, adding healthy copies or silencing bad ones. Gene therapy trials aimed at cystic fibrosis and sickle cell disease, for instance, attempt to treat the genetic defect that causes these diseases. Instead, gene therapy involves the introduction of a functional copy of a damaged or absent gene into the patient's cells. Typically, the therapeutic gene is delivered and inserted into the DNA of the target cells with the help of vectors - such as modified viruses. A promising technique is CRISPR, a revolutionary gene-editing tool that allows scientists to accurately cut specific DNA. CRISPR: Another intriguing technique is CRISPR, a revolutionary gene-editing tool that allows scientists to accurately snip certain sections of DNA, allowing for gene repair, mutation removal, and the insertion of new therapeutic genetic sequences. Gene therapy and CRISPR are still evolving, despite their enormous promise in treating everything from sickle cell anemia to cystic fibrosis.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Cyber-Twin Empowered UAV Assisted MEC Network for IoT: Challenges and Solution
abstract: The ever-increasing amount of Internet of Things (IoT) devices, along with increasing requirements for real-time data analyzing, has given rise to Mobile Edge Computing (MEC), a possible solution. MEC operates by moving processing workloads from resource constrained IoT devices to adjacent edge servers, allowing for speedier analysis of information. However, the resource utilization of these edge servers represents a major concern, particularly in regional or dynamic environments. This is where Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) come in. Owing to their pliability and nimbleness, UAVs enabled by Cyber-Twin (CT) have emerged as possible servers-out-of-reach for distant locations with a new twist on existing infrastructure. This study examines the fascinating possibility of UAVs in improving power consumption across MEC environments. It starts by examining MEC principles and energy issues at edge nodes. Next, discussion leads to the idea of CT empowered UAV assisted MEC which highlights the distinctions between UAVs like flexibility, dexterity, deployment immediacy, etc. In addition, this work explores various techniques and methods that can be used to improve energy utilization in CT empowered UAV-assisted MEC networks such as load shifting techniques, trajectory modeling techniques, resource allocation approaches among others that are aimed at reducing energy consumption yet satisfying application requirements. Finally, actual situations and experimental results are employed to indicate how Cyber-twin empowered UAV-assisted MEC improves energy efficiency and system performance as a whole.

articleTitle: Email Spam Detection Ensemble Methods
abstract: Finding on-demand messages has become a key task in today's generation of virtual verbal exchanges as emails and unsolicited messages flood inboxes. Spammers maximize email messaging system provisioning, especially for the scope of unwanted content that can dampen net overall performance, staff. Loan the records can catch up, and degrade the user experience. This paper provides a thorough look at using the device for unwanted mail detection methods to identify models. Several styles were observed including Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Trees, and Random Forest, Voting Classifier, and other ensemble methods. The data set used consisted of 1,00,000 text messages, equally cut into spam and ham (unsolicited mail) between. Our experimental results show that ensemble methods, especially random forest and alternative classification trees, provide the highest accuracy and precision in junk mail detection, achieving an accuracy of 0.97975. The experiment demonstrates the tool's knowledge-enhancing capabilities; it will likely enhance the security of e-mail messages with powerful junk mail detection.

articleTitle: Enhancing Healthcare with Blockchain: Innovations in Data Privacy, Security, and Interoperability
abstract: The rise of digital technologies has transformed the healthcare industry, enabling smarter and more efficient services. But high data volumes and reliance on centralized systems pose significant challenges, including real-time data sharing functionality and vulnerability to breaches. Blockchain technology offers flexible solutions for distributing data management and ensuring secure, transparent and immutable transactions. This paper explores the use of blockchain in healthcare, emphasizing its potential to improve data privacy, improve communication, and simplify the management of electronic health records (EHRs). Key features of the blockchain such as decentralization, immutability and cryptographic security have been analyzed in the context of healthcare. The review looks at notable developments, including blockchain-based frameworks for secure data shares, smart contracts for automated processes, and parallel healthcare systems combining it with artificial intelligence, as well as enabling efficiencies within the supply chain. This work provides a comprehensive analysis of blockchain's transformative potential and identifies areas for further research to ensure that it has been widely accepted.

articleTitle: Efficient DDoS Detection in Software-Defined Networking: A Machine Learning Perspective
abstract: DDoS attacks are among of the most dangerous forms of attack these days. They are the reason for many security issues in this era all around the globe, particularly in the landscape of SDN where core SDN controlllers are prone to attacks due to their centralized nature. The primary objective of this work is to further the use of machine learning in SDN systems for DDoS attack detection. We performed this research on five machine learning systems, namely Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Support Vector Classifier (SVC), Decision Tree (DT), and Gradient Boosting Classifier (GBC) a hybrid SVC+GBC model with the aid of the DataSet Sdn. The dataset encompasses standard and attacked data of traffic, around 80 factors are included such as packet and protocol details. One hot encoding and feature selection were some of the data pre-processing methods that were introduced to enhance the models. The evaluation methods were accuracy, F1 score, recall, and precision. Our SVC+GBC hybrid model surpassed all the standalone algorithms, 99.77% accuracy and an F1 Score of 99.76%. To sum up, the use of detection methods based on machine learning can greatly boost the defense of SDN network to DDoS attacks.

articleTitle: A Real Time Approach to Recognize Facial Expression Based on Scoring System for Restaurants
abstract: In this modern era the Automated and unmanned restaurants have started witnessing a surge in demand and popularity, however, customers feedback and any details regarding their experience at the restaurant are hardly able to be registered in such systems. To this issue, this outlines a novel method of scoring customer satisfaction through facial expression recognition that integrates a deep learning model based on Efficient MobileNet for feature extraction and Long Short-Term Memory for emotions time sequence analysis. This hybrid method takes into account both topological and chronological aspects of facial motions. The system consists of web applications for users, a web server for receiving requests and an AI server that receiving, evaluates the image of a person's facial expression and classifies their emotional state into three categories-satisfied, neutral and disappointed so it can be used to understand feedback about food quality and the dining area. Also, improved effectiveness is achieved by using MobileNet and LSTM the fusion is lightweight while being accurate for real time facial expression recognition.

articleTitle: Bi-CANet: Bidirectional Contextual Alignment with Multimodal Decoder for Image Captioning
abstract: Image captioning is an approach for precisely summarizing image contents using natural language processing. Leveraging cutting-edge feature extraction, multimodal encoding, and fusion strategies, visual and textual fragments are correlated within a latent space. These multimodal segments are analyzed by a deep sequential model for phrase decoding. The widely used CNN-LSTM encoder-decoder pipeline is central to image captioning frameworks. However, current architectures suffer from two major limitations: (1) existing frameworks employ a unidirectional fusion and sequential decoding process, failing to capture the semantic context against both the preceding and following tokens; and (2) static multimodal translation fails to grasp and align critical information accurately, limiting its effectiveness when training on diverse datasets with varied visual and linguistic samples. Consequently, the models fail to capture the expansive and intricate context, leading to the production of short and abstract captions. To address these limitations, we propose Bi-CANet, an end-to-end bidirectional multimodal contextual alignment network for image captioning. Bi-CANet employs a dual-directional fusion of visual details with textual phrases along with a bidirectional decoder, thereby aligning the rich semantic and spatial context over both the preceding and subsequent phrases. Experimental analysis shows that Bi-CANet is more effective in generating comprehensive captions when trained on diverse datasets. Specifically, it achieves BLEU-1 scores of 54.02%, and METEOR scores of 33.11% on the Flickr 8K dataset.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Early Brain Stroke Detection Using Genetic Algorithm
abstract: Stroke is a main source of mortality, disability in the world, and early detection is the only way for effective intervention and treatment of it. This research, we have compared methods by using ML and DL for early diagnosis of stroke using brain imaging data. While CNN, ResNet, and BiLSTM are used in DL, SVM and KNN algorithms are used ML with the genetic algorithm. It categorizes images of stroke and normal brain to provide accurate analysis. Each preprocessing step has been undertaken for ensuring quality data consistency. In the machine learning field, the experiment shows at an early detection stage the deep learning techniques are better than that of conventional methods. Thus, they can automatically define features more prominently, recognize complex patterns that are likely to be present within medical images due to models of DL, which further aids in stroke detection. Performance metrics of the each algorithm will be tested and the best performing model is identified when a stroke is found. CNN showed higher accuracy and performance evaluated with a accuracy 99% followed by BiLSTM at 90%, while traditional ML models had much lower values, with KNN at 88%, SVM at 86%, and ResNet at 86% for these parameters. In fact, these approaches are going to give a direction on whether these methods might be taken to the clinic and door-opening instruments for better early diagnosis tools of strokes.

articleTitle: Blockchain and AI-Driven Palmprint Biometrics for Secure Voting Systems in E-Governance Applications
abstract: This study introduces a secure voting system enhancing voter authentication, data integrity by integrating blockchain technology with an AI-driven biometric scheme, palmprint. The proposed method ensures that fraudulent voting is eliminated and allows trust within the election process in applications of e-governance because of the use of distributed ledger technology and reliable biometric verification. The system leverages the use of smart contracts to enable safe and secure transactions. It makes use of a CNN that has been trained on the PolyU Palmprint Database to check and authenticate palm prints. Simulation results show that the AI model presents phenomenal performance with 99.85% authentication accuracy and 35.42 transaction/sec blockchain free of data integrity issues. The system is also assured of an error-free user experience, excellent scalability, and lower latency. The proposed framework presents an excellent solution towards addressing the apprehensions regarding security and efficacy about the digital voting system that promotes safe and translucent e-governance.

articleTitle: Inventory Optimization for Deteriorating Products Using Exponential Demand Forecasting and Machine Learning with Carbon Emission Constraints
abstract: In today's business environment, companies implement highly advanced machine learning algorithms to calculate product demand and evaluate inventory levels. In the present research, we constructed a Degradation-based inventory model that incorporates Carbon emission, partial waiting lists, and exponentially forecasted demand. Since degradation and the rate of imperfections are both unpredictable and often difficult to accurately measure, we are treating them as fuzzy variables to represent a more realistic real-world scenario. This study proposed a method to determine the optimal order quantity and replenishment schedule that minimizes the average total cost while accounting for carbon emission expenditures. The sign distance approach is used for the defuzzification process, and demand is assumed to increase exponentially. The proposed method has been validated with numerical examples that demonstrate how demand for deteriorating products can be calculated monthly, enabling firms to optimize inventory management based on expected demand. Furthermore, a comparison between monthly predicted demand and fixed demand has been conducted, highlighting the advantages of the exponential demand model.

articleTitle: Multiple Manifold Regularization Based on Non-Negative Matrix Factorization for Multi-View Clustering
abstract: In recent years, non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) cluster analysis of multi-view data has shown outstanding results in data mining and machine learning. Multi-view data typically encompasses complementary elements from multiple perspectives. Finding a consensus solution that works for all the different views is a difficult task. This study proposes a novel NMF-based clustering method that utilizes various manifold regularizations for multi-view data to address the previously mentioned problem. In this method, the NMF will decompose the input data into the two non-negative matrices. Next, we employ the manifold scenario to preserve the geometric structure within the data. Lastly, we design the novel objective function by combining all the earlier mentioned terms and then optimize it using the iterative strategy method to achieve the optimal solution. The empirical analysis of real-world datasets indicates that the proposed method outperforms numerous existing techniques in clustering efficiency.

articleTitle: GAN-based data augmentation with recurrent residual U - Net for exudate segmentation in diabetic retinopathy
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a leading cause of vision impairment worldwide, often characterized by the presence of retinal lesions such as exudates. Hard exudates (HE), which appear as bright lesions in retinal fundus images, are an early and critical indicator of DR, making their accurate detection vital for timely diagnosis and intervention. Despite improvements in medical imaging, creating reliable deep learning models for HE segmentation is largely affected by the scarcity of annotated datasets. Recent studies on classifying the segmentation of sub-lesions in retinal images face a significant challenge due to the limited diversity of datasets. In this study, we propose an approach that combines Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) for data augmentation with a Recurrent Residual U-Net (R2U-Net) architecture for segmentation. Through the use of GANs, this study addresses the dataset scarcity issue caused by the time-intensive process of manual annotation. The datasets - IDRiD and E-Ophtha - were used to assess our model after it was trained on the IDRiD dataset. Performance comparisons were conducted between models trained on (i) original dataset with no augmentation (ii) original dataset with traditional/offline augmentation, (iii) synthetic dataset made with augmented orig-inal dataset and GAN-generated images. The GAN-augmented dataset achieved the best metrics: IoU 0.9319, DSC 0.9435, accu-racy 0.9926, sensitivity 0.9554, and specificity 0.9930, surpassing recent literature.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Incoming Calls on Helpdesk
abstract: In the present dynamic and highly competitive environment, sentiment analysis of incoming calls to helpdesks has been established as a critical tool in the improvement of both customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. This paper presents the implementation of a framework for sentiment analysis intended to automatically classify customer emotions over the course of helpdesk interactions. For the interpretation of the audio from call recordings into written text, speech-to-text technology is applied, and services can be Google Speech API or IBM Watson. Preprocessing steps include noise removal and text normalization, followed by tokenization before further processing. Performance metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score of the models are measured, thereby improving the performance. For real-time needs during helpdesk interactions, the system has also been interfaced with call management software, providing instant feed for sentiment analysis for guidance to agents and supervisors. The project involved such challenges as noisy and possibly unstructured audio data were being processed, imbalances in sentiment classes in datasets, scalability for large scale deployments, and ethical points of considerations like user private issues or biases in general that were avoided in the implementation. The results indicate that the offered framework achieves an accuracy above 85% in classifying sentiments, while at the same time, significantly improving helpdesk service operations by indicating important calls that need instant attention. This study marks the ability of sentiment analysis to revolutionize customer service by facilitating proactive, empathetic interaction that goes a long way to further customer satisfaction and favorable business results.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Protein Secondary Structure Prediction Models
abstract: Proteins are vital for numerous biological functions, and understanding their secondary structure is essential for unravelling their function. Predicting secondary protein's structure has been the focus of extensive study throughout the years. This article brings forth an rigorously overview of the latest advanced methods and approaches used for protein secondary structure prediction also aims to come up with researchers and practitioners in the field with a valuable resource for advancing the creation of dependable and precise contraption for anticipating protein secondary structures. This paper presents a benchmarking study of different secondary structure prediction methods, evaluating their accuracy, strengths, and limitations. We discuss widely used techniques such as the Chou-Fasman method, GOR method, PHD method, and more recent approaches based on machine learning and deep learning. This detailed summary is designed to assist researchers in determining the most suitable method for their specific needs research requirements and further the field of protein structure prediction.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Skin Lesions from Medical Images Using a Fusion of CNN and RNN Models
abstract: The necessity for accurate detection of skin cancer has led to very significant advances in medical image analysis, mainly through the application of deep learning models. Detection of early skin lesions such as basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, keratoacanthoma, and melanoma is highly critical for improving patient outcomes and treatment efficiency. A combination of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) is used in this research to improve the classification and prediction of skin lesions. CNN models VGGI6, VGGI9, and ResNet50 are applied to spatial features in skin lesion images, while RNNs manage the handling of temporal data such as lesion growth, treatment responses, and follow-up records. The models are trained to differentiate between various skin cancers and predict disease progression. The performance evaluations prove that the VGG 19 + RNN model presented the highest accuracy at a level of 96.76%, having both precision and recall, proving that the performance is also strong at the F1-score. VGG16 + RNN and ResNet50 + RNN followed in order, with slightly lower performances, which demonstrate the potential for CNN-RNN fusion to tackle complex diagnostic tasks. The VGG 19 + RNN model's excellent results make it the preferable candidate for real-time clinical applications since it can function with the capabilities of both image and temporal data. It is thus a good source for automatically diagnosed skin cancer, providing efficient, reliable means to healthcare professionals for the early detection and monitoring of treatment. This study highlights the potential that deep learning models can have in transforming medical diagnostics, offering a scale-up solution for improved detection of skin cancer and patient care.

articleTitle: Examining Driver Sleepiness Detection Based on Visual Actions Using Haar Cascading and CNN
abstract: Every hour, there are numerous road accidents all over the world. Some of these accidents are caused by drunk driving, lack of sleep, inattention behind the wheel, and a variety of other factors that can be dangerous for both passengers and other road users. The most frequent circumstance is sleeping deprivation, which can cause the driver to be reckless while operating a motor vehicle. Driver drowsiness detection systems are particularly effective in identifying drowsiness by measuring the size of the driver's eyes and the rate at which they blink using a camera and software that is connected to it. The driver fatigue detection system works utterly offline, leveraging the Haar Cascade and Perclos machine learning methodologies, and can warn the driver via alarm if he or she is feeling drowsy.

articleTitle: Improving IoT Service Quality with the Allocation of Dynamic Bandwidth
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) effectively facilitates interaction between individuals and devices in contemporary society. The IoT industry is experiencing substantial growth annually, attributed to many applications, from miniature sensors to large-scale industrial equipment. The proliferation of billions of connected devices creates distinctive business opportunities, while IoT applications contribute to economic enhancement. The IoT market is rapidly growing; yet, it encounters several challenges, including security issues, heterogeneity, and absence of defined protocols, communication topology, and bandwidth (BW) selection. This paper aims to enhance the comprehension of providing Internet of Things devices with stable bandwidth to increase communication. This article primarily contributes an elucidation of mechanisms associated with optimized dynamic bandwidth selection, prevalent protocols, and network topologies.

articleTitle: Automate Stock and Crypto Research Using Python and Machine Learning
abstract: This paper focuses on automating the analysis of financial news for stocks and cryptocurrencies, thereby providing traders and analysts with actionable insights. In today's fast-paced markets, being up-to-date is the need of the hour; however, manual analysis takes time. To overcome this challenge, the paper employs Python and deep learning tools to make the process of collecting, summarizing, and conducting sentiment analysis on relevant news articles much easier. The key assets analyzed are popular stocks and cryptocurrencies, such as Tesla, Gamestop, Bitcoin, and Ethereum. The system uses Hugging Face's Pegasus model, which is a state-of-the-art transformer, to summarize lengthy financial news into concise, manageable summaries. This reduces the effort required to sift through large amounts of information while preserving essential details. Moreover, the system applies pre-trained sentiment analysis models to gauge the market's overall sentiment-positive, negative, or neutral-toward specific assets, thus making quick and informed trading decisions possible. The paper workflow includes automatically scraping web sources such as Google News and Yahoo Finance, cleaning and processing the data, and exporting results in structured CSV files for further analysis. The files include the ticker symbols, sentiment scores, confidence levels, URLs, and summary text. It is scalable and flexible so that users can input their stock tickers and run real-time analysis with changes in market conditions. Overall, this paper provides an efficient, end-to-end solution for financial news analysis, allowing users to make informed decisions with reduced time and effort on data gathering and interpretation.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Schizophrenia Using Sequential CNN
abstract: Schizophrenia is a severe mental health illness that can greatly affect cognitive and social functioning. An early diagnosis is undoubtedly critical for timely intervention and may improve disease outcomes and minimize long-term disablement. This proposed a new approach to diagnosing schizophrenia using Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals, processed by a Sequential Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). From there they utilized the CBB-MIT dataset which has many EEG data, using wavelet to transform the data into fewer noise, and then by extracting some statistical features from the improved data and used it for classification. The final output is a vector passed through the final dense layer with softmax activation we got the probability over the given classes. The model gets 92% accuracy and a loss rate of 9.89%, which is better than old ML methods like SVM (Support Vector Machines) and RF (Random Forest). Unlike traditional approaches that need a lot of feature work, the Sequential CNN finds important patterns on its own, making it more scalable and efficient. The results show great promise, but to guarantee generalizability, additional validation on other datasets and actual clinical trials is required. Additionally, ethical issues need to be taken into account, that include patient data protection and the responsible utilization of AI in the medical decision-making. Future work will focus on integrating multiple diagnostic criteria and developing a user-friendly interface for facilitating clinical adoption. Findings highlight deep learning's role in advancing mental health diagnostics, offering a promising direction for improving schizophrenia detection.

articleTitle: Methodologies for Ensuring Robust Cybersecurity in Health Care Agencies for the Purpose of Securing Medical Internet of Things Devices
abstract: Improvements in patient tracking, diagnosis, and treatment have resulted from the widespread use of MIoT devices in healthcare organizations. Patient safety and sensitive health data are at danger due to the increased number of linked devices, which has brought about major cybersecurity issues such as illegal access, data breaches, and service disruptions. This study delves into different approaches to guarantee strong cybersecurity in healthcare organizations, with a particular emphasis on safeguarding MIoT devices. Anomaly detection systems, secure communication protocols, device authentication, and end-to-end encryption are some of the key tactics that are investigated. In addition, the research looks into how machine learning and AI may be used for predictive analytics and real-time threat detection in MIoT networks, and how blockchain technology can guarantee data integrity and safe communication in these networks. Following legal standards like HIP AA and creating multi-layered security measures to reduce risks are also emphasized in the research. The goal of this study is to present a thorough framework for protecting MIoT devices in healthcare settings, guaranteeing patient safety and data confidentiality by integrating established cybersecurity practices with new technology. Additionally, issues like managing a diverse ecosystem of MIoT devices and device resource limits are discussed, along with suggestions for adaptable security solutions that are lightweight. The results provide healthcare organizations with practical advice on how to strengthen the security of their systems and prevent cyberattacks on their MIoT infrastructure.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Emerging Challenges and Solutions in Cloud Computing
abstract: Cloud computing has revolutionized the IT industry by providing affordable, scalable, and on-demand services. High operating expenses, insufficient standardization, and security vulnerabilities are only a few of the issues that organizations encounter, despite the broad use of this technology. This article provides a thorough study of the main difficulties in cloud settings, focusing on data breaches, API vulnerabilities, and jurisdictional problems. Furthermore, it delves into the intricacies of costs, covering pricing structures and techniques for financial optimization as well as the continuous battle for cloud standardization and interoperability. We highlight current trends and mitigation solutions through a comprehensive examination of existing literature and industry reports. We design our proposed approach to assess these difficulties in an organized manner, incorporating security frameworks, cost optimization strategies, governance principles, and more. Researchers, cloud service providers, and companies seeking to improve cloud security, efficiency, and compliance may use the results to inform their actions. In the end, we talk about some possible areas that need more research. These include AI-driven cloud security approaches, ways to manage many clouds, and how quantum computing might affect these areas.

articleTitle: Automating Security in Blockchain: ML-Driven Smart Contract Vulnerability Analysis
abstract: As with the increasing usage of blockchain especially in decentralized systems, the need for solid security measures increases to stop vulnerabilities in smart contracts. Our method is an ML-based solution to automate the detection of smart contract vulnerabilities and improves the blockchain security. In this paper, we propose a comprehensive vulnerability detection algorithm that employs a hybrid detection mechanism that analyzes transaction patterns and uses ML models to detect suspicious activities on the fly. The algorithm detects as well as flags smart contract vulnerabilities and malicious transactions by analyzing transaction amounts, user behavior, and frequency. The developed framework not only lessens manual effort but also automates validation so as to improve mitigation process in case of unforeseen risks. This essentially shows the capability of using ML-driven analysis to secure the blockchain environment as an adaptable approach for the detection of smart contract vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: Exploring Cloud Security Challenges: An In-depth Analysis of Emerging Threats and Mitigation Strategies
abstract: Cloud computing has revolutionized the way organizations store, process, and manage data. However, the increasing reliance on cloud services raises significant security concerns. This paper explores the critical challenges in cloud security, including data breaches, compliance issues, and vulnerabilities in shared infrastructure. It also examines current strategies employed to mitigate these risks, such as encryption, access control, and multi-factor authentication. Furthermore, the paper highlights emerging trends and technologies in cloud security, including AI-driven security solutions and the implementation of zero-trust architectures. By understanding the landscape of cloud security, organizations can better protect their data and maintain trust with their stakeholders. As more companies migrate their activities to the cloud, robust security measures have become top priority. This research is exploring the main challenges of cloud security and focusing on software development approaches, multi-layered encryption, IAM, and threat detection using artificial intelligence and machine learning.

articleTitle: Enhanced Rheumatoid Arthritis Treatment Optimization Through Deep Learning
abstract: Inflammation and joint destruction are hallmarks of Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA), a chronic autoimmune condition. To improve patient outcomes, it is essential to optimize treatment plans. According to this research, integrating deep learning (DL) methods into a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) provides a new method to optimize RA treatments. The CNN model is used to decipher intricate medical data, such as imaging and patient records, find trends, and predict how patients react to treatment. To assess the efficacy of the proposed model in predicting ideal treatment methods, it was trained on a large dataset that included patient images and clinical data. The CNN model offers a potential tool for doctors to adapt RA management plans since results show it significantly improves prediction accuracy and treatment personalization. This method allows for data-driven decisions in RA management, improving patient care and enhancing treatment performance.

articleTitle: Dynamic Partitioning of 3D Scenes into User-Bounding Boxes for Immersive Metaverse Experience
abstract: The partitioning of 3-dimensional environments into user-specific bounding boxes, accompanied by immersive audio and visual experiences, presents a significant challenge in virtual and augmented reality systems. This study examines methods for the adaptive segmentation and management of virtual environments to improve user interaction and immersion. The system utilizes spatial partitioning algorithms such as octrees, Voronoi diagrams, and bounding volume hierarchies to dynamically allocate regions of 3D space according to the needs of individual users. Immersive audio experiences utilize directional sound rendering via Head-Related Transfer Functions and dynamic audio zones, whereas adaptive visual rendering incorporates techniques like level of detail, frustum culling, and real-time lighting adjustments. The proposed framework integrates AI-driven personalization, procedural content generation, and gesture-based interaction to establish context-aware and responsive environments. Synchronization among networked devices enables smooth transitions in multi-user environments, supported by edge computing and consensus algorithms. This research addresses the technical complexities of real-time dynamic partitioning and immersive multimodal experiences to enhance user engagement and redefine interaction paradigms in virtual spaces. The proposed solutions exhibit scalability and adaptability for use in gaming, training simulations, and collaborative metaverse environments.

articleTitle: Smart Robotic Crop Replanting and Recovery Using CNNs and Edge Computing
abstract: The growing need for precision agriculture contributes to integrating advanced technology to enhance agricultural yield and sustainability. This research presents an advanced intelligent robotic crop replanting and recovery system, incorporating Dense Convolutional Networks (DenseNet) and Edge Computing. The system is designed to function autonomously in agricultural settings, offering the ability to analyze and make decisions in real-time. The DenseNet architecture, known for effectively transmitting features and mitigating the vanishing-gradient issue, is used to analyze complex multispectral images obtained by the robotic system. Using this deep learning (DL) technique allows for the precise identification of failing crops, enabling the detection of regions that need replanting or recovery with high accuracy. By integrating Edge Computing, data processing moves close to the source, resulting in a substantial reduction in latency and enabling quick action to be taken in the field. The proposed approach utilizes the advantages of DenseNet and Edge Computing to improve the efficiency of crop management operations, reduce resource waste, and increase crop output. This method is advantageous in agricultural operations of significant size, where quick and accurate interventions are crucial for preserving crop health and yield. The findings indicate that the system can completely transform traditional agricultural methods, providing a scalable solution for the sustainable and effective management of crops in the era of intelligent farming.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Redefined: Forecasting and Fault Detection in Households
abstract: Currently, the state of the environment is a crucial challenge. Every day, we face the difficulty of the rising heat across the globe. Radiant emotions regarding environmental enhancement concern the majority of our daily lives. However, mainly urbanization modifies the environment for the worse. Urbanization is accompanied by relatively high energy and natural resource demand. Since energy consumption is rising in both households and industries, action needs to be taken to save energy. Our study will assist in lowering electricity costs and improving the efficiency of energy use. Efficient energy utilization has to be instigated at the household level. According to reports, millions of units of the energy produced is used by families. This research attempts to address that problem by focusing light on a domestic modeling system that includes the most popular appliances and examining energy-use patterns along with estimates for their energy consumption. A structural model that will be developed may provide the understanding and prediction of the energy use of a single house or a neighborhood. The model will be utilized for energy demand management after it has been modified and validated. If any anomalies are found in the consumption of the electricity by any devices an email alert is sent to the user.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach For Detecting Earth's Surface Anomalies Using Satellite Imagery
abstract: Abrupt and accelerated transformations in the Earth's landmass, whether resulting from natural disasters or human activities, pose significant risks to human well-being and infrastructure.
