Effective humanitarian aid and disaster relief (HADR) efforts demand expeditious and precise detection of such anomalies. To address these challenges, this work introduces a novel approach for detecting earth surface anomalies using single-view Very High Resolution (VHR) satellite imagery and the advanced U-Net++ convolutional neural network architecture. U-Net++ leverages enhanced image segmentation techniques, capturing both local and global features by extracting critical information from satellite images through a hierarchical and multi-scale framework. The architecture's nested and dense skip connections improve segmentation accuracy by preserving fine details and global context simultaneously. Unlike traditional methods, U-Net++ optimizes the process by combining down sampling and feature refinement in its encoder-decoder structure to deliver precise and pixel-level classification of anomalies. This design accelerates detection and enhances efficiency while minimizing data requirements. A binary classification approach is employed to distinguish anomalies effectively at the image level. Comprehensive evaluation is performed using satellite imagery datasets and real-world case studies to benchmark U-Net++ against existing models, demonstrating its superior accuracy and robustness. The architecture strong generalization capabilities make it a powerful tool for real-time anomaly identification across diverse scenarios, including those with limited annotated datasets. This innovative approach highlights the potential of U-Net++ in advancing anomaly detection for earth surface monitoring and disaster management.

articleTitle: Book Recommendation System Using Hybrid Content and Collaborative Filtering Techniques
abstract: In this study, the process of producing a book recommendation system outlines the process of finding books to provide personalized suggestions according to user preference and behavior. The system increases user satisfaction by tailoring recommendations to their tastes, improving the overall reading experience, and enhancing engagement and retention on plat-forms. It tracks users with collaborative filtering. interactions, content-based filtering to study book characteristics such as genre and author, and mixed methods to combine both techniques that will help ensure accuracy and circumvent similar limitations of cold start problems. Machine learning models-, pre-processing of data algorithms, and accuracy and recall measures of analysis ensure the effectiveness of the system in providing individualized and relevant recommendations that are 85% accurate. The findings reveal test the system's capacity to generate good suggestions, improving user experience and engagement. Improvements in the future could include real-time recommendations and broader feedback integration towards further optimization in accuracy and usability.

articleTitle: Non-Governmental Organization Funding with Blockchain
abstract: Although a relationship between NGOs and their donors is based more on trust, donors would expect N GOs to demonstrate legitimacy and accountability this time. Transparency is at the core of building such confidence, and recent technological innovation advances, specifically blockchain, reveal new possibilities for greater accountability in the NGO sector. Blockchain is a trust less system that can confirm transactions on its own without the assistance of an external party, thus building trust between NGOs and donors. There are various major domains related to the application of blockchain in the N GO sector. Many research gaps exist regarding effective knowledge of blockchain compared to other approaches that validate its effectiveness in promoting transparency and accountability. Research has shown that blockchain technology has a high-efficiency level of about 95% in increasing the reliability of donation-tracing mechanisms. However, almost 90% of non-governmental organizations (NGOs) are reluctant to adopt such innovations. The most significant technologies driving such innovations include blockchain, smart contracts, decentralized applications (DApps), distributed ledger technology (DLT), and data analytics, which all playa vital role in increasing transparency in donation systems. While blockchain has tremendous potential to transform the way NGOs engage with donors, organizations are faced with severe challenges in its application. Such challenges tend to come from change resistance and the difficulty in adopting and maintaining new technologies. The need to carry out comprehensive research to overcome such challenges and investigate how blockchain can increase transparency and accountability in N GO operations remains the number one priority.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Fennel Variety Classification in India: Employing CNN and RNN to Distinguish Florence, Selma, and Perfection
abstract: The study presents a new mix of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) for more accurate fennel-kind sorting. It shows an amazing 92.64% accuracy in telling Florence, Selma, and Perfection styles apart. This model uses pictures and order data to tell apart the complex differences between these fennel types. Preparing the images included making them all 224x224 pixels, and then adding extra changes and adjustments to make sure they worked better with the computer model. There were over 10 thousand pictures in total. The model design combines CNNs for handling images and RNNs to analyze sequences, showing high precision and trustworthiness in sorting. Precision, recall, and F1 scores show how well the model can find and get examples of each fennel type right. Comparing it with other methods, the model is more accurate. This makes fennel-type classification a big step forward using modern techniques. The idea's results go beyond farming, showing how flexible it is in many ways of classifying things. Its power in farming gives farmers an automatic tool to guide their crops. This helps with growing methods, attracting markets, and ensuring quality control of the produce for sale. But, in the plan to make it work better for huge amounts of data and look at more ways to study information. This study is a big step forward in automatic sorting methods. It helps make advancements in smart farming and opens doors for high-tech machine learning uses on plant groupings.

articleTitle: Lung Diseases Identification from Chest Radiographs based on Transfer Learning
abstract: In the year 2019 global health crisis rapidly evolved into a worldwide medical emergency. This respiratory illness presents signs like pneumonia, tiredness, harsh cough, as well as high temperature that may confused you with other conditions like lung cancer, tuberculosis (TB), or typical pneumonia. As a result, rapid and accurate diagnosis is crucial to reduce mortality rates among patients. Medical facilities frequently use chest X-rays (CXR) for quick and precise diagnoses. Deep learning (DL) algorithms have shown remarkable potential in identifying various kinds of diseases that affect human lungs, significantly expediting the process of diagnosing various lungs disease supporting medical professionals. The dataset consists of CXR images: 3616 images of coronavirus disease, 6012 images of lung opacity disease, 1345 images of Pneumonia contaminated lungs, also 10,192 images of lungs that are normal. These images are pre-processed, which include resizing of the images also the normalizing and at random divided them in order to fulfil the requirements of our neural network model based deep learning architecture. The implementation utilizes transfer learning, employing a previously trained ResNet50 architecture, afterward additional convolutional units and fully connected layers. The experimental results demonstrated that the ResNet50 + Fully Connected NN model surpassed existing methods, attaining 97.09% of overall accuracy, 96.97% of recall value, 97.17% of precision value, 92.30% of F1 score, and an 98.85% of AUC value (Area Under Curve). This model offers an efficient tool for physicians to examine also manage lung diseases further effectively, faster patient treatment and care.

articleTitle: The Convergence of Artificial Intelligence and Healthcare in Revolutionizing Diagnosis, Treatment, and Personalization: A Review
abstract: A new era in medical diagnosis, treatment, and patient care is dawning with the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into healthcare. AI's growing proficiency in areas such as deep learning (DL), neural networks, and big data analytics is enhancing the accuracy of disease diagnoses, personalizing treatment plans, and simplifying healthcare operations. AI-driven technologies are outpacing traditional approaches in terms of speed and accuracy, from disease diagnosis via medical imaging to genetic predisposition prediction and medication discovery. In medical imaging, AI-powered algorithms have matched or even surpassed human competence in disease classification. Furthermore, genomics and proteomics benefit from AI's capacity to understand complex biological data, enabling precise therapeutic interventions. Despite these achievements, extensive AI deployment in healthcare raises ethical and technical concerns. Data privacy concerns, algorithmic bias, and the “black-box” nature of AI decision-making all raise trust and accountability concerns. Additionally, the lack of large, high-quality datasets continues to make it hard to use AI in therapeutic situations. Healthcare workers, AI researchers, and lawmakers all need to work together to solve these problems. As AI gets better, it will be combined with human skills to change the future of medicine. This will make care more personalized, effective, and open to everyone.

articleTitle: An Overview of DeepFake Video Detection and Mitigation
abstract: The rapid development of deepfake technology, driven by artificial intelligence and machine learning advancements, creates a significant challenge to authenticity in digital media. With deep fakes, for instance, the manipulation of images, videos, or audio to create hyper-realistic but fabricated content forms a tool for spreading disinformation, committing cyber crimes, and further eroding public trust. This study systematically reviews the numerous methods implemented in deep fake detection research, such as deep learning-based techniques, machine learning approaches, statistical analysis, and blockchain technologies. To this end, it further classifies available detection methodologies, critically examines their respective effectiveness, and compares advantages and disadvantages for each category. Additionally, the importance of datasets to the process of training a model, a discussion on metrics, model generalization issues, as well as other related problems will be identified in the performance of the deepfake model. In addition, this study will aim to develop more efficient and scalable systems for deepfake detection so that the threat posed by media manipulation in the age of digital can be alleviated.

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Glaucoma Detection Framework using Explainable AI and LLMs
abstract: Glaucoma is a group of diseases that can lead to partial or complete blindness due to excessive pressure on the eyes, often caused by anxiety or depression. This pressure damages the optic nerve. The condition requires close, regular cooperation between doctors and patients over time. The increasing number of screenings and time constraints on medical practitioners can lead to errors in disease identification and treatment. Many attempts have been made to automate glaucoma screening and provide interpretability to ensure reliable and accurate solutions. A proposed multi-modal approach combines LIME and Generative AI to help medical practitioners detect glaucoma and provide explanations

articleTitle: Mini CNC Milling Machine
abstract: This paper describes the designing and implementation process of a precision CNC milling machine based on expensive and resource-consuming CNC milling machines. This machine, based on the usage of stepper motors, trimming tools, CAD software, and G-code programming, creates precision machining. The system is intended to be inexpensive and productive, making it suitable for both small-scale manufacturing and educational purposes. The machine is initially designed on CAD software, whose dimensions and geometries are enhanced for optimal performance. Stepper motors were chosen to ensure high precision and reliable control of the machine's axes. G-code is the general programming language accepted by most CNC systems, essentially serving as the foundation for specifying tool paths and machining tasks. We describe the integration of mechanical, electrical, and software components in a high-fidelity prototype designed to perform high-precision milling operations. Confirmation tests show that the machine can produce parts of impressive fidelity. CNC milling machines are widely applied for cutting through various materials. They have great opportunities for further improvement in educational and small-scale production environments, supported by the economy and versatility such devices can afford. This paper concludes with recommendations for system performance improvement and a better fitting of the system into numerous kinds of software environments.

articleTitle: The Role of AI in Optimizing Healthcare Appointment Scheduling
abstract: AI is the most interesting area of healthcare, which is currently making its way into the medical field. Artificial Intelligence has become a game changer, in the healthcare industry bringing forth solutions to problems. A particular area of focus for AI advancements in years has been appointment scheduling with the aim of improving efficiency and accessibility for patients. To overcome these challenges AI technologies have been utilized to develop scheduling systems that utilize data-driven insights and machine learning algorithms. This paper is to investigate appointment scheduling systems in the healthcare sector. The healthcare sector is a major part of the economy. Through surveys, the appointment scheduling system can improve its efficiency. Artificial Intelligence proposes methods for advancing appointment scheduling, which helps control the scheduling window. It can reduce patient no-shows, manage long waitlists, take rapid action over medical urgency, and enhance the department's use of resources for outpatients. Further, the paper examines the problem of appointment management in the healthcare sector considering the various outcoming problems. This paper overlooks the different components of Artificial Intelligence that are applied to the appointment system. We also observe the challenges in the system and the open issues. The objective is to improve the appointment system in the healthcare sector and regulate it with the advancement of Artificial Intelligence.

articleTitle: Optimizing Revenue Generation in E-Commerce: An Analysis of Customer Purchase Intent Using Machine Learning Technique
abstract: In the rapidly changing world of electronic commerce, knowing and predicting what makes people buy things is key to making money. This research tests out how effective machine learning can be in analyzing customer data sets collected from e- commerce platforms. The researchers use a dataset gleaned from the UC Irvine Machine Learning Repository, which provides multiple predictors about user behavior during site visits as well as an outcome variable denoting whether they made purchases or not. Given that there are imbalances between different classes' representation rates within this sample size, our aim is developing classification models for purchase intentions while still considering such discrepancies [1]. In other words - through this project we want to find out what variables contribute most towards buying something online among all others available. The most appropriate algorithm turns out to be Random Forests due its stable performance over various runs where many decision trees get built simultaneously using different subsets of training data; then each tree votes independently so final predictions come from multiple paths thus reducing bias caused by using single model alone. When Hyperparameters are tuned, models tend generalize better by controlling complexity reduce overfitting improve predictive accuracy. This study concludes with suggestions for online firms, indicating how they can make use of machine learning findings in order to promote sales directed at specific customers and maximize profits. In general, such an investigation contributes towards furthering knowledge on data-based methods for comprehending revenue creation within electronic commerce settings.

articleTitle: Real-Time Anomaly Detection in Telecommunications: Advanced Data Mining Techniques for Fraud Identification
abstract: Recently, the telecom fraud issues are so intense that it has become difficult for industry professionals, not just because of monetary loss but because it tarnishes the reputation of the firm as well. In any case, real time analysis and monitoring systems are critical in curbing such transactions and activities. The main purpose of this paper is to analyze how mining processes can help in detecting telecommunication fraud from the interactions of the users, which generate significant amounts of data. In this paper, different methods of machine learning are applied: clustering, decision trees and anomaly detection to identify unusual call patterns, unauthorized use, and impersonation. To detect suspicious actions, a combination of time and frequency data from various mobile operators is used for model training and testing. The goal of this study is to improve the accuracy of fraud detection systems by applying Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and deep learning networks. Furthermore, this paper indicates the possibilities of incorporating these models into the current framework of network security architecture to measure the level of scalability of such solutions in an advanced fraud environment. Along with many other findings, these results reveal that data mining can handle monitoring and prevention of frauds in real-time. This observation shows the importance of updating the fraud detection mechanisms within the telecommunication industry.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Swarm Intelligence-Based Meta-Heuristic Algorithms
abstract: Swarm Intelligence (SI) algorithms, motivated by the group actions of natural systems, offer robust and efficient solutions to complex optimization problems. This review explores several key SI algorithms, including Cuckoo Search (CS), Firefly Algorithm (FA), Bat Algorithm (BA), and others. Each algorithm uses ideas from nature, like how ants find food and how bees interact with each other, to effectively solve nonlinear and multimodal problems. Comparative analysis focuses on convergence speed, solution quality, robustness, and computational complexity, highlighting the unique strengths and applicability of each algorithm. SI algorithms can be changed and scaled up or down easily, which makes them useful for dynamic and large-scale optimization tasks. This makes them future-proof solutions that can be used in many areas. Future research directions include new algorithms, hybrid approaches, real-world applications, and integration with machine learning techniques, promising continued advances and broader applicability. The development of SI algorithms is driven by their natural inspiration, simplicity, and potential for innovative applications, underscoring their importance in tackling diverse and complex challenges.

articleTitle: A Survey on Blockchain for Access Control Models: Security, Transparency, and Challenges
abstract: Access control is a crucial security mechanism that safeguards the confidentiality, availability, and integrity of resources in contemporary systems. This study provides a comprehensive comparison of various access control models, including ABEAC (Attribute-Based Encryption Access Control), CapBAC (Capability-Based Access Control), Blockchain-Based Access Control, ABAC (Attribute-Based Access Control), RBAC (Role-Based Access Control). The advantages and disadvantages of each mechanism are analyzed based on factors such as privacy, fine-grained access control, scalability, adaptability etc. The possible integration of blockchain technology with conventional access control methods is examined, highlighting its capacity to enhance security, accountability, and transparency in decentralized environments. Our survey offers a detailed analysis of access control methodologies concerning key attributes such as dynamic access, audit ability, privacy context aware access, etc. To enhance the robustness of access control systems, research deficiencies are identified, particularly in conjunction with blockchain technology. While blockchain integration offers numerous advantages essential to deal different challenges, and system complexities for optimal access control.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Maintenance: Exploring Reliability and Maintainability Perspectives
abstract: Maintenance is set of activities performed by service personnel to ensure availability of Machine to achieve the organisational objectives. The Reliability and Maintainability models have pivotal roles in Maintenance. A lot of up-gradation has happened in maintenance services since the industrial revolution. Therefore, it is direly required to seek out the latest trends, developments, limitations and to understand the adaptation of AI technologies in maintenance through the aspects of Reliability and Maintainability. For this purpose, an exhaustive literature review was carried out on the mentioned subject through an exploratory data analysis using MATLAB approach based on various publications reviewed from vast and relevant journals along with data available on open sources and Military Standards specific to maintenance sectors. The area of focus is Military Aviation Engineering and Management concerning ageing aircraft maintenance. So, this paper elicits the current trends of use of AI in maintenance models based on the research data of the past 09 years from 2016 to 2024. Literature classifications have not only been made as a part of scientific manner of review but also tailored based on parameters as per the guidance of military standards applicable to Reliability and Maintainability. Crucial observations have been made on recent researches and challenges like Cyber Security, covering all the latest developments including the numerous solutions approaches based on Analysis Models, Simulations, Data Science, AI etc and limitations. In this review, many new R and M models emerged and were highly suitable to be adapted in various sectors, especially aviation. In contrast, very few researches have been found in civil or military ageing aircraft maintenance. This paper is precious for beginners, researchers, and professionals currently working in maintenance management, system safety in civil or military organisations. They can refer to all the valuable references as provided herewith.

articleTitle: GarbageDetectNet: A Framework for Multi-Class Garbage Detection using Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: The frequent generation of alarmingly high domestic solid waste adds to serious climate change and increased pollution. To separate recyclables, automated garbage classification during the early stage of disposal might be a useful approach. This study presents a method for garbage categorisation and recognition utilising a convolutional neural network, which can aid in waste resource management, prevent environmental pollution, and make garbage sorting easier. However, current research is restricted to a small number of garbage categories, like TrashN et dataset, which has 2,527 pictures and 6 types of waste. Some essential categories like clothes, batteries, and biological products are absent from this dataset, which should represent actual environmental issues. Therefore, the performance of proposed convolutional neural network model was assessed using a dataset comprising 15,596 images and 12 classes of household garbage. U sing a neural network, a garbage categorization model was created. After using a customized CNN model, a high accuracy of 96% is achieved. Compared to previous advanced models, this proposed model showed efficacy with fewer parameters and faster training due to use of Adam optimizer and ReL U activation function. This indicates the practicality of the suggested paradigm for real-life environmental concerns.

articleTitle: ConvAttRecurNet: An Attention-based Hybrid Model for Suicidal Thoughts Detection
abstract: Suicide constitutes a serious societal concern, but it rarely represents the initial phase of a person's battle. There are frequently apparent signs of suffering prior to a suicide attempt, which, if identified, can offer a chance for prompt assistance. Changes in food or sleeping habits, increased risk-taking, or estrangement from loved ones are all indicators of a potential mental health crisis. Individuals may display emotions such as pessimism, worthlessness, or feeling like a burden to others, which are frequently accompanied by severe mood swings. It is feasible to offer the requisite assistance and potentially save lives by promptly recognizing these indicators. Thus, this paper proposes a novel model, ConvAttRecurNet, which is an attention-based hybrid model that integrates convolutional neural networks (CNN) and bidirectional long-term memory (BiLSTM). The publicly available datasets from Kaggle are used to train the proposed model. Before using the data for training, the data is pre-processed to clean the text data, convert the text into tokens, and create word embeddings using the word2vec method. The word embeddings are provided to the ConvAttRecurNet for training with the customized 10 layers. The proposed model outperforms benchmarked models like BiLSTM and BiLSTM+Attention, achieving the highest accuracy of 94.6 on test data. However, the BiLSTM and BiLSTM+Attention models are overfitting by achieving the highest accuracy in training while performing poorly on the validation data. Hence, using the proposed ConvAttRecurNet in real life can benefit society in detecting suicidal thoughts at an early stage from social media texts.

articleTitle: Improving Intrusion Detection for IoT Networks Using SMOTE and PCA on NSL-KDD Dataset
abstract: This paper focuses on detecting anomalies in IoT devices, which is an important component of maintaining their security. To accomplish this, we use the well-known NSL-KDD dataset, which represents real-world IoT network traffic. Our strategy addresses the issue of imbalanced data by employing the SMOTE oversampling technique, which improves our classifier's performance by mitigating data scarcity in the minority class. Following that, we improve our anomaly detection procedure by using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to identify features. PCA speeds up the subsequent classification processes by lowering data dimensionality while keeping critical information. The Random Forest Classifier, known for its robustness and capacity to handle varied data patterns, is used for the actual classification task. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our proposed method surpasses other existing approaches, achieving an impressive 99.8% accuracy rate in detecting anomalies in IoT devices. Our research presents a promising avenue to enhance IoT security, ensuring safer and more reliable interconnected systems.

articleTitle: Early Diagnosis and Prediction of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome Using Machine Learning-Based Techniques: A Review
abstract: The prevalence of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS), a complex endocrine condition that predominantly impacts women of reproductive age, has risen significantly in recent years. Excess concentrations of androgen and male hormone frequently constitute as contributing factors for PCOS. Hormonal deviations indeterminate menstrual cycles, and in-numerable tiny cysts on the female reproductive organs are characteristic features of PCOS. Beyond its detrimental impact on reproduction, PCOS has been associated to a wide range of metabolic disorders among which are obesity, dyslipidemia, insulin resistance, and a greater likelihood of cardiovascular disease and type 2 diabetes. However, if diagnosed early enough, PCOS-related challenges could be prevented or more effectively managed. It is vital to understand the difference between healthy and affected diagnostic observations in order to obtain an exhaustive understanding of the extent of the illness and its multifaceted detrimental impacts on women's reproductive health. Machine Learning (ML), considering its feature extraction capabilities, performs particularly well in detection among all the detection approaches. Various ML methods such as Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, Naive Bayes etc. are used in diagnosis of PCOS. An in-depth review of the techniques by which numerous machine learning-based algorithms have been implemented for identification of PCOS throughout the previous several decades is carried out and the approaches are explored in depth.

articleTitle: An Improved Deep Neuro Fuzzy Framework for Big Data Management in Ultra-Dense Cloud Servers
abstract: As how much information keeps on filling dramatically in the present computerized world, overseeing and dissecting this information has turned into a significant test for organizations. Conventional strategies for information the executives, for example, rule-based approaches, frequently should be extended to adjust to the intricacies and vulnerabilities of enormous information. To resolve this issue, we propose a better Deep Neuro-Fuzzy (DNF) structure for huge information the executives in super thick cloud servers. This system use the force of both profound learning and fluffy rationale to deal with the intricacies of large information in cloud servers. The DNF structure adjusts to the changing climate by utilizing profound learning methods to learn and refresh its boundaries. Simultaneously, the fluffy rationale system gives interpretability and adaptability in navigation. The DNF system comprises of three fundamental parts: information pre-handling, Deep Neuro-Fuzzy Network (DNFN), and information post-handling. In the pre-handling stage, the structure cleans and concentrates applicable highlights from the crude information. The DNFN, the center part of our structure, is a crossover brain network that consolidates the upsides of profound learning and fluffy rationale. It uses a versatile rule-based design to deal with enormous information and gives interpretability in the dynamic cycle. The information post-handling stage includes changing the result of the DNFN into significant bits of knowledge and representations. The proposed model arrived at 95.05% Adaptability, 95.38% asset the executives, 95.60% Security the board, 94.44% Energy Productivity, 95.21 % information reconciliation and 95.74% Data access. The system is versatile and can deal with huge volumes of information, making it appropriate for super thick cloud servers.

articleTitle: Leveraging AI and Machine Learning for Early Detection and Analysis of Mental Health Trends
abstract: Mental health has become a significant concern as many people today struggle to maintain a healthy work-life balance. Addressing the root causes of this issue is crucial since its effects are often felt in early life, such as in educational or professional contexts. The widespread effects of mental health disorders highlight the urgent need for public education and preventative measures to create environments that are healthy for all. To tackle this problem, we propose to use state-of-the-art machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) techniques. This study compares and analyses a number of machine learning algorithms with the goal of accurately forecasting human moods, which is a critical aspect of understanding trends in mental health. A comprehensive evaluation of multiple models is conducted to determine and enhance their accuracy. By improving a transformer-based model, BERT, and researching its variations, such SieBERT, the goal of 96% accuracy rate is achieved. First, methods including LSTM, BERT, SVM, and Naive Bayes is used to train the model. Subsequently, advanced BERT variations such as SieBERT and RoBERTa are applied to optimize precision and efficiency. This study aims to improve the early detection and understanding of mental health problems in order to create the foundation for workable solutions.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Brain Tumor Detection Using CNN-Based Medical Imaging Analysis
abstract: The detection of brain tumours is a long-term persistent challenge in medical imaging where accurate and efficient diagnostic tools remain an absolute necessity for clinicians to detect in early stages and to determine the appropriate treatment. Rapid developments in DL have opened new avenues to automate and improve the accuracy of brain tumour classification from MRI scans. This study proposes to develop a robust Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based classification method for various types of brain tumours, including glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumours, and healthy brain tissue. For this purpose, the paper utilises the following deep learning models: DenseNet169, ResNet50, VGG16, and VGG19. The dataset used was comprehensive, with labelled MRI images-70% for training and 30% for testing data. Accuracies, precisions, recalls, and F1 scores are used to assess model performance. DenseNet169 proved to be the most effective model, with an accuracy of 97.45<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>. ResNet50 came in second at 92.34%, followed by VGG16 at 88.65% and VGG19 at 90.23%. The confusion matrices also show that in the case of each model, DenseNet169 tended to reduce the number of false positives, particularly for glioma and pituitary tumours. These results demonstrate a great possibility of deep learning to develop automatisation for accurate high-throughput brain tumour detection. Since DenseNet169 has superior results, it implies usability in real-time clinical applications that can improve the whole process of diagnosis, which would increase early detection or treatment for the majority of patients with brain tumours.

articleTitle: An Automated Solution for Traffic Safety and Compliance Using Wireless-Enabled Overspeed Detection and Data Logging Using Doppler Radar and Visual Capture for Enhanced Monitoring and Enforcement
abstract: Among the most pressing problems in the world today is road safety and an obvious means of ensuring this is the reduction of speeds for vehicles. Due to the increase in population and the resulting traffic congestion there is a flagrant case of drivers speeding on suburban as well as urban roads. Traditional speed control measures installed in certain locations do not suffice for big cities and their scope and traffic complexity, because there is no real time information availability or feedback. Particularly because some of the traditional measures being used are so manpower-intensive, those in charge of making decisions rarely have the information they need at the right time. For instance, this research proposes an automated system which provides a solution to the problem of the dangerous speeding of vehicles with the aim of improving safety on the roads. The system measures vehicle speeds without having to stop them in order to take the speed measurement and without delaying the vehicle, so all the speeds of the moving vehicles are captured and sent to a main server. Consequently, oppressed by the speed of the economy, the car offers worldwide speed measurement service. This solves the problem of data recording which has in the past been a great impediment to the enforcement of speeding violations and where detailed traffic patterns of the city or locality can be properly obtained. It allows detailed traffic datasets to be properly obtained as compliance with laws has in the past been a major hindrance in speeding violation enforcements.

articleTitle: Empowering Sustainable Waste Management: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Models for Citizen Engagement
abstract: Everyone needs to take responsibility to achieve sustainable waste management since this practice addresses not only ecological issues but also serves as an essential sustainability requirement. This research explores machine learning solutions that increase public participation and environmental consciousness for sustainable waste protection. In the proposed work, the performance of logistic regression, random forest, KNN, and the decision tree algorithm has been evaluated through multiple classification metrics using waste composition and treatment data. The selection of these models occurred because they demonstrated strong capabilities when dealing with structured data classification tasks. Different statistical parameters measures, including accuracy with precision and recall and F1-score, evaluated the models. The Random Forest model shows the optimal performance by attaining 89% accuracy along with an F1 score of 86%, which qualified it as the best method to forecast citizen engagement behavior. The Decision Tree model implementation reveals effective potential for tree-based methodology as waste management solution frameworks. This study provides effective strategies to boost waste recycling rates and develops operational techniques to lower open dumping occurrences and participation enhancement initiatives. Through machine learning-based civic engagement approaches, the government jointly develops better waste management plans together with local communities. Technology cooperation between citizens leads to an enduring environment where people actively protect their environment.

articleTitle: Bridging the Gap: From Food Recognition to Accurate Weight Estimation
abstract: Accurate estimation of food weight is of utmost importance in the assessment of diet in nutrition, healthcare, and wellness. Although great progress has been achieved with machine learning and computer vision in image-based food recognition, the task of accurate weight estimation is still a challenging one. This review summarizes the current methodologies that address the gap, focusing on the reduction of errors and novel innovations. The review compares 2D and 3D computational methods, emphasizes the advantages of hybrid multimodal models, and assesses their strengths and weaknesses. The role of datasets and annotation techniques is analyzed in detail, highlighting the importance of having diverse and accurate datasets for model improvement. Standard evaluation metrics and benchmarks are addressed to evaluate accuracy and comparability across methods. Realism emerging trends of self-supervised learning, multimodal data integration, and real-time edge computing applications are searched for as answers to these practical constraints found in reality: variability in food, occlusion, environmental factors all challenge; solution proposed here. This review is aimed at outlining future research guidance by summarizing recent innovations, addressing gaps, and providing a roadmap for practical, scalable, and accurate dietary assessment systems.

articleTitle: Advanced Motion Recognition Using High-Resolution Infrared Imaging and Enhanced Image Processing Techniques
abstract: Over the past few years, infrared (IR) motion detection has become more important in domains such as security, wildlife monitoring, and nighttime surveillance, when standard vision-based systems frequently fail. The approach of infrared video detection using convolutional neural networks is been implemented in this research work. Infrared imaging is particularly useful for collecting temperature-based data in low-visibility or dark conditions, enabling for the monitoring of activities that would otherwise be difficult to trace. The suggested approach preprocesses grayscale infrared pictures, normalizing them and scaling to fit the input requirements of a custom-built CNN. Through a sequence of convolutional and pooling layers, the CNN collects characteristics related to motion patterns in IR pictures, learning to discriminate between frames having motion and those that do not. The proposed system was developed with the help of pre-trained data values of infrared pictures, and performance was tested using multiple parameters that includes various visualization figures such as accuracy-precision graph, recall, and ROC-AUC, to show its usefulness. This real-time approach combines a CNN with a video processing pipeline to identify motion in an infrared movie. It uses visualizations like as confusion matrices, accuracy-loss curves, and precision-recall curves to give insights into model design, implementation details, and experimental results. The results reveal that CNNs can accurately discern motion in infrared pictures, paving the way for automated low-light surveillance.

articleTitle: Malaria Detection Using Deep Learning: An In-Depth Comparison of Techniques
abstract: The Plasmodium parasite, which is accountable for malaria, is a lethal disease that infests individuals once female Anopheles mosquitoes bite them. It persists as one of the most prevalent and deadly diseases in tropical and subtropical regions. Prompt Identification of malaria is necessary for successful therapeutics and deterrence of acute repercussions. Microscopic is the standard of excellence for diagnosing malaria. However, the result of microscopic analysis takes time and depends on factors such as quality of equipment, lighting conditions, and the expertise of parasitologists. Coupled with traditional detection methods, experts have explored microscopic picture examination rooted in deep learning models to recognize Plasmodium parasites. This study proposes a comparative analysis of the prediction of malaria parasites and healthy cells using different deep learning models and open-access datasets. Several measures are employed to evaluate the efficacy of various architectures. The outcomes show that ResNet-50 outperformed delivering an accuracy rate of 96.88%. The findings allude that neural network architectures can effectively diagnose malaria while identifying the optimal model is important in order to achieve high accuracy.

articleTitle: Development of an Advanced Multi-Disease Prediction Framework Utilizing Machine Learning Techniques
abstract: This innovative study applies Machine Learning (ML) techniques to construct an all-encompassing Multiple Disease Prediction System using datasets from Kaggle. The dataset holds great potential for marking “Parkinson”, “Heart Disease” and “Heart diseases” causing to its multifaceted structure. The study incorporates Support Vector Machines for “Support Vector Machine” that organized Mikey's and problem of Diabetes predictions & Logistic regression for heart disease predictions. This novel approach means that the system offers improved reliability and ease of use, and most importantly, optimal predictions for every possible medical nuance. A prominent concern is the intersection of emerging technologies and medicine with emphasis on the importance of evidence-based medicine for primary healthcare. The project uses intuitive and advanced algorithms for ML based on the machine learning algorithms to improve the value of understanding diabetes for cardiovascular disease prediction and mitigate the gap for improved healthcare action. The principal expects to develop models which are economical and can support a wide range of changes, such as using decision trees, but utilizing more advanced techniques like SVM and Logistic Regression. The integration of the open source Streamlit platform allows for the user module of the integrated component to be more easily utilized. This improves operational efficacy and access to the predictive system, thus broadening the target user population. This integrates the different aspects of the project in an enhanced way to build a better and more proactive health care system for early diagnosis and preventive measures of common health problems.

articleTitle: Exploring Botnets: Detection Techniques, Botnet Attack and Future Prospects
abstract: Botnets are a significant concern to cybersecurity because they are able to carry out attacks such as distributed denial of service (DDoS) and data theft by utilising complex structures and infection techniques. A comprehensive examination of the botnet lifecycle is presented here, covering topics such as attack strategies, infection techniques, and detection methods. Emerging architectures, Internet of Things vulnerabilities, and encrypted traffic are some of the difficulties that are brought to light by this. The research highlights the importance of scalable, adaptable, and privacy-preserving solutions by offering an analysis of the methodologies that are already in use.

articleTitle: Malware-BERT: Enhancing Evasive Malware Detection with Multi-Head BERT Attention with Hybrid BERT models
abstract: The increasing prevalence of malicious software poses a significant threat to computer systems and the Internet, with some malware employing sophisticated techniques to evade detection. Traditional detection methods, such as signature-based and heuristic-based approaches, often fail to identify unknown malware, underscoring the need for advanced solutions. This research introduces the Malware-BERT model for detecting evasive malware in PDF documents. Leveraging a novel dataset, Evasive-PDFMal2022, which comprises 10,025 samples (5,557 malicious and 4,468 benign), the model utilizes BERT embeddings and multi-head attention mechanisms. A comparative analysis of hybrid BERT models reveals significant improvements in detection performance, with the RoBERTa model achieving an accuracy of 96%. This study demonstrates the potential of advanced machine learning techniques in fortifying cybersecurity measures against sophisticated PDF-based threats.

articleTitle: Adaptive Task Offloading Framework for Serverless Edge Computing
abstract: Serverless Edge Computing (SEC) has emerged as a transformative paradigm to meet the computational demands of latency-sensitive applications in the Internet of Things (IoT). By processing tasks closer to data sources., SEC minimizes latency and improves system responsiveness. However., the heterogeneity of edge resources., dynamic workloads., and the need to prioritize high-urgency tasks introduce significant challenges in resource allocation and scheduling. This paper presents a hybrid task offloading framework tailored for SEC environments., integrating centralized task classification., task-specific server clustering., and multiagent Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) based decision-making to manage resource allocation and task execution dynamically. By balancing deterministic strategies for task specialization and adaptive learning for real-time decision making., the proposed framework achieves significant reductions in latency while enhancing task completion rates. Experimental results validate the framework's superiority over traditional deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches., by achieving latency reduction of about 15% and improving average completion time by 29.46% demonstrating its effectiveness and scalability in complex., distributed computing environments.

articleTitle: Enriching Patient Care and Health Outcomes using Wearable Technology
abstract: With its constant, immediate knowledge into indi- cators and circumstances, wearable technology within healthcare has completely altered the way health of patients is monitored. This review analyzes wearable technology in the medical field today, emphasizing how it could be utilized to monitor patient health and increase clinical results. In order to record blood pressure, glucose levels, heart rate and sleep patterns, wearables like such as watches, fitness trackers and specialized medical de- vices are increasingly contained into patient care. These electronic devices minimize visits to hospitals and promote patient auton- omy through the use of early health issue detection, customized medication regimens, and remote support for patients. Also by using the data produced by wearables, healthcare providers could possibly enhance patient outcomes by taking well-informed, decisions based on data. The analysis additionally highlights the need to enhance wearable technology integration with the present health care infrastructure, along with issues with data security and accuracy. In order to deal with privacy concerns and improve the precision, affordability, and usability of these devices, future advances in this field may concentrate on addressing these kinds of problems. This might lead to a broader and successful adoption of such devices in healthcare systems. This paper underlines how wearable technology may revolutionize healthcare by facilitating active tracking of health and custom medical interventions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Quality and Early Gastric Cancer Detection Using Pre-Processing Techniques on the Kvasir-SEG Dataset
abstract: The main reason for a large portion of deaths related to cancer is caused by gastric cancer which is the worst form of disease. Endoscopy is the test that can identify this disease at its early stage which can result in patient survival rates. This study tries to enhance the processing of gastroscopic images by using an enhanced Deep learning (DL) model to boost the accuracy of stomach cancer. Pre-processing frequently involves resizing and bilaterally filtering images to increase clarity and reduce noise. Gamma correction is then used to enhance contrast and make the images simpler to read. To function the model more consistently approaches like zooming, scaling, and rotation are applied to improve the images. The model was trained and evaluated in this research utilizing the Kvasir-SEG dataset, which contains thorough annotations for gastroscopic images. To gauge the outcomes, two important metrics were employed: Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR). The processed photos show a very little decrease in quality, with Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio PSNR values ranging from 50.65 to 52.94. The remarkably low Mean Squared Error (MSE) values (ranging from 0.0023 to 0.0029) show that the treated images are still fairly close to the originals. Based on the available data, this approach could significantly enhance the early detection of stomach cancer, allowing doctors to enhance and expedite patient care. In the future, an improved DL model will be used for lesion segmentation.

articleTitle: Multiclass Grade Prediction in Higher Education via Ensemble Learning Models and Grey Wolf Feature Optimization
abstract: A challenging aspect of the academic performance prediction model over the years is to achieve high predictive accuracy and an effective feature selection approach, which traditional prediction models struggle to achieve. In this study, a new model is proposed for the prediction of student academic performance, called the Novel Scholar Grade Prediction Model (NGPM), based on multiclass classification machine learning algorithms. The aim of this study is to correctly predict the final grades of students on the input data by identifying and laying out suitable features. For model development, a dataset of student academic records from a Higher Education Institution in Central India was used. In this novel model, the selection of feature was addressed, which is optimized using the Grey Wolf optimization (GWO). This model combines the SVM, K-NN and LSTM Networks with the bagging ensemble method to create a strong and precise prediction model. In the academic session, the evaluation results showed an average precision value of 0.9975 and recall value of 0.9920 on the data of students achieving Grade A at the 40% course completion with an overall accuracy improvement of 15% as compared to the earlier models applied. The ensemble model gives a significantly better predictive accuracy when feature selection is tuned using GWO.

articleTitle: Real-Time American Sign Language Translation Using Deep Learning
abstract: Sign language is a means of communication between the deaf and hard of hearing, but sometimes becomes difficult to communicate with others who do not know sign language. Traditional methods of translation usually result in imprecise conversions and sometimes duplication. This paper is interested in the design and implementation of a novel system for the conversion of sign language to spoken English. The system applies computer vision and machine learning techniques toward better interpretation of the motion in sign language and produces natural human language output. A comprehensive discussion of translation methods that exist and why they fail in the task is provided. It underlines how authentic voice translations, that are contextually accurate, have to be generated to enhance the communicative inclusion. This technique integrates deep learning models that have been trained on large sign language datasets to achieve great accuracy in detecting and interpreting sign language movements. It tries to get high accuracy in identifying and understanding sign language motions, in order to avoid mistakes and assure smooth translation. The system will be tested extensively under various sign language inputs after which the accuracy of given textual translations will be known. The research outcome creates value in the development of inclusive communication technology because it would bring more light on issues revolving around authenticity in the interpretation process of sign language translation. An approach to this contribution would improve the quality and quality of sign language interpretation; it would promote effective communication, understanding, and appreciation amongst linguistic groups.

articleTitle: Optimization of Diabetics Diagnosis Using SVM, Random Forest and XGBoost
abstract: Diabetes is one of the common chronic conditions in today's world. Early and accurate diagnosis of diabetes helps in its effective management and prevention of complications. This paper aims at finding optimized machine learning model for diabetic prediction. Three machine learning models, Random Forest, eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) are considered to evaluate the predictive performance on the diabetic dataset considered from UCI machine learning repository consisting of health-related parameters for identifying whether an individual is diabetic or not. The assessment parameters considered for evaluation are Precision, Recall, Accuracy and F1-Score. The algorithms are run on training datasets of varied sizes, the results are analyzed through performance comparison among three models. The findings of this work based on the performance analysis are: SVM performed better for large datasets and handled imbalanced and high-dimensional data well therefore it is appropriate for hospital databases. Random Forest displayed consistent performance irrespective of the dataset size, giving robustness with interpretability from feature importance analysis and hence can be used to improve clinical decision support systems. XGBoost was very efficient for smaller datasets because of its gradient-boosting mechanism that optimizes predictions efficiently and therefore it is very effective for real-time use like wearable health monitoring. The results are also compared with advanced deep learning methods and it is observed that machine learning models make better option on real-time datasets due to the ease of implementation, speed, and resource efficiency.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics for Injury Prevention in Physical Education Using Machine Learning Models
abstract: In recent years, there has been a growing concern over the increasing number of injuries among high school students participating in physical education programs, particularly during sports activities. These injuries, ranging from minor sprains to stress fractures, can significantly impact student health and disrupt the learning process. Focused on addressing this issue, applying predictive analytics along with machine learning models to figure out the possible at-risk group of students timely interventions are set in motion by this study regarding the possibility to predict and potentially prevent injuries based on machine learning algorithms. Comprehensive datasets containing a combination of all demographic information related to physical and other metrics; injury history information; and detailed activity data reported from wearable equipment will be provided. Models that were applied to achieve this end are Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). Results obtained from this indicate that the RNN model is the strongest one compared to others regarding accuracy since it identified the widest range of injury types with a very minor error. Random Forest also did quite well, whereas SVM and ANN showed lower accuracies, mostly while predicting complex injuries. Hence, the general results indicate that machine learning via real-time data analysis from wearables can significantly enhance injury prevention practices in PE. This approach provides educators and coaches with early warnings regarding the potential injury risks, allowing them to undertake preventive measures in improving both safety among students and athletic performance.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Genetic Manipulation: Artificial Intelligence-Powered Precision in CRISPR-Cas9 Gene Editing
abstract: CRISPR-Cas9 has revolutionized gene editing by enabling precise genetic modifications. However, factors such as off-terrain effects, variable editing efficiency, and delivery complications hamper its translational applicability in clinics and industries. Hence, this work proposes an AI-assisted approach by which CRISPR-Cas9 might become even more accurate. In this study, the AI deep-learning model algorithms were engaged in gRNA design generation, off-targets minimization, and editing strategy refinements based on live feedback. Targeted delivery modes additionally assisted in cellular uptake and CRISPR-Cas9 activity. These advances now have been experimentally proved to improve editing accuracy and efficiency significantly. This interdisciplinary intervention promotes the advancement of gene therapy while providing a whole new framework for tackling the ethical and safety-related concerns associated with genome editing.

articleTitle: Analysis of Evolutionary Intelligence Approaches for Feature Selection and Open Challenges
abstract: The superiority of stochastic approaches for feature selection algorithms has been demonstrated over the past two decades, and tens of new ones are developed and tested annually on UCI datasets. It can provide a way to reduce processing costs, improve forecast accuracy, and improve understanding of data structures. Evolutionary Intelligence (EI) algorithms are more promising approaches to feature selection problems because stochastic methods are among the many feature selection strategies that have many local solutions. However, the work is challenging due to two factors: feature communication and a large solution space. In this study, using a wrapper-based framework, we focus on the basic algorithmic structures of evolutionary intelligence for feature selection in order to choose the best feature subset for classification. This study examined the classification accuracy and convergence speed of five Evolutionary Intelligence feature selection methods across the five UCI datasets. Particle Swarm Optimisation (PSO), Harmony Search (HS), Rhinoceros Search Algorithm (RSA), Genetic Algorithm (GA), and Gravitational Search Algorithm (GSA) are the five EI algorithms that are utilised in their most basic form. Recent algorithms, such as HSA and GA, are used to identify the best feature subsets in the absence of empirical data. Five benchmark datasets are taken from the UCI repository in order to verify the outcomes of the chosen EIs.

articleTitle: Detection of Skin Diseases and Vitamin Deficiency-Related Conditions Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning
abstract: This research proposes the use of advanced deep learning architecture referred to as EfficientN et for diagnos ing various skin conditions, ranging from Acne, to Rosacea, Pigmentary Disorders, Eczema, and Psoriasis, using simple images captured with any cameras. The methodology involves the four critical stages: image labeling, preprocessing, extracting features, and classification. Median filtering is used for image pre processing to remove noise, hair and other artifacts while pre serving the essential edges, textures, and optimal image analysis. Feature extraction uses techniques such as Shearlet Transforms (ST) and Blur Trace (BT) to capture the characteristics of skin texture, including curvature and energy distribution. These extracted features are fed into the EfficientN et model, which classifies the skin condition into predefined classes, which are Acne, Rosacea, Pigmentation Disorders, Eczema, and Psoriasis. Classification results of EfficientN et were observed to be high with well supported metrics such as precision, recall, and F1 score. Cross-validation assures robustness and adaptability across diverse datasets. Unlike previous methods based on dermoscopy images, simple images from digital cameras broaden the system applicability and make it suitable for real-world applications. This work aims to develop an accurate, scalable diagnostic tool that will help healthcare professionals with early detection and personalized treatment of dermatological conditions associated with vitamin deficiencies. The dataset that has been used is a public dataset available on Kaggle.

articleTitle: Optimizing Large Scale Ontology Alignment to Establish Interoperability for Efficient Retrieval
abstract: The Semantic Web is aiming to add meaning and structure to the vast amount of data available online. It aims to make information machine-readable and interpret, unlike traditional web pages that are designed for human consumption. The increase in adoption of semantic web technologies resulted in the generation of vast number of ontologies with varying size and heterogeneity. The efficient ontology matching system to align the large number of ontologies is extremely required to allow interoperability in cross domain. Although there are various ontology matching systems available which could handle matching small ontologies but when it comes to matching large scale ontologies, high computational and space requirements is always a challenge. In this paper, an ontologies matching system is proposed which partition the large-scale healthcare ontologies in parallel using base level ontology partitioning method and the similarity between the entities are computed using Adjustment similarity computation method. However, the alignment discovery process demands high computational requirement, therefore in this proposed system, the distributed and parallel approach of Map Reduce technique is used to make system more scalable and efficient.

articleTitle: Optimizing NPC Behavior in Video Games Using Unity ML-Agents: A Reinforcement Learning-Based Approach
abstract: The development of video games is now being influenced by machine learning (ML), which is changing the industry with every passing day. The focus of this research is on how video games can be made better through ML in game development, particularly how NPCs behave in the game. Game companies can boost the immerse feeling in video games by utilizing reinforcement learning in developing sophisticated NPCs. Those who play modern video games know that they are more realistic than what they used to be, and this is courtesy of ML. The toolkit Unity ML-Agents enables more straightforward ML implementations in the Unity game engine, giving game makers the ability to create complex AI features without having to have deep knowledge of machine learning. This paper seeks to analyze how ML can transform the experience of humans when playing games by enhancing the NPCs and through interactivity. The future of video games is bright, especially considering new advancements in technology like ML.

articleTitle: Underwater Vision Enhancement: Adaptive White Balancing Combined with Nature-Inspired Algorithm Mechanisms
abstract: Underwater reconstructed images often suffer from color cast, low contrast, and reduced brightness due to absorption and scattering effects. Research has shown that underwater environments exhibit low-pass characteristics, leading to the loss of crucial image information and degradation in visual quality. Image enhancement techniques can help recover this lost information. Various underwater image enhancement methods have been proposed; however, existing approaches often introduce artefacts and produce unrealistic results. To address these challenges, we propose a novel adaptive white-balancing method specifically designed for underwater images. This method primarily focuses on correcting a color cast in underwater scenes. Following white balancing, both local and global contrast enhancements are applied to further improve image quality. The artificial bee colony algorithm is employed to significantly enhance contrast, while a Laplacian filter is used to refine local contrast. The proposed method effectively improves contrast and eliminates color cast, resulting in more natural-looking underwater images. Additionally, the integration of different algorithms enhances the quality of degraded images. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms existing techniques, achieving the highest UIQM score (41.78 on RUIE, 44.82 on EUVP datasets) and the lowest BRISQUE score (2.8 on RUIE, 0.8 on EUVP), indicating superior contrast, color correction, and image naturalness.

articleTitle: Generative AI for Text to Speech and Sign Language Translation
abstract: This paper presents the development of an AI-powered platform designed to enhance real-time communication for individuals with speech and hearing impairments. The system integrates 3D animation, Natural Language Processing[15] (NLP), and Automatic Speech Recognition [1] [2] (ASR) to convert spoken words into sign language gestures. By utilizing advanced speech recognition models, natural language understanding, and dynamic 3D [6] gesture generation, the platform ensures a smooth and intuitive communication experience. To promote inclusivity, the system supports both multilingual and regional sign languages, making it accessible across diverse linguistic and cultural backgrounds. This solution bridges the gap in real-time communication tools by offering a scalable and accessible platform for both web and mobile applications. Ultimately, the goal is to empower individuals with disabilities, enhance their interaction with digital environments, and foster greater social inclusion.

articleTitle: Analysis of Stock Market Prediction Through the Application of Machine Learning Techniques
abstract: Trends in stock market forecasting are acknowledged as a noteworthy and fruitful field of study. Smart investors can profit handsomely from the ups and downs of stock prices. Investors have a formidable obstacle when trying to forecast the stock market: data that is either stagnant or uncertain. For investors seeking to optimize profitability, stock market forecasting poses a significant difficulty. Mathematical methods and state-of-the-art learning technologies are employed to produce stock market projections. Computing methods, Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, performance variables, and reputable publications are just a few of the many subjects covered in this paper's review of different research articles. Therefore, the chosen articles are helping to advance datasets and ML algorithms that are used to predict how the stock market will move in the future. Predictions about the stock market are often made with the help of Neural Networks (NNs) and Artificial Neural Network (ANNs) algorithms. Unfortunately, there are still a lot of problems with the way the stock market is currently predicted. The principal premise of the research is that there are many interrelated factors that should be given greater weight when making stock market predictions.

articleTitle: Skilldev: Genai-Powered Skill Upgrading Platform
abstract: The rapid evolution of technology has transformed the landscape of education, making it essential for students to stay up-to-date with industry-relevant skills. The project presents a web-based platform to enhance campus placement preparation for pre-final and final-year engineering students of various computer-related faculties. The platform uses Generative AI to assess student skill levels in various core and important subjects under the computer domain. By categorizing students into Beginner, Intermediate, or Advanced levels, the platform delivers personalized learning resources and tutorial recommendations as per the user's needs while tracking the overall progress. The system provides visual insights through graphical analysis of student performance to improve employability and better equip students for competitive placement processes. Additionally, it also delivers responsive feedback for the overall achievement and progress of the user. Through various self-designed recommendation and evaluation algorithms, the system adapts to student's learning needs, ensuring an optimized and dynamic learning experience.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Smart Unidirectional Road Lighting Control System for Enhanced Energy Efficiency and Road Safety Through Sensor Integration and Geofencing Technology
abstract: The increasing concentration of urban population has certainly made the advocates of sustainable and efficient cities very interested in their construction. Energy efficient do indeed involve street lighting which unfortunately is one of the most challenging features of any sustainable city as it incurs large shares of expenditure within the energy budget of the cities. Aho et al. note that older streetlights were almost always left on regardless of what the operating environment was or this could be an insomniac offending night. The large scale installation and use of such systems results in wastage of electricity, addition of light pollution and cost funds to maintenance. Therefore, smart lighting systems are fitting end to such deficiencies, where Internet of Things and smart control systems are employed. These systems include methods of control whereby devices and luminaires are turned off or dimmed or turned on depending upon the expected conditions. Such advancement of smart lighting proposes advantages of decreased electrical consumption, less electrification pollution to the extent of being a “win-win” for vehicles and pedestrians oriented safety measures. More than motion sensors are necessary to enhance smart road lighting systems, as light around the area and the geographic location of the road lighting equipment must be integrated into the system. In addition, only a light is turned on when a car is nearby so that there is minimal energy wastage. Also, the real time visibility of energy consumption and the frequency of providing such information has a huge bearing on the management of lighting or power resources. Moreover, such technological advancement is very useful to smart vehicles because geofencing allows for the switching on of streetlights after a vehicle is a certain distance away from the light meaning less energy is also spent.

articleTitle: Securing Medical Images in the Cloud: A Hybrid Approach Using Adaptive Strength Control and Content-Aware Watermarking
abstract: The field of healthcare data storage on the cloud, which is fast expanding, protecting sensitive medical pictures including X-rays, CT scans, and MRIs while maintaining computing efficiency and image quality top priority is a huge challenge. This work introduces a novel approach to securely store medical images kept in the cloud by combining adaptive strength control with content-aware watermarking. Using adaptive strength control allows one to protect important diagnostic sections while lowering distortion in less important areas by varying the watermark intensity in line with image content. We then precisely place the watermark in the image using content- aware watermarking. In this sense, we can quickly identify modification without sacrificing the visual quality of the image. We hash every image using SHA-256 to maintain the hash result for future use, therefore providing additional peace of mind. Photographs are encrypted and kept on a virtual cloud following their hashed and watermarked treatment. Recalculating and comparing the hash value helps users to verify the presence of the watermark and guarantees the integrity of the image, therefore regulating access to these pictures. The hybrid approach balances security, visual quality, and computing economy. Experimental data supports the system's capacity to preserve visual quality, function in a cloud storage environment, and properly protect photographs from modification. Medical professionals may be relieved that strict data privacy regulations and depending on the quality of preserved images help to safely guard sensitive healthcare data with this approach.

articleTitle: Extracting Abstractive Summaries Through Generative AI Models
abstract: Text summarization is an advanced domain in the natural language processing (NLP) field, to shorten a large amount of text into meaningful condensed summaries to get more enhanced information. While generating summaries, maintaining the intact of the original text is very important. Furthermore, to generate the original summaries from the text, i.e. for abstractive summarization, the inclusion of neural networks and generative AI is highly required. Considering the importance of text summarization in different fields, and the advancements in generative AI models, this paper seeks to analyze the capabilities of generative AI models i.e., Mistral-7B, LLaMA3-8B, and BART-large CNN for text summarization. With tools such as LangChain and Hugging Face pipelines, the said models have been integrated to produce abstractive summaries. This study uses the DialogSum dataset, along with Groq & Google Colab experimental frameworks. Well-known evaluation metrics like ROUGE, BLEU, and BERT Score further strengthen the comprehensiveness of their evaluations of these models. The findings suggest that Mistral-7B was found to have the best performance among others. This paper also presents the capacity of different models and their ability to meet the desired output of summarization, which further facilitates text summarization-related tasks in different industries.

articleTitle: Enhancing Network Lifetime in IoT-Based Wireless Sensor Networks Through MSSA-Driven Cluster Head Optimization
abstract: The integration of the Internet of Things with WSN s has given emergence to various applications in industries starting from precision agriculture to healthcare, and smart cities. These networks completely depend on well-organized data collection and transmission, where energy consumption is one of the crucial issues. One of the major challenges in WSN is the optimum selection of cluster heads that can directly influence energy efficiency and network lifetime and hence the overall performance. In this context, this paper deals with this challenge by proposing a new method of selecting cluster heads based on Multi-Objective Salp Swarm Algorithm-MSSA. MSSA is proposed to deploy loT for data gathering in the WSN, therefore optimization of cluster head selection have been done with MSSA application. We assess the performance of this approach by comparing it with various established algorithms such as LEACH, PSO, GA, and FCM. These will provide performance metrics necessary for energy consumption, network lifetime, and packet delivery ratio; thus, all critical parameters determining WSN's sustainability could be given in an overview. The experimental results depict that the MSSA-based approach outperforms the benchmark algorithms in terms of energy consumption, lifetime elongation of the network, and data transmission efficiency. This research contributes to the literature by providing an advanced solution to the problem of cluster head selection, offering a more energy-efficient and scalable approach to IoT-enabled WSN applications, such as environmental monitoring and smart infrastructure management.

articleTitle: Customer Analytics: Using Machine Learning to Predict the Customer Life Time Value (CLTV) Based on Purchase History and Ratings
abstract: Customer Life Time Value (CLTV) is a vital customer analytics metric that is intended to inform companies on the right investment in customer acquisition, retention, and engagement. Conventional CLTV models are heavily dependent on purchase frequency and money-value transaction information, but not customer satisfaction measurements like ratings. This paper proposes a general framework for incorporating ratings into machine learning models for CLTV prediction. Taking advantage of the merits of ensemble learning methods, the paper uses both transactional and satisfaction data to uncover the complex customer behavior dynamics. Our experimental finding indicates the better predictive performance of satisfaction-based models, providing companies with a sound basis to enhance customer analytics activities.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based HOG ResNet Model for Group Attendance System in Educational Institutions
abstract: Traditional attendance management systems in educational institutions use manual methods that are time-consuming and prone to errors. This work proposes an automated attendance taking system implemented through group pictures using face recognition making the process much easier in classroom environments. For detection of faces from group photographs, the system employs Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) available in the dlib library. For face recognition, Deep learning architecture known as ResNet is used to identify the students under different poses and lighting conditions. A real-time dataset was created using various photographs of the students from different angles with the most common scenarios that are likely to happen in the real classroom situation. The facial recognition model was trained on this custom real-time dataset thus addressing the challenge of photography in the classroom conditions. Using group images, the system recognizes students present classes, marks the attendance and registers them in the attendance database in real time. A user-friendly interface was developed for efficient management of attendance records. Developed Group picture attendance system demonstrates high accuracy in attendance management in various conditions, featuring seamless database integration and a user-friendly front-end interface for data retrieval.
